  let hasCustomMusic = (window.currentCustomMusic || []).length > 0 || (window.appCustomMusic || []).length > 0;
  let hasCustomBackgrounds = (window.currentCustomBackgrounds || []).length > 0 || (window.appCustomBackgrounds || []).length > 0;
  if(typeof hideDefaultMusicRow !== "undefined") hideDefaultMusicRow.hidden = !hasCustomMusic;
  if(typeof hideDefaultBackgroundsRow !== "undefined") hideDefaultBackgroundsRow.hidden = !hasCustomBackgrounds;

updateCustomMediaField(scope, listType, index, field, value) =>
  let list = (scope === "app")
    ? (listType === "music" ? (window.appCustomMusic || []) : (window.appCustomBackgrounds || []))
    : (listType === "music" ? (window.currentCustomMusic || []) : (window.currentCustomBackgrounds || []));
  if(!list[index]) return;
  list[index][field] = value;
  if(scope === "app") requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();

moveCustomMediaScope(listType, fromScope, index, toScope) =>
  if(fromScope === toScope) return;
  let fromList = (fromScope === "app")
    ? (listType === "music" ? (window.appCustomMusic || []) : (window.appCustomBackgrounds || []))
    : (listType === "music" ? (window.currentCustomMusic || []) : (window.currentCustomBackgrounds || []));
  let toList = (toScope === "app")
    ? (listType === "music" ? (window.appCustomMusic || []) : (window.appCustomBackgrounds || []))
    : (listType === "music" ? (window.currentCustomMusic || []) : (window.currentCustomBackgrounds || []));
  let item = fromList[index];
  if(!item) return;
  fromList.splice(index, 1);
  toList.push(item);
  requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();
  renderCustomMediaLists();

uploadCustomMediaFile(opts) =>
  if(!opts) return;
  let {accept, urlInputEl, buttonEl} = opts;
  if(!urlInputEl || !buttonEl) return;
  let input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  if(accept) input.accept = accept;
  input.onchange = async (event) => {
    let file = event.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;
    let originalText = buttonEl.textContent;
    let originalPlaceholder = urlInputEl.placeholder;
    buttonEl.textContent = "⏳";
    buttonEl.disabled = true;
    urlInputEl.placeholder = "uploading...";
    try {
      let { url, error } = await upload(file);
      if(error) throw new Error(error);
      urlInputEl.value = url;
    } catch(e) {
      alert(`Upload failed: ${e.message || e}`);
    } finally {
      buttonEl.textContent = originalText;
      buttonEl.disabled = false;
      urlInputEl.placeholder = originalPlaceholder;
    }
  };
  input.click();

uploadCustomMusicFile() =>
  uploadCustomMediaFile({
    accept: "audio/*",
    urlInputEl: newMusicUrlEl,
    buttonEl: uploadMusicBtn,
  });

uploadCustomBackgroundFile() =>
  uploadCustomMediaFile({
    accept: "image/*,video/*,.gif,.webm,.mp4,.mov",
    urlInputEl: newBackgroundUrlEl,
    buttonEl: uploadBackgroundBtn,
  });

addCustomMusic() =>
  let url = (newMusicUrlEl.value || "").trim();
  let title = (newMusicTitleEl.value || "").trim();
  if(!url || !title) {
    alert("Please add a title and URL.");
    return;
  }
  let emoji = "🎵";
  window.appCustomMusic = window.appCustomMusic || [];
  window.appCustomMusic.push({url, title, emoji});
  newMusicUrlEl.value = "";
  newMusicTitleEl.value = "";
  requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();
  renderCustomMediaLists();

removeCustomMusic(i, scope) =>
  if(!confirm("Remove this custom music?")) return;
  if(scope === "app") {
    window.appCustomMusic.splice(i,1);
    requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  } else {
    window.currentCustomMusic.splice(i,1);
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  }
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();
  renderCustomMediaLists();

addCustomBackground() =>
  let url = (newBackgroundUrlEl.value || "").trim();
  let title = (newBackgroundTitleEl.value || "").trim();
  if(!url || !title) {
    alert("Please add a title and URL.");
    return;
  }
  let emoji = "🖼️";
  window.appCustomBackgrounds = window.appCustomBackgrounds || [];
  window.appCustomBackgrounds.push({url, title, emoji});
  newBackgroundUrlEl.value = "";
  newBackgroundTitleEl.value = "";
  requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();
  renderCustomMediaLists();

removeCustomBackground(i, scope) =>
  if(!confirm("Remove this custom background?")) return;
  if(scope === "app") {
    window.appCustomBackgrounds.splice(i,1);
    requestAppMediaSaveDebounced({debounceMs:300});
  } else {
    window.currentCustomBackgrounds.splice(i,1);
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  }
  try { if(typeof storyDataChangedHandler === "function") storyDataChangedHandler(); } catch(e) {}
  renderMediaSelectOptions();
  renderCustomMediaLists();

// --- Mobile (portrait-screen) background override ---

isMobileBackgroundViewport() =>
  try { return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(orientation: portrait)").matches; } catch(e) { return false; }

getActiveBackgroundVisualUrl() =>
  // while the theme modal is open, staged (uncommitted) choices preview live
  // via this override — it never touches the saved state, so background
  // auto-saves can't leak a half-committed preview
  let preview = window.themeModalBackgroundPreview;
  if(preview) {
    if(preview.mobileEnabled && isMobileBackgroundViewport()) return (preview.mobile || "").trim();
    return (preview.bg || "").trim();
  }
  if(window.currentBackgroundVisualMobileEnabled && isMobileBackgroundViewport()) return (window.currentBackgroundVisualMobile || "").trim();
  return (window.currentBackgroundVisual || "").trim();

updateThemeModalBackgroundPreview() =>
  if(typeof themeModalEl === "undefined" || themeModalEl.hidden) return;
  window.themeModalBackgroundPreview = {
    bg: (typeof backgroundVisualSelectEl !== "undefined" ? backgroundVisualSelectEl.value : "") || "",
    mobile: (typeof backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl !== "undefined" ? backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.value : "") || "",
    mobileEnabled: (typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl !== "undefined") ? !mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden : false,
  };
  updateBackgroundVisual(false);

syncMobileBackgroundUi() =>
  if(typeof backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl === "undefined") return;
  let themeModalOpen = (typeof themeModalEl !== "undefined" && !themeModalEl.hidden);
  let stagedVal = backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.value;
  let stagedEnabled = (typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl !== "undefined") ? !mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden : false;
  let bgOptions = getCombinedBackgroundVisuals();
  backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.innerHTML = `<option value="">🚫 None</option>` + bgOptions.map(t => `<option value="${escapeHtml(t.url)}">${escapeHtml((t.emoji||"🖼️") + " " + (t.title || t.url))}</option>`).join("");
  backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.value = themeModalOpen ? stagedVal : (window.currentBackgroundVisualMobile || "");
  let mobileEnabled = themeModalOpen ? stagedEnabled : !!window.currentBackgroundVisualMobileEnabled;
  if(typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl !== "undefined") mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden = !mobileEnabled;
  if(typeof mobileBackgroundToggleBtn !== "undefined") mobileBackgroundToggleBtn.style.opacity = mobileEnabled ? "" : "0.55";

toggleMobileBackgroundSelect() =>
  // staged: only committed when the theme modal's save button is clicked
  if(typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl === "undefined") return;
  mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden = !mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden;
  if(typeof mobileBackgroundToggleBtn !== "undefined") mobileBackgroundToggleBtn.style.opacity = mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden ? "0.55" : "";
  updateThemeModalBackgroundPreview();

async updateBackgroundVisual(userInitiated) =>
  if(typeof backgroundImageCtn === "undefined") return;
  let url = getActiveBackgroundVisualUrl();
  try { localStorage.lastBgActive = url ? "1" : ""; } catch(e) {} // pre-paint hint for the next page load
  if(url) {
    let isVideo = /\.(mp4|webm|mkv|mov)$/i.test(url.split("?")[0]);
    let sameMedia = (window.lastBackgroundVisualUrl === url && !!window.lastBackgroundIsVideo === !!isVideo);
    if(isVideo) {
      backgroundImageCtn.style.backgroundImage = "";
      backgroundVideoEl.hidden = false;
      if(!sameMedia) {
        backgroundVideoEl.src = url;
        backgroundVideoEl.currentTime = 0;
      }
      try { backgroundVideoEl.play().catch(() => {}); } catch(e) {}
      userActivationPromise.then(() => backgroundVideoEl.play().catch(console.error));
    } else {
      if(!sameMedia) {
        backgroundImageCtn.style.backgroundImage = `url(${url})`;
        backgroundImageCtn.style.imageRendering = url.endsWith(".gif") ? "pixelated" : "";
      }
      backgroundVideoEl.hidden = true;
      backgroundVideoEl.src = "";
      backgroundVideoEl.pause();
    }
    document.body.classList.add("backgroundImageIsActive");
    let editorVisible = (typeof storyGenerationAreaEl !== "undefined" && !storyGenerationAreaEl.hidden);
    // Only apply overview/topStuff visibility on actual state TRANSITIONS. This function re-runs on
    // orientation media-query changes (which the mobile on-screen keyboard triggers by shrinking the
    // viewport), and unconditionally re-hiding the overview here would yank it away while the user
    // is trying to edit it, and stomp their "show overview" choice.
    let immersionState = editorVisible ? "bg-editor" : "bg-intro";
    if(window.lastAppliedImmersionState !== immersionState) {
      window.lastAppliedImmersionState = immersionState;
      if(editorVisible) {
        topStuffEl.hidden = true;
        toggleOverviewVisibilityEl.hidden = false;
        if(document.activeElement !== storyOverviewEl) {
          storyOverviewEl.hidden = true;
          storyOverviewPaddingEl.hidden = false;
        }
      } else {
        topStuffEl.hidden = false;
        toggleOverviewVisibilityEl.hidden = true;
        storyOverviewEl.hidden = false;
        storyOverviewPaddingEl.hidden = true;
      }
    }
    window.lastBackgroundVisualUrl = url;
    window.lastBackgroundIsVideo = isVideo;
  } else {
    backgroundImageCtn.style.backgroundImage = "";
    backgroundVideoEl.hidden = true;
    backgroundVideoEl.src = "";
    backgroundVideoEl.pause();
    document.body.classList.remove("backgroundImageIsActive");
    if(window.lastAppliedImmersionState !== "nobg") {
      window.lastAppliedImmersionState = "nobg";
      topStuffEl.hidden = false;
      toggleOverviewVisibilityEl.hidden = true;
      storyOverviewEl.hidden = false;
      storyOverviewPaddingEl.hidden = true;
    }
    window.lastBackgroundVisualUrl = "";
    window.lastBackgroundIsVideo = false;
  }
  updateOverviewToggleText();

getYouTubeVideoId(url) =>
  url = (url || "").toString().trim();
  // IMPORTANT: must actually be a youtube domain - a loose match on things like "v/" causes false positives (e.g. "uploads.dev/file/...")
  if(!/^(https?:\/\/)?(www\.|m\.|music\.)?(youtube(-nocookie)?\.com|youtu\.be)\//i.test(url)) return "";
  return (url.match(/^.*(?:(?:youtu\.be\/|v\/|vi\/|u\/\w\/|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/)|(?:(?:watch)?\?v(?:i)?=|\&v(?:i)?=))([^#\&\?\/]*).*/) || [])[1] || "";

isYouTubeUrl(url) =>
  return !!getYouTubeVideoId(url);

// The youtube iframe is created lazily (only when a youtube link is actually used) so it never slows down page load:
getYouTubeMusicIframe(createIfMissing) =>
  let el = window.youtubeBackgroundAudioIframeEl;
  if(el && el.isConnected) return el;
  if(!createIfMissing) return null;
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl === "undefined") return null;
  el = document.createElement("iframe");
  el.id = "youtubeBackgroundAudioPlayerEl";
  el.width = "336";
  el.height = "189";
  el.setAttribute("frameborder", "0");
  el.setAttribute("allow", "autoplay; encrypted-media");
  el.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.35rem; max-width:100%;";
  try { backgroundAudioPlayerEl.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", el); } catch(e) { console.error(e); return null; }
  window.youtubeBackgroundAudioIframeEl = el;
  return el;

removeYouTubeMusicIframe() =>
  let el = window.youtubeBackgroundAudioIframeEl;
  window.youtubeBackgroundAudioIframeEl = null;
  if(el) { try { el.remove(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); } }

applyMusicRepeatMode() =>
  musicRepeatMode = normalizeMusicRepeatMode(musicRepeatMode);
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl !== "undefined") {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.loop = (musicRepeatMode === "repeat");
  }
  if(typeof musicRepeatBtn !== "undefined") {
    // "repeat" = loop current track; "next" = no-repeat (advance through the playlist)
    if(musicRepeatMode === "repeat") musicRepeatBtn.textContent = "🔁";
    else musicRepeatBtn.innerHTML = combineEmojis("🚫", "🔁");
  }

updateMusicPlayback(userInitiated) =>
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl === "undefined") return;
  let url = (window.currentBackgroundMusic || "").trim();
  // YouTube URLs play via a lazily-created embedded iframe (prev/next/repeat don't control it):
  let youtubeId = getYouTubeVideoId(url);
  if(youtubeId) {
    window.musicAutoPlayNext = false;
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.pause();
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.removeAttribute("src");
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.hidden = true;
    let iframe = getYouTubeMusicIframe(true);
    if(iframe) {
      let embedUrl = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${youtubeId}`;
      if(iframe.src !== embedUrl) iframe.src = embedUrl;
    }
    updatePageMusicToggleBtn();
    return;
  } else {
    removeYouTubeMusicIframe(); // fully remove it from the DOM (setting src="" would navigate the iframe to the page's own URL)
  }
  let wasPlaying = !backgroundAudioPlayerEl.paused;
  let shouldAutoPlay = !!window.musicAutoPlayNext || (!!userInitiated && !!url);
  window.musicAutoPlayNext = false;
  applyMusicRepeatMode();
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.autoplay = false;
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.onended = () => {
    if(musicRepeatMode === "next") {
      window.musicAutoPlayNext = true;
      playNextTrack();
    }
    else if(musicRepeatMode === "repeat") backgroundAudioPlayerEl.currentTime = 0;
  };
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.onplay = updatePageMusicToggleBtn;
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.onpause = updatePageMusicToggleBtn;
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.volume = 0.6;
  if(!url) {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.pause();
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.removeAttribute("src");
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.hidden = true;
    updatePageMusicToggleBtn();
    return;
  }
  backgroundAudioPlayerEl.hidden = false;
  let srcChanged = false;
  if(backgroundAudioPlayerEl.src !== url) {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.src = url;
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.currentTime = 0;
    srcChanged = true;
  }
  if(shouldAutoPlay) {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.play().catch(console.error);
  } else if(wasPlaying && !srcChanged) {
    // same track is already playing - leave it alone (e.g. this update was just a repeat-mode toggle)
  } else {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.pause();
  }
  updatePageMusicToggleBtn();

updatePageMusicToggleBtn() =>
  if(typeof pageMusicToggleBtn === "undefined" || typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl === "undefined") return;
  let hasSong = !!(window.currentBackgroundMusic || "").trim();
  if(hasSong && isYouTubeUrl(window.currentBackgroundMusic || "")) hasSong = false; // can't control the youtube iframe from here
  pageMusicToggleBtn.hidden = !hasSong;
  if(!hasSong) return;
  pageMusicToggleBtn.textContent = backgroundAudioPlayerEl.paused ? "🎵" : "⏸️";

togglePageMusicPlayback() =>
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl === "undefined") return;
  if(backgroundAudioPlayerEl.paused) {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.play().then(updatePageMusicToggleBtn).catch(console.error);
  } else {
    backgroundAudioPlayerEl.pause();
    updatePageMusicToggleBtn();
  }

playNextTrack() =>
  let list = getCombinedMusicTracks().map(t => t.url).filter(Boolean);
  if(list.length === 0) return;
  let current = window.currentBackgroundMusic || "";
  let idx = list.indexOf(current);
  let next = list[(idx + 1) % list.length];
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl !== "undefined" && !backgroundAudioPlayerEl.paused) {
    window.musicAutoPlayNext = true;
  }
  backgroundMusicSelectEl.value = next;
  onMusicSelectChange(true);

playPreviousTrack() =>
  let list = getCombinedMusicTracks().map(t => t.url).filter(Boolean);
  if(list.length === 0) return;
  let current = window.currentBackgroundMusic || "";
  let idx = list.indexOf(current);
  let prev = list[(idx - 1 + list.length) % list.length];
  if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl !== "undefined" && !backgroundAudioPlayerEl.paused) {
    window.musicAutoPlayNext = true;
  }
  backgroundMusicSelectEl.value = prev;
  onMusicSelectChange(true);

toggleMusicRepeatMode() =>
  musicRepeatMode = (musicRepeatMode === "repeat") ? "next" : "repeat";
  applyMusicRepeatMode();
  requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  updateMusicPlayback(false);

randomizeBackgroundMusic() =>
  let list = getCombinedMusicTracks().map(t => t.url).filter(Boolean);
  let current = window.currentBackgroundMusic || "";
  let options = list.filter(u => u !== current);
  if(options.length === 0) return;
  let next = options[Math.floor(Math.random()*options.length)];
  window.musicAutoPlayNext = true;
  backgroundMusicSelectEl.value = next;
  onMusicSelectChange(true);

randomizeBackgroundVisual() =>
  let list = getCombinedBackgroundVisuals().map(t => t.url).filter(Boolean);
  let current = window.currentBackgroundVisual || "";
  let options = list.filter(u => u !== current);
  if(options.length === 0) return;
  applyBackgroundVisualUrl(options[Math.floor(Math.random()*options.length)]);

/////////////
// Notepad //
/////////////

getNotebookScope() =>
  return (window.notepadScope === "app") ? "app" : "story";

getNotebookDataForScope(scope) =>
  scope = (scope === "app") ? "app" : "story";
  let data = (scope === "app") ? window.appNotebookData : window.currentStoryNotebookData;
  return normalizeNotebookData(data);

setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data) =>
  scope = (scope === "app") ? "app" : "story";
  let normalized = normalizeNotebookData(data);
  if(scope === "app") window.appNotebookData = normalized;
  else window.currentStoryNotebookData = normalized;
  return normalized;

ensureNotepadEditor() =>
  if(window.notepadEditorEl) return window.notepadEditorEl;
  if(typeof notepadEditorCtn === "undefined") return null;
  window.notepadEditorEl = createTextEditor({
    textStyleRules: getStoryTextStyleRules(),
  });
  notepadEditorEl.id = "notepadEditorEl";
  notepadEditorEl.placeholder = "A place to add notes that won't affect the adventure.";
  notepadEditorEl.style.cssText = "width:100%; height:100%; min-height:0; max-height:none; display:block; resize:none;";
  notepadEditorCtn.innerHTML = "";
  notepadEditorCtn.appendChild(notepadEditorEl);
  notepadEditorEl.addEventListener("input", function() {
    if(window.notepadLoadingContent) return;
    clearTimeout(window.notepadSaveDebounceTimeout);
    window.notepadSaveDebounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
    }, 350);
  });
  return notepadEditorEl;

saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab() =>
  if(!window.notepadEditorEl) return;
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  let active = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === data.activeTabId) || data.tabs[0];
  if(active) {
    active.content = window.notepadEditorEl.value || "";
    active.lastEditedTime = Date.now();
  }
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  if(typeof notepadPanel !== "undefined" && !notepadPanel.hidden) renderNotepadTabs({skipLoad:true});
  if(scope === "app") requestAppNotebookSaveDebounced({debounceMs:400});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:400});

loadNotepadTabContent(tabId) =>
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  let tab = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === tabId) || data.tabs[0];
  if(!tab) return;
  data.activeTabId = tab.id;
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  ensureNotepadEditor();
  if(window.notepadEditorEl) {
    window.notepadLoadingContent = true;
    window.notepadEditorEl.value = tab.content || "";
    window.notepadLoadingContent = false;
  }

renderNotepadTabs(opts) =>
  if(!opts) opts = {};
  if(typeof notepadTabsSelectEl === "undefined") return;
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = setNotebookDataForScope(scope, getNotebookDataForScope(scope));
  let sortedTabs = (data.tabs || []).slice(0).sort((a,b) => (b.lastEditedTime||0) - (a.lastEditedTime||0));
  let options = [`<option value="__add__">➕ 𝗡𝗲𝘄 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲</option>`];
  options = options.concat(sortedTabs.map(t => `<option value="${escapeHtml(t.id)}">${escapeHtml(t.title || "Page")}</option>`));
  notepadTabsSelectEl.innerHTML = options.join("");
  notepadTabsSelectEl.value = data.activeTabId || "";
  if(!opts.skipLoad) loadNotepadTabContent(data.activeTabId);

setActiveNotepadTab(tabId) =>
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  if(window.notepadEditorEl && !window.notepadLoadingContent) {
    let active = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === data.activeTabId) || data.tabs[0];
    if(active) active.content = window.notepadEditorEl.value || "";
  }
  let nextTab = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === tabId);
  if(!nextTab) return;
  data.activeTabId = nextTab.id;
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  if(typeof notepadTabsSelectEl !== "undefined") {
    notepadTabsSelectEl.value = nextTab.id;
  }
  loadNotepadTabContent(nextTab.id);
  if(scope === "app") requestAppNotebookSaveDebounced({debounceMs:400});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:400});

onNotepadTabsSelectChange(value) =>
  if(value === "__add__") {
    addNotepadTab();
    return;
  }
  setActiveNotepadTab(value);

openNotepadPanel() =>
  if(typeof notepadPanel === "undefined") return;
  notepadPanel.hidden = false;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    document.body.classList.add("notepadOpen");
    updateNotepadOverlayMode();
  });
  if(typeof notepadScopeSelectEl !== "undefined") {
    window.notepadScope = (notepadScopeSelectEl.value === "app") ? "app" : "story";
    notepadScopeSelectEl.value = window.notepadScope;
  }
  ensureNotepadEditor();
  renderNotepadTabs();
  setupNotepadResizer();

toggleNotepadPanel() =>
  if(document.body.classList.contains("notepadOpen")) closeNotepadPanel();
  else openNotepadPanel();

closeNotepadPanel() =>
  if(typeof notepadPanel === "undefined") return;
  saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
  document.body.classList.remove("notepadOpen");
  document.body.classList.remove("notepadOverlayMode");
  if(typeof notepadTabMenu !== "undefined") notepadTabMenu.hidden = true;
  if(typeof notepadOverlay !== "undefined") notepadOverlay.hidden = true;
  setTimeout(() => {
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("notepadOpen")) notepadPanel.hidden = true;
  }, 160);

setNotepadScope(scope) =>
  saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
  window.notepadScope = (scope === "app") ? "app" : "story";
  if(typeof notepadScopeSelectEl !== "undefined") notepadScopeSelectEl.value = window.notepadScope;
  renderNotepadTabs();

addNotepadTab() =>
  saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  let id = `tab_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`;
  let title = `Page ${data.tabs.length + 1}`;
  data.tabs.push({id, title, content:"", lastEditedTime:Date.now()});
  data.activeTabId = id;
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  renderNotepadTabs();
  if(scope === "app") requestAppNotebookSaveDebounced({debounceMs:400});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:400});

renameActiveNotepadTab() =>
  saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  let active = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === data.activeTabId) || data.tabs[0];
  if(!active) return;
  let name = prompt("Rename tab:", active.title || "");
  if(typeof notepadTabMenu !== "undefined") notepadTabMenu.hidden = true;
  if(name === null) return;
  name = name.trim();
  if(!name) return;
  active.title = name;
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  renderNotepadTabs();
  if(scope === "app") requestAppNotebookSaveDebounced({debounceMs:400});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:400});

deleteActiveNotepadTab() =>
  saveNotepadEditorToActiveTab();
  let scope = getNotebookScope();
  let data = getNotebookDataForScope(scope);
  let active = data.tabs.find(t => t.id === data.activeTabId) || data.tabs[0];
  if(!active) return;
  if(!confirm("Delete this tab?")) return;
  data.tabs = data.tabs.filter(t => t.id !== active.id);
  if(typeof notepadTabMenu !== "undefined") notepadTabMenu.hidden = true;
  if(data.tabs.length === 0) {
    let id = `tab_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`;
    data.tabs = [{id, title:"Page 1", content:"", lastEditedTime:Date.now()}];
    data.activeTabId = id;
  } else {
    data.activeTabId = data.tabs[0].id;
  }
  setNotebookDataForScope(scope, data);
  renderNotepadTabs();
  if(scope === "app") requestAppNotebookSaveDebounced({debounceMs:400});
  else requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:400});

toggleNotepadTabMenu() =>
  if(typeof notepadTabMenu === "undefined") return;
  notepadTabMenu.hidden = !notepadTabMenu.hidden;

updateNotepadForCurrentStory() =>
  if(typeof notepadScopeSelectEl !== "undefined") {
    notepadScopeSelectEl.value = getNotebookScope();
  }
  if(typeof notepadPanel !== "undefined" && !notepadPanel.hidden) {
    renderNotepadTabs();
  }

updateNotepadOverlayMode() =>
  let overlayMode = window.innerWidth < 650;
  window.notepadOverlayMode = overlayMode;
  document.body.classList.toggle("notepadOverlayMode", overlayMode);
  if(typeof notepadOverlay !== "undefined") {
    let isOpen = document.body.classList.contains("notepadOpen");
    notepadOverlay.hidden = !overlayMode || !isOpen;
  }

setupNotepadResizer() =>
  if(window.notepadResizerSetup) return;
  if(typeof notepadResizeHandle === "undefined" || typeof notepadPanel === "undefined") return;
  window.notepadResizerSetup = true;
  notepadResizeHandle.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let startX = e.clientX;
    let startWidth = notepadPanel.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    notepadResizeHandle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    function onMove(ev) {
      let delta = startX - ev.clientX;
      let nextWidth = Math.max(220, startWidth + delta);
      nextWidth = Math.min(nextWidth, Math.max(260, window.innerWidth - 160));
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--notepad-width", `${Math.round(nextWidth)}px`);
    }
    function onUp(ev) {
      notepadResizeHandle.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      let width = parseInt(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--notepad-width")) || notepadPanel.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      localStorage.notepadWidth = Math.round(width);
    }
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
  });

///////////
// Theme //
///////////

openThemeModal() =>
  if(typeof themeModalEl === "undefined") return;
  ensureThemeSchemeListeners();
  if(typeof themeSchemeSelectEl !== "undefined") themeSchemeSelectEl.value = getActiveColorScheme();
  loadThemeSettingsIntoModal();
  renderMediaSelectOptions(); // modal still hidden here, so this resets the staged background selects to the saved state
  window.themeModalSnapshot = getThemeModalSnapshot();
  if(typeof themeAdvancedSection !== "undefined" && !themeAdvancedSection.hidden) {
    ensureThemeAdvancedReady();
  }
  themeModalEl.hidden = false;

closeThemeModal(opts) =>
  if(typeof themeModalEl === "undefined") return;
  if(!opts || !opts.skipConfirm) {
    if(hasThemeModalUnsavedChanges()) {
      if(!confirm("Discard theme changes?")) return;
    }
  }
  try { if(typeof fontHelpTooltip !== "undefined") fontHelpTooltip.hidden = true; } catch(e) {}
  themeModalEl.hidden = true;
  if(window.themeModalBackgroundPreview) {
    window.themeModalBackgroundPreview = null;
    updateBackgroundVisual(false); // revert (or, after save, re-apply the committed state)
  }

normalizeColorScheme(scheme) =>
  return (scheme === "dark") ? "dark" : "light";

getActiveColorScheme() =>
  let scheme = document.documentElement.style.colorScheme;
  if(scheme !== "dark" && scheme !== "light") {
    scheme = (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) ? "dark" : "light";
  }
  return normalizeColorScheme(scheme);

setManualColorScheme(scheme) =>
  scheme = normalizeColorScheme(scheme);
  localStorage.forceColorScheme = scheme;
  setColorScheme(scheme);
  let systemColorScheme = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? "dark" : "light";
  if(systemColorScheme === scheme) {
    localStorage.removeItem("forceColorScheme");
  }

loadAppThemeSettingsByScheme() =>
  let raw = localStorage.themeSettingsByScheme || "";
  let settings = getThemeDefaultsByScheme();
  if(raw) {
    try { settings = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(JSON.parse(raw), {allowNull:false}); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  for(let scheme of ["light","dark"]) {
    let entry = settings[scheme];
    if(entry?.storyFontFamily) entry.storyFontFamily = parseFontFamilyInput(entry.storyFontFamily);
  }
  window.themeSettingsByScheme = settings;
  return settings;

getEffectiveThemeSettingsByScheme() =>
  if(window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme) {
    let storySettings = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme, {allowNull:false});
    return storySettings;
  }
  return loadAppThemeSettingsByScheme();

getEffectiveThemeSettings(scheme) =>
  scheme = normalizeColorScheme(scheme || getActiveColorScheme());
  let settingsByScheme = getEffectiveThemeSettingsByScheme();
  return settingsByScheme[scheme] || {...getThemeDefaults()};

saveThemeSettingsByScheme() =>
  localStorage.themeSettingsByScheme = JSON.stringify(window.themeSettingsByScheme || getThemeDefaultsByScheme());

parseFontFamilyInput(raw) =>
  let val = (raw || "").toString().trim();
  if(!val) return "";
  return val.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "");

extractFontNameFromInput(raw) =>
  let val = (raw || "").toString().trim();
  if(!val) return "";
  val = val.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "");
  let specimenMatch = val.match(/fonts\.google\.com\/specimen\/([^?#/]+)/i);
  if(specimenMatch && specimenMatch[1]) {
    let name = specimenMatch[1].replace(/\+/g, " ");
    try { name = decodeURIComponent(name); } catch(e) {}
    return name.trim();
  }
  let familyMatch = val.match(/[?&]family=([^&#]+)/i);
  if(familyMatch && familyMatch[1]) {
    let name = familyMatch[1].split(":")[0].replace(/\+/g, " ");
    try { name = decodeURIComponent(name); } catch(e) {}
    return name.trim();
  }
  return val;

getThemeModalScheme() =>
  if(typeof themeSchemeSelectEl !== "undefined") {
    let val = themeSchemeSelectEl.value;
    if(val === "dark" || val === "light") return val;
  }
  return getActiveColorScheme();

ensureThemeSchemeListeners() =>
  if(window.themeSchemeListenersReady) return;
  window.themeSchemeListenersReady = true;
  if(typeof themeSchemeSelectEl === "undefined") return;
  themeSchemeSelectEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
    let newScheme = normalizeColorScheme(themeSchemeSelectEl.value);
    let currentScheme = getActiveColorScheme();
    if(newScheme === currentScheme) return;
    if(hasThemeModalUnsavedChanges()) {
      if(!confirm("Discard theme changes?")) {
        themeSchemeSelectEl.value = currentScheme;
        return;
      }
    }
    setManualColorScheme(newScheme);
    loadThemeSettingsIntoModal();
    window.themeModalSnapshot = getThemeModalSnapshot();
  });

getThemeModalDefaultColors() =>
  let scheme = getThemeModalScheme();
  let defaultText = (scheme === "light") ? "#000000" : "#b7b7b7";
  let defaultBg = (scheme === "light") ? "#ffffff" : "#000000";
  let defaultItalic = (scheme === "light") ? "#585858" : "#919191";
  let defaultQuote = (scheme === "light") ? "#00539b" : "#4eb5f7";
  let defaultAction = (scheme === "light") ? "#7c3e00" : "#ffc86e";
  return {scheme, defaultText, defaultBg, defaultItalic, defaultQuote, defaultAction};

updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal() =>
  if(typeof themeTextColorEl === "undefined") return;
  let {defaultText, defaultBg, defaultItalic, defaultQuote, defaultAction} = getThemeModalDefaultColors();
  if(typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined" && themeTextAutoEl.checked) {
    themeTextColorEl.value = defaultText;
  }
  if(typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined" && themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked) {
    themeBackgroundColorEl.value = defaultBg;
  }
  if(typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined" && themeItalicAutoEl.checked) {
    themeItalicColorEl.value = defaultItalic;
  }
  if(typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined" && themeQuoteAutoEl.checked) {
    themeQuoteColorEl.value = defaultQuote;
  }
  if(typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined" && themeActionAutoEl.checked) {
    themeActionColorEl.value = defaultAction;
  }

ensureThemeAutoListeners() =>
  if(window.themeAutoListenersReady) return;
  window.themeAutoListenersReady = true;
  if(typeof themeTextColorEl !== "undefined") {
    themeTextColorEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if(typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined") themeTextAutoEl.checked = false;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeBackgroundColorEl !== "undefined") {
    themeBackgroundColorEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if(typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined") themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked = false;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeItalicColorEl !== "undefined") {
    themeItalicColorEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if(typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined") themeItalicAutoEl.checked = false;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeQuoteColorEl !== "undefined") {
    themeQuoteColorEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if(typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined") themeQuoteAutoEl.checked = false;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeActionColorEl !== "undefined") {
    themeActionColorEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if(typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined") themeActionAutoEl.checked = false;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined") {
    themeTextAutoEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if(themeTextAutoEl.checked) updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal();
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined") {
    themeBackgroundAutoEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if(themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked) updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal();
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined") {
    themeItalicAutoEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if(themeItalicAutoEl.checked) updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal();
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined") {
    themeQuoteAutoEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if(themeQuoteAutoEl.checked) updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal();
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined") {
    themeActionAutoEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if(themeActionAutoEl.checked) updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal();
    });
  }
  if(window.onForcedColorSchemeChangeHandlers) {
    window.onForcedColorSchemeChangeHandlers.add(() => updateThemeAutoDefaultsInModal());
  }

getThemeModalSnapshot() =>
  if(typeof themeTextColorEl === "undefined") return "";
  return JSON.stringify({
    backgroundVisual: (typeof backgroundVisualSelectEl !== "undefined" ? backgroundVisualSelectEl.value : "") || "",
    backgroundVisualMobile: (typeof backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl !== "undefined" ? backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.value : "") || "",
    backgroundVisualMobileEnabled: (typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl !== "undefined" ? !mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden : false),
    storyTextColor: themeTextColorEl.value || "",
    storyBackgroundColor: themeBackgroundColorEl.value || "",
    storyTextAuto: (typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeTextAutoEl.checked : false),
    storyBackgroundAuto: (typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked : false),
    storyFontFamily: parseFontFamilyInput(themeFontFamilyEl.value || ""),
    italicColor: themeItalicColorEl.value || "",
    italicAuto: (typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeItalicAutoEl.checked : false),
    italicItalic: !!themeItalicIsItalicEl.checked,
    quoteColor: themeQuoteColorEl.value || "",
    quoteAuto: (typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeQuoteAutoEl.checked : false),
    quoteItalic: !!themeQuoteIsItalicEl.checked,
    actionColor: (typeof themeActionColorEl !== "undefined" ? themeActionColorEl.value : "") || "",
    actionAuto: (typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeActionAutoEl.checked : false),
    actionItalic: (typeof themeActionIsItalicEl !== "undefined" ? !!themeActionIsItalicEl.checked : true),
    scope: (typeof themeScopeSelectEl !== "undefined" ? themeScopeSelectEl.value : "app"),
    advancedVisible: (typeof themeAdvancedSection !== "undefined" ? !themeAdvancedSection.hidden : false),
    advancedRules: collectThemeAdvancedRulesFromModal(),
  });

hasThemeModalUnsavedChanges() =>
  let snap = window.themeModalSnapshot || "";
  let now = getThemeModalSnapshot();
  return snap && now && snap !== now;

renderThemeAdvancedRules(rules) =>
  if(typeof themeAdvancedRulesCtn === "undefined") return;
  if(!Array.isArray(rules)) rules = [];
  let ready = !!window.themeAdvancedReady;
  let patternPlaceholder = ready ? "Text or /regex/flags" : "Loading...";
  let cssPlaceholder = ready ? "e.g. color:#d33; font-weight:bold;" : "Loading...";
  let disabledAttr = ready ? "" : "disabled";
  let aiButtonText = ready ? "🧠" : "⏳";
  let rows = rules.map(r => ({pattern: (r?.pattern || "").toString(), css: (r?.css || "").toString()}));
  rows.push({pattern:"", css:""});
  themeAdvancedRulesCtn.innerHTML = rows.map((r, i) => `
    <div class="themeAdvancedRow" data-index="${i}">
      <textarea class="themePatternInput" rows="1" placeholder="${patternPlaceholder}" ${disabledAttr}>${escapeHtml(r.pattern)}</textarea>
      <input class="themeCssInput" placeholder="${cssPlaceholder}" value="${escapeHtml(r.css)}" ${disabledAttr}>
      <button class="themeRuleAiBtn" title="Describe rule" ${disabledAttr}>${aiButtonText}</button>
    </div>
  `).join("");
  ensureThemeAdvancedRowCount();

collectThemeAdvancedRulesFromModal() =>
  if(typeof themeAdvancedRulesCtn === "undefined") return [];
  let rows = [...themeAdvancedRulesCtn.querySelectorAll(".themeAdvancedRow")];
  let rules = [];
  for(let row of rows) {
    let pattern = row.querySelector(".themePatternInput")?.value?.trim() || "";
    let css = row.querySelector(".themeCssInput")?.value?.trim() || "";
    if(pattern && css) rules.push({pattern, css});
  }
  return rules;

ensureThemeAdvancedRowCount() =>
  if(typeof themeAdvancedRulesCtn === "undefined") return;
  let rows = [...themeAdvancedRulesCtn.querySelectorAll(".themeAdvancedRow")];
  if(rows.length === 0) {
    renderThemeAdvancedRules([]);
    return;
  }
  let last = rows[rows.length-1];
  let lastPattern = last.querySelector(".themePatternInput")?.value?.trim() || "";
  let lastCss = last.querySelector(".themeCssInput")?.value?.trim() || "";
  if(lastPattern && lastCss) {
    renderThemeAdvancedRules(collectThemeAdvancedRulesFromModal());
  }

toggleThemeAdvancedSection() =>
  if(typeof themeAdvancedSection === "undefined") return;
  themeAdvancedSection.hidden = !themeAdvancedSection.hidden;
  window.themeAdvancedVisible = !themeAdvancedSection.hidden;
  if(!themeAdvancedSection.hidden) ensureThemeAdvancedReady();
  if(typeof themeAdvancedToggleBtn !== "undefined") themeAdvancedToggleBtn.textContent = themeAdvancedSection.hidden ? "⚙️ advanced" : "🙈 advanced";

buildThemeAdvancedTextRules(rules) =>
  let output = [];
  if(!Array.isArray(rules)) return output;
  for(let r of rules) {
    let pattern = (r?.pattern || "").toString().trim();
    let css = (r?.css || "").toString().trim();
    if(!pattern || !css) continue;
    let regex = null;
    if(/^\/.+\/[gimsuy]*$/.test(pattern)) {
      let lastSlash = pattern.lastIndexOf("/");
      let body = pattern.slice(1, lastSlash);
      let flags = pattern.slice(lastSlash+1) || "g";
      if(!flags.includes("g")) flags += "g";
      try { regex = new RegExp(body, flags); } catch(e) { regex = null; }
    } else {
      let escaped = pattern.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
      try { regex = new RegExp(escaped, "g"); } catch(e) { regex = null; }
    }
    if(!regex) continue;
    output.push({match: regex, style: css});
  }
  return output;

ensureThemeAdvancedReady() =>
  if(window.themeAdvancedReady) return;
  if(window.themeAdvancedReadyPromise) return;
  window.themeAdvancedReadyPromise = (async () => {
    try { await ai({preload:true}); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    window.themeAdvancedReady = true;
    window.themeAdvancedReadyPromise = null;
    renderThemeAdvancedRules(collectThemeAdvancedRulesFromModal());
  })();

async generateThemeRuleWithAi(rowEl, btnEl) =>
  if(!rowEl) return;
  let originalBtnText = btnEl?.textContent;
  if(btnEl) { btnEl.textContent = "⏳"; btnEl.disabled = true; }
  let description = prompt("Describe the rule you want, e.g. \"make the word Alice appear bold\".");
  if(!description) { if(btnEl) { btnEl.textContent = originalBtnText || "⏳"; btnEl.disabled = false; } return; }
  try {
    let result = await ai({
      instruction: [
        "Convert the user's description into a JSON object with keys:",
        `"pattern": a literal text or a /regex/flags string (include 'g' flag),`,
        `"css": CSS text styling rules like "color:#d33; font-weight:bold;"`,
        "Return ONLY JSON with those two keys and no extra text.",
        "",
        `User description: ${description}`,
      ].join("\n"),
      stopSequences: ["\n\n"],
    });
    if(result.stopReason === "error") {
      alert("Failed to generate rule.");
      return;
    }
    let text = (result.generatedText || "").trim();
    let jsonText = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/)?.[0] || "";
    if(!jsonText) {
      alert("Could not parse the generated rule.");
      return;
    }
    let parsed = JSON.parse(jsonText);
    let pattern = (parsed.pattern || "").toString().trim();
    let css = (parsed.css || "").toString().trim();
    if(!pattern || !css) {
      alert("Generated rule was incomplete.");
      return;
    }
    rowEl.querySelector(".themePatternInput").value = pattern;
    rowEl.querySelector(".themeCssInput").value = css;
    ensureThemeAdvancedRowCount();
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
    alert("Failed to generate rule.");
  } finally {
    if(btnEl) { btnEl.textContent = originalBtnText || "⏳"; btnEl.disabled = false; }
  }

loadThemeSettingsIntoModal() =>
  ensureThemeSchemeListeners();
  let scheme = getThemeModalScheme();
  if(typeof themeSchemeSelectEl !== "undefined") themeSchemeSelectEl.value = scheme;
  let s = getEffectiveThemeSettings(scheme);
  if(typeof themeScopeSelectEl !== "undefined") themeScopeSelectEl.value = "story";
  ensureThemeAutoListeners();
  let {defaultText, defaultBg, defaultItalic, defaultQuote, defaultAction} = getThemeModalDefaultColors();
  let textColor = s.storyTextColor || defaultText;
  let bgColor = s.storyBackgroundColor || defaultBg;
  let italicColor = s.italicColor || defaultItalic;
  let quoteColor = s.quoteColor || defaultQuote;
  let actionColor = s.actionColor || defaultAction;
  let textIsAuto = !s.storyTextColor;
  let bgIsAuto = !s.storyBackgroundColor;
  let italicIsAuto = !s.italicColor;
  let quoteIsAuto = !s.quoteColor;
  let actionIsAuto = !s.actionColor;
  if(!/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(textColor)) { textColor = defaultText; textIsAuto = true; }
  if(!/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(bgColor)) { bgColor = defaultBg; bgIsAuto = true; }
  if(!/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(italicColor)) { italicColor = defaultItalic; italicIsAuto = true; }
  if(!/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(quoteColor)) { quoteColor = defaultQuote; quoteIsAuto = true; }
  if(!/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(actionColor)) { actionColor = defaultAction; actionIsAuto = true; }
  if(typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined") themeTextAutoEl.checked = textIsAuto;
  if(typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined") themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked = bgIsAuto;
  if(typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined") themeItalicAutoEl.checked = italicIsAuto;
  if(typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined") themeQuoteAutoEl.checked = quoteIsAuto;
  if(typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined") themeActionAutoEl.checked = actionIsAuto;
  themeTextColorEl.value = textColor;
  themeBackgroundColorEl.value = bgColor;
  themeFontFamilyEl.value = parseFontFamilyInput(s.storyFontFamily || "");
  themeItalicColorEl.value = italicColor;
  themeItalicIsItalicEl.checked = (s.italicItalic !== false);
  themeQuoteColorEl.value = quoteColor;
  themeQuoteIsItalicEl.checked = (s.quoteItalic !== false);
  if(typeof themeActionColorEl !== "undefined") themeActionColorEl.value = actionColor;
  if(typeof themeActionIsItalicEl !== "undefined") themeActionIsItalicEl.checked = (s.actionItalic !== false);
  if(typeof themeAdvancedRulesCtn !== "undefined") renderThemeAdvancedRules(s.advancedRules || []);
  if(typeof themeAdvancedSection !== "undefined") themeAdvancedSection.hidden = !window.themeAdvancedVisible;
  if(typeof themeAdvancedToggleBtn !== "undefined") themeAdvancedToggleBtn.textContent = (themeAdvancedSection?.hidden ? "⚙️ advanced" : "🙈 advanced");

saveThemeSettingsFromModal() =>
  let scheme = getThemeModalScheme();
  let s = {...getThemeDefaults()};
  let textAuto = (typeof themeTextAutoEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeTextAutoEl.checked : false;
  let bgAuto = (typeof themeBackgroundAutoEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeBackgroundAutoEl.checked : false;
  let italicAuto = (typeof themeItalicAutoEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeItalicAutoEl.checked : false;
  let quoteAuto = (typeof themeQuoteAutoEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeQuoteAutoEl.checked : false;
  let actionAuto = (typeof themeActionAutoEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeActionAutoEl.checked : false;
  s.storyTextColor = textAuto ? "" : themeTextColorEl.value.trim();
  s.storyBackgroundColor = bgAuto ? "" : themeBackgroundColorEl.value.trim();
  s.storyFontFamily = parseFontFamilyInput(themeFontFamilyEl.value);
  themeFontFamilyEl.value = s.storyFontFamily || "";
  s.italicColor = italicAuto ? "" : themeItalicColorEl.value.trim();
  s.italicItalic = !!themeItalicIsItalicEl.checked;
  s.quoteColor = quoteAuto ? "" : themeQuoteColorEl.value.trim();
  s.quoteItalic = !!themeQuoteIsItalicEl.checked;
  s.actionColor = (typeof themeActionColorEl !== "undefined") ? (actionAuto ? "" : themeActionColorEl.value.trim()) : "";
  s.actionItalic = (typeof themeActionIsItalicEl !== "undefined") ? !!themeActionIsItalicEl.checked : true;
  s.advancedRules = collectThemeAdvancedRulesFromModal();
  if(typeof themeScopeSelectEl !== "undefined" && themeScopeSelectEl.value === "story") {
    let map = window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme || getThemeDefaultsByScheme();
    map = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(map, {allowNull:false});
    map[scheme] = s;
    window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme = map;
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  } else {
    window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme = null;
    let map = window.themeSettingsByScheme || loadAppThemeSettingsByScheme();
    map = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(map, {allowNull:false});
    map[scheme] = s;
    window.themeSettingsByScheme = map;
    saveThemeSettingsByScheme();
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  }
  // commit the staged background choices
  if(typeof backgroundVisualSelectEl !== "undefined") {
    window.currentBackgroundVisual = backgroundVisualSelectEl.value || "";
    if(typeof backgroundVisualSelectInlineEl !== "undefined") backgroundVisualSelectInlineEl.value = window.currentBackgroundVisual;
  }
  if(typeof mobileBackgroundRowEl !== "undefined") window.currentBackgroundVisualMobileEnabled = !mobileBackgroundRowEl.hidden;
  if(typeof backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl !== "undefined") window.currentBackgroundVisualMobile = backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl.value || "";
  updateBackgroundVisual(true);
  applyThemeSettings();
  closeThemeModal({skipConfirm:true});

resetThemeSettingsToDefault() =>
  if(!confirm("Reset theme to default?")) return;
  let scheme = getThemeModalScheme();
  if(typeof themeScopeSelectEl !== "undefined" && themeScopeSelectEl.value === "story") {
    let map = window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme || getThemeDefaultsByScheme();
    map = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(map, {allowNull:false});
    map[scheme] = {...getThemeDefaults()};
    window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme = map;
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  } else {
    window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme = null;
    let map = window.themeSettingsByScheme || loadAppThemeSettingsByScheme();
    map = normalizeThemeSettingsByScheme(map, {allowNull:false});
    map[scheme] = {...getThemeDefaults()};
    window.themeSettingsByScheme = map;
    saveThemeSettingsByScheme();
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
  }
  applyThemeSettings();
  loadThemeSettingsIntoModal();

ensureGoogleFontLoaded(fontName) =>
  let name = (fontName || "").toString().trim();
  if(!name) return;
  let safeName = extractFontNameFromInput(name).split(",")[0].replace(/["'<>]/g, "").trim();
  if(!safeName) return;
  let id = "googleFont_" + btoa(safeName).replace(/=+/g, "");
  if(document.getElementById(id)) return;
  let family = encodeURIComponent(safeName).replace(/%20/g, "+");
  let link = document.createElement("link");
  link.id = id;
  link.rel = "stylesheet";
  link.href = `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${family}&display=swap`;
  document.head.appendChild(link);

getStoryTextStyleRules() =>
  let scheme = getActiveColorScheme();
  let s = getEffectiveThemeSettings(scheme);
  let defaultItalicColor = (scheme === "light") ? "#585858" : "#919191";
  let defaultQuoteColor = (scheme === "light") ? "#00539b" : "#4eb5f7";
  let defaultActionColor = (scheme === "light") ? "#7c3e00" : "#ffc86e";
  let italicParts = [`color:${s.italicColor || defaultItalicColor};`];
  if(s.italicItalic !== false) italicParts.push("font-style:italic;");
  let quoteParts = [`color:${s.quoteColor || defaultQuoteColor};`];
  if(s.quoteItalic !== false) quoteParts.push("font-style:italic;");
  let actionParts = [`color:${s.actionColor || defaultActionColor};`];
  if(s.actionItalic !== false) actionParts.push("font-style:italic;");
  let rules = [
    {match: /(\s|^)\*\*[^*"“”]+?\*\*/g, style: "font-weight:bold;"},
    {match: /(\s|^)\*[^*"“”]+?\*/g,     style: italicParts.join(" ")},
    {match: /(^|\n)>[^\n]*/g,           style: actionParts.join(" ")},
    {match: /(\s|^)["“][^"]+?["”]/g,   style: quoteParts.join(" ")},
    {match: /(^|\n)SUMMARY\^[0-9]+: /g, style: "font-weight:bold;"},
    {match: /^[^:]{1,30}?: /g,           style: "font-weight:bold;"},
    {match: /(^|\n)#+ [^\n]*/g,         style: "font-weight:bold;"},
  ];
  let advanced = buildThemeAdvancedTextRules(s.advancedRules || []);
  if(advanced.length) rules = rules.concat(advanced);
  return rules;

applyTextStyleRulesToEditor() =>
  let rules = getStoryTextStyleRules();
  let applyToEditor = (el) => {
    if(!el) return;
    if(el.setTextStyleRules) el.setTextStyleRules(rules);
    else if(el.updateTextStyleRules) el.updateTextStyleRules(rules);
  };
  if(typeof storySoFarEl !== "undefined") applyToEditor(storySoFarEl);
  if(window.notepadEditorEl) applyToEditor(notepadEditorEl);

applyThemeSettings() =>
  let scheme = getActiveColorScheme();
  let s = getEffectiveThemeSettings(scheme);
  let defaultText = (scheme === "light") ? "black" : "#b7b7b7";
  let defaultBg = (scheme === "light") ? "#ffffff" : "#000000";
  let textColor = s.storyTextColor || defaultText;
  let bgColor = s.storyBackgroundColor || defaultBg;
  let fontValue = parseFontFamilyInput(s.storyFontFamily || "");
  let fontName = extractFontNameFromInput(fontValue);
  if(typeof storySoFarEl !== "undefined") {
    if(fontName) ensureGoogleFontLoaded(fontName);
    storySoFarEl.style.color = textColor;
    storySoFarEl.style.fontFamily = fontName || "";
    storySoFarEl.style.fontSize = "";
    storySoFarEl.style.lineHeight = "";
    storySoFarEl.style.border = "";
  }
  if(window.notepadEditorEl) {
    if(fontName) ensureGoogleFontLoaded(fontName);
    notepadEditorEl.style.color = textColor;
    notepadEditorEl.style.fontFamily = fontName || "";
    notepadEditorEl.style.fontSize = "";
    notepadEditorEl.style.lineHeight = "";
    notepadEditorEl.style.border = "";
  }
  applyTextStyleRulesToEditor();
  updateThemeDependentVars(bgColor, scheme);

updateThemeDependentVars(bgColor, scheme) =>
  let normalBg = bgColor || (scheme === "light" ? "#ffffff" : "#000000");
  let activeBg = addAlphaToColor(normalBg, 0.78);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--normal-textbox-background-color', normalBg);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--background-image-active-textbox-background-color', activeBg);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--background-image-active-box-shadow-color', scheme === "light" ? "#ffffff" : "#000000");

addAlphaToColor(color, alpha) =>
  let hex = color.trim();
  if(/^#([0-9a-f]{3}){1,2}$/i.test(hex)) {
    if(hex.length === 4) hex = "#" + hex[1]+hex[1]+hex[2]+hex[2]+hex[3]+hex[3];
    let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16);
    let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16);
    let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
    return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
  }
  if(/^rgb\(/i.test(color)) return color.replace(/^rgb\(/i, "rgba(").replace(/\)$/, `,${alpha})`);
  if(/^rgba\(/i.test(color)) return color.replace(/,[^,]+\)$/, `,${alpha})`);
  return color;

//////////////////////
// Scene image tray //
//////////////////////
// Images are heavy, so kept images live in a separate blob store (kv.storyImages) and the
// adventure data only holds light references ({id, prompt, createdTime}) - that keeps
// adventure loads/saves/auto-backups fast. A small index ({id, storyId} pairs) lives in
// kv.storiesMeta so cleanup/GC never has to load the actual blobs.

IMAGES_INDEX_KEY = story_images_index_v1

ensureImageTrayState() =>
  if(!window.imageJobQueue) window.imageJobQueue = [];
  if(!window.imageCardsById) window.imageCardsById = new Map();
  if(window.imageCardIdCounter === undefined) window.imageCardIdCounter = 0;
  if(!window.currentKeptImages) window.currentKeptImages = [];

normalizeKeptImagesList(list) =>
  if(!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
  return list.map(item => {
    let out = {
      id: (item?.id ?? "").toString(),
      prompt: (item?.prompt ?? "").toString(),
      createdTime: Number(item?.createdTime || 0),
    };
    if(typeof item?.dataUrl === "string" && item.dataUrl.startsWith("data:")) out.dataUrl = item.dataUrl;
    return out;
  }).filter(i => i.id || i.dataUrl);

async getImagesIndex() =>
  if(Array.isArray(window.cachedImagesIndex)) return window.cachedImagesIndex;
  let idx = null;
  try { idx = await kv.storiesMeta.get(IMAGES_INDEX_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  window.cachedImagesIndex = Array.isArray(idx) ? idx.filter(e => e && e.id) : [];
  return window.cachedImagesIndex;

async saveImagesIndex(index) =>
  window.cachedImagesIndex = index;
  try { await kv.storiesMeta.set(IMAGES_INDEX_KEY, index.map(e => ({id:e.id, storyId:e.storyId}))); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

async addImageToIndex(id, storyId) =>
  let index = await getImagesIndex();
  if(!index.some(e => e.id === id)) index.push({id, storyId});
  await saveImagesIndex(index);

async removeImageFromIndex(id) =>
  let index = await getImagesIndex();
  await saveImagesIndex(index.filter(e => e.id !== id));

generateImageId(storyId) =>
  return `img_${storyId}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`;

async dataUrlToBlob(dataUrl) =>
  return await (await fetch(dataUrl)).blob();

async blobToDataUrl(blob) =>
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
    reader.onerror = reject;
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });

// New image records store the pixels as an ArrayBuffer + mime type rather than a Blob,
// because storing Blobs in IndexedDB still fails in some browsers' private-browsing modes
// (e.g. Safari). Old records that already contain a Blob remain readable via
// getBlobFromImageRecord (back-compat read path).
async makeImageRecord(blob, prompt, createdTime, storyId) =>
  return {bytes: await blob.arrayBuffer(), type: blob.type || "image/png", prompt, createdTime, storyId};

getBlobFromImageRecord(rec) =>
  if(!rec) return null;
  try {
    if(rec.blob instanceof Blob) return rec.blob; // legacy record (pre-ArrayBuffer format)
    if(rec.bytes) return new Blob([rec.bytes], {type: rec.type || "image/png"});
  } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  return null;

// Converts any embedded dataUrl images in imported data into blobs in the blob store (with fresh
// ids owned by `storyId`), and drops refs whose blobs don't exist on this device.
async absorbEmbeddedKeptImages(data, storyId) =>
  let items = normalizeKeptImagesList(data.keptImages);
  let refs = [];
  for(let item of items) {
    try {
      let blob = null;
      if(item.dataUrl) {
        blob = await dataUrlToBlob(item.dataUrl);
      } else if(item.id) {
        let rec = await kv.storyImages.get(item.id);
        blob = getBlobFromImageRecord(rec); // copy to a fresh id so two adventures never share an image (deleting one would break the other)
      }
      if(!blob) continue;
      let id = generateImageId(storyId);
      let createdTime = item.createdTime || Date.now();
      await kv.storyImages.set(id, await makeImageRecord(blob, item.prompt || "", createdTime, storyId));
      await addImageToIndex(id, storyId);
      refs.push({id, prompt:item.prompt || "", createdTime});
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  data.keptImages = refs;
  return data;

async embedKeptImagesAsDataUrls(data) =>
  let items = normalizeKeptImagesList(data.keptImages);
  let out = [];
  for(let ref of items) {
    if(ref.dataUrl) { out.push(ref); continue; }
    try {
      let rec = await kv.storyImages.get(ref.id);
      let blob = getBlobFromImageRecord(rec);
      if(blob) out.push({...ref, dataUrl: await blobToDataUrl(blob)});
      else out.push(ref);
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); out.push(ref); }
  }
  data.keptImages = out;
  return data;

async addKeptImageFilesToZip(writer, zip, storyFolder, data) =>
  for(let ref of (data.keptImages || [])) {
    if(!ref.dataUrl) continue;
    try {
      let imgBlob = await dataUrlToBlob(ref.dataUrl);
      let ext = ((imgBlob.type.split("/")[1] || "png").split("+")[0]) || "png";
      let safeName = (ref.id || `image_${Date.now()}`).toString().replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_");
      await writer.add(`${storyFolder}/images/${safeName}.${ext}`, new zip.BlobReader(imgBlob));
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  }

async deleteImagesForStory(storyId) =>
  let index = await getImagesIndex();
  let mine = index.filter(e => String(e.storyId) === String(storyId));
  if(mine.length === 0) return;
  for(let e of mine) {
    try { await kv.storyImages.delete(e.id); } catch(err) { console.error(err); }
  }
  await saveImagesIndex(index.filter(e => String(e.storyId) !== String(storyId)));

// Cheap orphan sweep: runs well after startup, at most every few days, and only reads the
// light index + in-memory meta (never the blobs themselves) - so it stays fast even with
// thousands of adventures/images.
scheduleImageGcSweep() =>
  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      let last = Number(localStorage.lastImageGcSweepTime || 0);
      if(Date.now() - last < 1000*60*60*24*3) return;
      localStorage.lastImageGcSweepTime = Date.now();
      let index = await getImagesIndex();
      if(index.length === 0) return;
      let validIds = new Set((window.storyManager?.meta || []).map(m => String(m.id)));
      let orphans = index.filter(e => !validIds.has(String(e.storyId)));
      if(orphans.length === 0) return;
      console.log(`Image GC: deleting ${orphans.length} orphaned image(s).`);
      for(let e of orphans) {
        try { await kv.storyImages.delete(e.id); } catch(err) { console.error(err); }
      }
      await saveImagesIndex(index.filter(e => validIds.has(String(e.storyId))));
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  }, 1000*35);

getImageBatchSizeSetting() =>
  let v = parseInt(localStorage.imageBatchSize || "6");
  if(!Number.isFinite(v)) v = 6;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(16, v));

isImageTrayOpen() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return false;
  return !imageTrayEl.hidden && !imageTrayEl.classList.contains("trayClosed");

openImageTray() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  ensureImageTrayState();
  imageTrayEl.hidden = false;
  imageTrayEl.classList.remove("trayClosed");
  document.body.classList.add("imageTrayOpen");
  localStorage.imageTrayOpen = "1";
  let h = parseInt(localStorage.imageTrayHeight || "0");
  if(h) document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--image-tray-height", `${Math.max(120, Math.min(h, Math.round(window.innerHeight*0.9)))}px`);
  try { updateImagePromptModeUi(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  updateImageTrayCompactMode();
  setupImageTrayResizer();
  // only (re)render if the feed isn't already showing this adventure's cards - re-rendering
  // wipes unkept/in-progress images, and the user may have queued a batch, closed the
  // panel to keep playing, and reopened to see the results:
  if(window.imageTrayRenderedForStoryId !== (window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId)) {
    renderImageTrayFeedForCurrentStory();
  }
  try {
    if(!window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches && typeof imageGuidanceEl !== "undefined") imageGuidanceEl.focus({preventScroll:true});
  } catch(e) {}

closeImageTray() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  imageTrayEl.classList.add("trayClosed"); // slides down leaving just the grab tab peeking at the bottom of the screen
  document.body.classList.remove("imageTrayOpen");
  localStorage.imageTrayOpen = "";

toggleImageTray() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  if(!isImageTrayOpen()) openImageTray();
  else closeImageTray();

updateImageTrayCompactMode() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined" || !isImageTrayOpen()) return;
  let h = imageTrayEl.getBoundingClientRect().height || 0;
  imageTrayEl.classList.toggle("compact", h > 0 && h < 190);

setupImageTrayResizer() =>
  if(window.imageTrayResizerSetup) return;
  if(typeof imageTrayGrabTab === "undefined" || typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  window.imageTrayResizerSetup = true;
  let attachTrayDragHandle = (handleEl, tapToggles) => {
    if(!handleEl) return;
    handleEl.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      let startY = e.clientY;
      let startHeight = isImageTrayOpen() ? imageTrayEl.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0;
      let moved = false;
      let prevTransition = imageTrayEl.style.transition;
      try { handleEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err) {}
      function applyHeight(px) {
        px = Math.max(120, Math.min(px, Math.round(window.innerHeight * 0.9)));
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--image-tray-height", `${Math.round(px)}px`);
      }
      function onMove(ev) {
        let dy = startY - ev.clientY; // dragging up = positive
        if(!moved && Math.abs(dy) < 6) return;
        if(!moved) {
          moved = true;
          imageTrayEl.style.transition = "none"; // no slide animation while actively dragging
        }
        if(!isImageTrayOpen()) {
          // dragging up from the closed tab opens the tray at the dragged height:
          if(dy > 24) {
            openImageTray();
            let applied = Math.max(120, dy);
            applyHeight(applied);
            // rebase so further dragging grows/shrinks from the applied height
            // (without this, the next move computes a tiny target and instantly re-closes - flicker)
            startHeight = applied;
            startY = ev.clientY;
          }
          return;
        }
        let target = startHeight + dy;
        if(target < 70) {
          // dragged down past the bottom - close (they can drag back up to reopen)
          closeImageTray();
          startY = ev.clientY;
          startHeight = 0;
          return;
        }
        applyHeight(target);
        updateImageTrayCompactMode();
      }
      function onUp(ev) {
        try { handleEl.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId); } catch(err) {}
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
        imageTrayEl.style.transition = prevTransition;
        if(!moved) {
          if(tapToggles) toggleImageTray(); // simple tap on the tab toggles the tray
          return;
        }
        if(isImageTrayOpen()) localStorage.imageTrayHeight = Math.round(imageTrayEl.getBoundingClientRect().height);
      }
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    });
  };
  attachTrayDragHandle(imageTrayGrabTab, true);
  attachTrayDragHandle(typeof imageTrayDragStrip !== "undefined" ? imageTrayDragStrip : null, false);

createImageCard(opts) =>
  if(!opts) opts = {};
  ensureImageTrayState();
  let cardId = "imgcard_" + (++window.imageCardIdCounter);
  let el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "imageCard";
  el.dataset.cardId = cardId;
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="imageCardMedia"><div class="imageCardStatus"></div></div>
    <div class="imageCardBtns">
      <button class="imgDelBtn" title="Delete this image">🗑️</button>
      <button class="imgKeepBtn" title="Keep - saves the image with this adventure">📌<span class="imageBtnLabel"> keep</span></button>
      <button class="imgRegenBtn" title="Regenerate with the same prompt">🔁</button>
      <button class="imgPromptBtn" title="View/copy/edit the image prompt">📝</button>
    </div>
  `;
  let card = {
    cardId, el,
    prompt: opts.prompt || "",
    kept: !!opts.kept,
    imageId: opts.imageId || null,
    dataUrl: null,
    objectUrl: null,
    busy: false,
  };
  card.mediaEl = el.querySelector(".imageCardMedia");
  card.statusEl = el.querySelector(".imageCardStatus");
  card.delBtn = el.querySelector(".imgDelBtn");
  card.keepBtn = el.querySelector(".imgKeepBtn");
  card.regenBtn = el.querySelector(".imgRegenBtn");
  card.promptBtn = el.querySelector(".imgPromptBtn");
  card.setStatus = (text) => { if(card.statusEl) card.statusEl.textContent = text; };
  card.showImage = (src) => {
    if(typeof src === "string" && src.startsWith("data:")) card.dataUrl = src;
    card.mediaEl.innerHTML = "";
    let img = document.createElement("img");
    img.src = src;
    img.addEventListener("click", () => showImageLightbox(cardId));
    card.mediaEl.appendChild(img);
    card.statusEl = null;
    updateImageCardButtons(card);
  };
  card.setError = (msg) => {
    card.mediaEl.innerHTML = "";
    let div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "imageCardStatus";
    div.textContent = "❌ " + String(msg || "failed").slice(0, 140);
    card.mediaEl.appendChild(div);
    card.statusEl = div;
    updateImageCardButtons(card);
  };
  card.delBtn.onclick = () => deleteImageCard(cardId);
  card.keepBtn.onclick = () => keepImageCard(cardId);
  card.regenBtn.onclick = () => regenImageCard(cardId);
  card.promptBtn.onclick = () => showImagePromptEditor(cardId);
  card.setStatus(opts.statusText || "⏳ queued...");
  updateImageCardButtons(card);
  window.imageCardsById.set(cardId, card);
  return card;

updateImageCardButtons(card) =>
  let hasImage = !!card.mediaEl.querySelector("img");
  if(card.kept) card.keepBtn.innerHTML = `📌<span class="imageBtnLabel"> kept</span>`;
  card.keepBtn.disabled = card.kept || card.busy || !hasImage || !card.dataUrl;
  card.regenBtn.disabled = card.busy || !card.prompt;
  card.delBtn.disabled = card.busy;
  card.promptBtn.disabled = !card.prompt;

insertImageCardIntoFeed(card, beforeEl) =>
  if(typeof imageFeedEl === "undefined") return;
  imageFeedEl.insertBefore(card.el, beforeEl || imageFeedEl.firstChild);

removeImageCard(card) =>
  if(!card) return;
  if(card.objectUrl) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(card.objectUrl); } catch(e) {} card.objectUrl = null; }
  try { card.el.remove(); } catch(e) {}
  try { window.imageCardsById.delete(card.cardId); } catch(e) {}

pruneUnkeptImageCards() =>
  if(typeof imageFeedEl === "undefined") return;
  ensureImageTrayState();
  const MAX_UNKEPT = 24;
  let unkeptEls = [...imageFeedEl.children].filter(el => {
    let c = window.imageCardsById.get(el.dataset.cardId);
    return c && !c.kept && !c.busy;
  });
  while(unkeptEls.length > MAX_UNKEPT) {
    let el = unkeptEls.pop(); // oldest are at the right
    removeImageCard(window.imageCardsById.get(el.dataset.cardId));
  }

async deleteImageCard(cardId) =>
  let card = window.imageCardsById?.get(cardId);
  if(!card || card.busy) return;
  if(card.kept) {
    if(!confirm("Delete this kept image? It will be removed from this adventure.")) return;
    await unkeepImageRecord(card);
  }
  removeImageCard(card);

async unkeepImageRecord(card) =>
  let id = card.imageId;
  card.imageId = null;
  card.kept = false;
  if(!id) return;
  try { await kv.storyImages.delete(id); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  try { await removeImageFromIndex(id); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  ensureImageTrayState();
  window.currentKeptImages = (window.currentKeptImages || []).filter(r => r.id !== id);
  requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});

async keepImageCard(cardId) =>
  let card = window.imageCardsById?.get(cardId);
  if(!card || card.kept || card.busy || !card.dataUrl) return;
  let storyId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
  if(storyId === null || storyId === undefined) return;
  card.keepBtn.disabled = true;
  card.keepBtn.innerHTML = `⏳<span class="imageBtnLabel"> keeping</span>`;
  try {
    let blob = await dataUrlToBlob(card.dataUrl);
    let id = generateImageId(storyId);
    let createdTime = Date.now();
    await kv.storyImages.set(id, await makeImageRecord(blob, card.prompt, createdTime, storyId));
    await addImageToIndex(id, storyId);
    ensureImageTrayState();
    window.currentKeptImages.push({id, prompt: card.prompt, createdTime});
    requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:300});
    card.kept = true;
    card.imageId = id;
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
    alert("Failed to save image: " + (e?.message || e));
    card.keepBtn.innerHTML = `📌<span class="imageBtnLabel"> keep</span>`;
  }
  updateImageCardButtons(card);

async regenImageCard(cardId) =>
  let card = window.imageCardsById?.get(cardId);
  if(!card || card.busy || !card.prompt) return;
  if(card.kept) {
    if(!confirm("Regenerate this kept image? The current kept image will be removed from this adventure (the replacement won't be kept unless you keep it).")) return;
    await unkeepImageRecord(card);
    card.keepBtn.innerHTML = `📌<span class="imageBtnLabel"> keep</span>`;
  }
  await runGenerateForCard(card);

async runGenerateForCard(card) =>
  card.busy = true;
  card.dataUrl = null;
  if(card.objectUrl) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(card.objectUrl); } catch(e) {} card.objectUrl = null; }
  card.mediaEl.innerHTML = "";
  let statusDiv = document.createElement("div");
  statusDiv.className = "imageCardStatus";
  statusDiv.textContent = "⏳ generating image...";
  card.mediaEl.appendChild(statusDiv);
  card.statusEl = statusDiv;
  updateImageCardButtons(card);
  try {
    let result = await generateImage({prompt: card.prompt, resolution: "768x768"});
    let dataUrl = (typeof result === "string") ? result : (result?.dataUrl || result?.url || result?.src || "");
    card.busy = false;
    if(!card.el.isConnected) return; // adventure was switched away while generating - discard the result
    if(!dataUrl) throw new Error("no image returned");
    card.showImage(dataUrl);
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
    card.busy = false;
    if(card.el.isConnected) card.setError(e?.message || e);
  }
  updateImageCardButtons(card);

getImagePromptMode() =>
  let v = (typeof imagePromptModeEl !== "undefined" ? imagePromptModeEl.value : "") || localStorage.imagePromptMode || "auto";
  return (v === "manual" || v === "recent") ? v : "auto";

updateImagePromptModeUi() =>
  if(typeof imageGuidanceEl === "undefined") return;
  let mode = getImagePromptMode();
  if(typeof imagePromptModeEl !== "undefined" && imagePromptModeEl.value !== mode) imagePromptModeEl.value = mode;
  if(mode === "manual") imageGuidanceEl.placeholder = "describe the image...";
  else if(mode === "recent") imageGuidanceEl.placeholder = "(optional) prompt prefix - style, focus, etc.";
  else imageGuidanceEl.placeholder = "(optional) style / what to focus on";

buildRecentStoryImagePrompt() =>
  let paras = ((typeof storySoFarEl !== "undefined" ? storySoFarEl.value : "") || "").trim().split(/\n{2,}/).map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p && !p.startsWith("SUMMARY^"));
  let text = paras.slice(-4).join("\n\n"); // up to the last 4 paragraphs
  if(text.length > 1500) text = text.slice(-1500); // over the cap: trim from the start (keep the most recent text)
  return text;

startImageBatch() =>
  ensureImageTrayState();
  let batchSize = getImageBatchSizeSetting();
  if(typeof imageBatchSizeEl !== "undefined") {
    let v = parseInt(imageBatchSizeEl.value);
    if(Number.isFinite(v)) {
      batchSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, v));
      imageBatchSizeEl.value = batchSize;
      localStorage.imageBatchSize = batchSize;
    }
  }
  let guidance = ((typeof imageGuidanceEl !== "undefined" ? imageGuidanceEl.value : "") || "").trim();
  let storyId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
  let mode = getImagePromptMode();

  if(mode === "manual" || mode === "recent") {
    // no LLM request needed in these modes - the images generate immediately (in parallel):
    let prompt = "";
    if(mode === "manual") {
      if(!guidance) {
        alert("Manual prompt mode: please describe the image in the text box first.");
        try { imageGuidanceEl.focus(); } catch(e) {}
        return;
      }
      prompt = guidance;
    } else {
      let recentText = buildRecentStoryImagePrompt();
      if(!recentText && !guidance) {
        alert("There's no story text to use yet - generate/write some first, or add a prompt prefix.");
        return;
      }
      prompt = guidance ? `${guidance}\n${recentText}` : recentText;
    }
    let cards = [];
    for(let i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
      cards.push(createImageCard({prompt, statusText: "⏳ generating image..."}));
    }
    for(let i = cards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) insertImageCardIntoFeed(cards[i]); // reverse order so cards[0] ends up leftmost
    Promise.all(cards.map(c => runGenerateForCard(c))).then(() => {
      try { pruneUnkeptImageCards(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    });
    return;
  }

  // "auto" mode: an LLM writes the prompt - queued so story generation is never starved.
  // show the full batch as placeholder cards right away:
  let cards = [];
  for(let i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
    cards.push(createImageCard({statusText: "⏳ queued..."}));
  }
  for(let i = cards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) insertImageCardIntoFeed(cards[i]); // reverse order so cards[0] ends up leftmost
  window.imageJobQueue.push({type:"batch", storyId, guidance, batchSize, cards});
  runImageQueue();

// Only ONE image-prompt-writing LLM request runs at a time (and it waits for any in-progress
// story generation) so that clicking "generate" repeatedly can never starve story writing.
// The image generations themselves (no LLM involved) all run in parallel per batch.
async runImageQueue() =>
  ensureImageTrayState();
  if(window.imageQueueRunning) return;
  window.imageQueueRunning = true;
  try {
    while(window.imageJobQueue.length > 0) {
      let job = window.imageJobQueue.shift();
      let liveCards = job.cards.filter(c => c.el.isConnected);
      let currentId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
      if(job.storyId !== currentId || liveCards.length === 0) {
        job.cards.forEach(c => removeImageCard(c));
        continue;
      }
      while(window.currentlyGenerating) {
        for(let c of liveCards) { if(c.el.isConnected) c.setStatus("⏳ waiting for the story to finish generating..."); }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));
      }
      liveCards = job.cards.filter(c => c.el.isConnected);
      if(liveCards.length === 0) continue; // all deleted/switched away while waiting
      for(let c of liveCards) c.setStatus("⏳ writing image prompt...");
      let prompt = "";
      try { prompt = await generateImagePromptText(job.guidance); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
      currentId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
      if(job.storyId !== currentId) {
        job.cards.forEach(c => removeImageCard(c));
        continue;
      }
      liveCards = job.cards.filter(c => c.el.isConnected);
      if(liveCards.length === 0) continue;
      if(!prompt) {
        // collapse the batch into a single error card:
        for(let c of liveCards.slice(1)) removeImageCard(c);
        liveCards[0].setError("failed to write the image prompt - try again");
        continue;
      }
      // the placeholder cards become the image cards, all generating in parallel:
      for(let c of liveCards) {
        c.prompt = prompt;
        updateImageCardButtons(c);
      }
      Promise.all(liveCards.map(c => runGenerateForCard(c))).then(() => {
        try { pruneUnkeptImageCards(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
      });
    }
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
  } finally {
    window.imageQueueRunning = false;
  }

async generateImagePromptText(guidance) =>
  window.processedStorySoFarText = getPreprocessedStoryText();
  let taskLines = [];
  taskLines.push(`TASK: Write a single image-generation prompt that depicts the current scene (i.e. the most recent events) of the adventure above. Make the prompt fully self-contained: an artist who has never read the adventure must be able to paint the scene from your prompt alone, so explicitly describe the concrete visual appearance of every character/creature in the scene (age, build, hair, skin, clothing/armor, expression, pose) and the environment (location, key objects, lighting, time of day, weather, mood, camera framing/angle). Refer to characters via their visual descriptions. Write the prompt as a single paragraph, and respond with only the prompt text.`);
  if((guidance || "").trim()) taskLines.push(`IMPORTANT: Follow this instruction from the player regarding the image: ${guidance.trim()}`);
  let instruction = sharedInstructionPrefix.evaluateItem + "\n" + taskLines.join("\n") + "\n</instructions>";
  let result = await ai({
    instruction,
    startWith: "Image prompt:",
    stopSequences: ["\n\n"],
  });
  if(result.stopReason === "error") return "";
  return (result.generatedText || "").trim().replace(/^["']+|["']+$/g, "").trim();
