  ```
updateImageTrayForCurrentStory() =>
  if(typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  ensureImageTrayState();
  if(isImageTrayOpen()) {
    renderImageTrayFeedForCurrentStory();
  } else {
    // tray closed: still discard queued jobs + stale cards so nothing leaks across adventures
    let currentId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
    window.imageJobQueue = window.imageJobQueue.filter(job => {
      if(job.storyId === currentId) return true;
      (job.cards || []).forEach(c => removeImageCard(c));
      return false;
    });
    for(let card of [...window.imageCardsById.values()]) removeImageCard(card);
    if(typeof imageFeedEl !== "undefined") imageFeedEl.innerHTML = "";
    window.imageTrayRenderedForStoryId = undefined;
  }

async renderImageTrayFeedForCurrentStory() =>
  if(typeof imageFeedEl === "undefined" || typeof imageTrayEl === "undefined") return;
  ensureImageTrayState();
  let currentId = window.currentStoryId ?? window.storyManager?.currentId;
  // discard queued jobs that belong to other adventures:
  window.imageJobQueue = window.imageJobQueue.filter(job => {
    if(job.storyId === currentId) return true;
    (job.cards || []).forEach(c => removeImageCard(c));
    return false;
  });
  window.imageTrayRenderedForStoryId = undefined;
  for(let card of [...window.imageCardsById.values()]) removeImageCard(card);
  imageFeedEl.innerHTML = "";
  try { window.imageLazyLoadObserver?.disconnect(); } catch(e) {}
  window.imageLazyLoadObserver = null;
  if(!isImageTrayOpen()) return;
  window.imageTrayRenderedForStoryId = currentId;
  // show this adventure's kept images, newest first/leftmost. Only the first chunk loads its
  // blob eagerly - the rest are placeholder cards that load as they're scrolled into view,
  // so even a collection of hundreds/thousands of kept images renders instantly:
  const EAGER_COUNT = 24;
  let refs = normalizeKeptImagesList(window.currentKeptImages || []).filter(r => r.id).sort((a,b) => (b.createdTime||0) - (a.createdTime||0)); // newest first
  if(refs.length === 0) return;
  window.imageTrayRenderToken = (window.imageTrayRenderToken || 0) + 1;
  let lazyObserver = null;
  if(refs.length > EAGER_COUNT) {
    lazyObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for(let entry of entries) {
        if(!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
        lazyObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        let c = window.imageCardsById.get(entry.target.dataset.cardId);
        if(c && c.imageId && !c.mediaEl.querySelector("img")) loadKeptImageIntoCard(c);
      }
    }, {root: imageFeedEl, rootMargin: "0px 600px 0px 600px"});
    window.imageLazyLoadObserver = lazyObserver;
  }
  let i = 0;
  for(let ref of refs) {
    let card = createImageCard({prompt: ref.prompt || "", kept:true, imageId: ref.id, statusText:"🖼️"});
    imageFeedEl.appendChild(card.el); // newest-first order, appended left to right
    if(i < EAGER_COUNT || !lazyObserver) {
      loadKeptImageIntoCard(card); // async, in parallel
    } else {
      lazyObserver.observe(card.el);
    }
    i++;
  }

async loadKeptImageIntoCard(card) =>
  if(!card || !card.imageId) return;
  let rec = null;
  try { rec = await kv.storyImages.get(card.imageId); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  if(!card.el.isConnected) return; // adventure switched / feed re-rendered meanwhile
  let blob = getBlobFromImageRecord(rec);
  if(!blob) { card.setError("image missing from storage"); return; }
  if(!card.prompt && rec.prompt) card.prompt = rec.prompt;
  card.objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  card.showImage(card.objectUrl);

showImagePromptEditor(cardId) =>
  let card = window.imageCardsById?.get(cardId);
  if(!card || !card.prompt) return;
  let overlay = document.createElement("div");
  overlay.className = "imageOverlayModal";
  overlay.style.cssText = "position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9999998; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);";
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div style="background:var(--box-color); border:1px solid var(--box-border-color); border-radius:3px; padding:0.75rem; width:min(92vw, 520px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.5rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Image prompt</div>
      <div style="font-size:78%; opacity:0.7;">You can edit this prompt and tap regenerate.</div>
      <textarea style="width:100%; min-height:9rem; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box; font-size:85%;"></textarea>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:0.35rem; justify-content:flex-end; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button class="imgPromptCopyBtn">📋 copy</button>
        <button class="imgPromptRegenBtn" title="Regenerate the image using the prompt above">🔁 regenerate</button>
        <button class="imgPromptCloseBtn">✕ close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  let ta = overlay.querySelector("textarea");
  ta.value = card.prompt;
  overlay.querySelector(".imgPromptCopyBtn").onclick = async (e) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(ta.value);
      e.target.textContent = "✅ copied";
      setTimeout(() => { try { e.target.textContent = "📋 copy"; } catch(err) {} }, 1500);
    } catch(err) { console.error(err); alert("Failed to copy."); }
  };
  overlay.querySelector(".imgPromptRegenBtn").onclick = () => {
    card.prompt = ta.value.trim() || card.prompt;
    overlay.remove();
    regenImageCard(cardId);
  };
  overlay.querySelector(".imgPromptCloseBtn").onclick = () => {
    card.prompt = ta.value.trim() || card.prompt;
    updateImageCardButtons(card);
    overlay.remove();
  };
  overlay.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if(e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); overlay.remove(); }
  });
  overlay.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if(e.target === overlay) e.preventDefault(); });
  overlay.addEventListener("click", e => { if(e.target === overlay) overlay.remove(); });
  document.body.append(overlay);

showImageLightbox(cardId) =>
  let startCard = window.imageCardsById?.get(cardId);
  if(!startCard) return;
  let getImageCards = () => [...(typeof imageFeedEl !== "undefined" ? imageFeedEl.children : [])]
    .map(el => window.imageCardsById?.get(el.dataset.cardId))
    .filter(c => c && c.mediaEl.querySelector("img"));
  let overlay = document.createElement("div");
  overlay.className = "imageOverlayModal";
  overlay.tabIndex = 0;
  overlay.style.cssText = "position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9999997; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); outline:none;";
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; max-width:95vw;">
      <div class="lbViewport" style="position:relative; overflow:hidden; width:min(95vw, calc(95vh - 3rem), 450px); height:min(95vw, calc(95vh - 3rem), 450px); border-radius:3px;">
        <img class="lbImgPrev" style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
        <img class="lbImgNext" style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
        <img class="lbImgCur" style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;">
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:0.3rem; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center;">
        <button class="lbPrevBtn" title="Previous (left arrow key)">⬅️</button>
        <button class="lbDelBtn" title="Delete this image">🗑️</button>
        <button class="lbKeepBtn" title="Keep - saves the image with this adventure">📌 keep</button>
        <button class="lbRegenBtn" title="Regenerate with the same prompt">🔁</button>
        <button class="lbPromptBtn" title="View/copy/edit the image prompt">📝</button>
        <button class="lbCloseBtn" title="Close (Esc)">✕</button>
        <button class="lbNextBtn" title="Next (right arrow key)">➡️</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  let viewport = overlay.querySelector(".lbViewport");
  let curImg = overlay.querySelector(".lbImgCur");
  let prevImg = overlay.querySelector(".lbImgPrev");
  let nextImg = overlay.querySelector(".lbImgNext");
  let keepBtn = overlay.querySelector(".lbKeepBtn");
  let regenBtn = overlay.querySelector(".lbRegenBtn");
  let promptBtn = overlay.querySelector(".lbPromptBtn");
  let currentCardId = cardId;
  let currentCard = () => window.imageCardsById?.get(currentCardId);
  let animToken = 0;
  function close() { overlay.remove(); }
  function cardSrc(c) {
    let im = c && c.el.isConnected ? c.mediaEl.querySelector("img") : null;
    return im ? im.src : "";
  }
  function neighbors() {
    let cards = getImageCards();
    let idx = cards.findIndex(c => c.cardId === currentCardId);
    if(idx === -1) idx = 0;
    let n = cards.length;
    return {
      cards, idx,
      prev: n > 1 ? cards[(idx - 1 + n) % n] : null,
      next: n > 1 ? cards[(idx + 1) % n] : null,
    };
  }
  // prev/current/next are mounted side-by-side (a filmstrip); `px` shifts the whole strip,
  // so the neighbor image slides along in lockstep with the finger during a swipe:
  function setOffset(px, animate) {
    let W = viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320;
    let strip = [[prevImg, -1], [curImg, 0], [nextImg, 1]];
    for(let [el, base] of strip) {
      el.style.transition = animate ? "transform 150ms ease-out" : "none";
      el.style.transform = `translateX(${px + base*W}px)`;
    }
  }
  function refresh() {
    animToken++;
    let c = currentCard();
    if(!c || !c.el.isConnected || !cardSrc(c)) { close(); return; }
    let nb = neighbors();
    curImg.src = cardSrc(c);
    prevImg.src = nb.prev ? cardSrc(nb.prev) : "";
    prevImg.style.visibility = nb.prev ? "visible" : "hidden";
    nextImg.src = nb.next ? cardSrc(nb.next) : "";
    nextImg.style.visibility = nb.next ? "visible" : "hidden";
    setOffset(0, false);
    keepBtn.textContent = c.kept ? "📌 kept" : "📌 keep";
    keepBtn.disabled = c.kept || c.busy || !c.dataUrl;
    regenBtn.disabled = c.busy || !c.prompt;
    promptBtn.disabled = !c.prompt;
  }
  function nav(dir) { // instant switch (buttons / arrow keys)
    let nb = neighbors();
    if(nb.cards.length === 0) { close(); return; }
    let target = dir > 0 ? nb.next : nb.prev;
    if(!target) { refresh(); return; }
    currentCardId = target.cardId;
    refresh();
  }
  function slideTo(dir) { // animated completion of a swipe
    let nb = neighbors();
    let target = dir > 0 ? nb.next : nb.prev;
    if(!target) { setOffset(0, true); return; }
    let W = viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320;
    let token = ++animToken;
    setOffset(dir > 0 ? -W : W, true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(token !== animToken) return; // superseded by another action
      currentCardId = target.cardId;
      refresh(); // the new current is exactly where the strip already sits, so this is seamless
    }, 160);
  }
  overlay.querySelector(".lbPrevBtn").onclick = () => nav(-1);
  overlay.querySelector(".lbNextBtn").onclick = () => nav(1);
  try {
    if(window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) {
      // on touchscreens, swiping covers navigation - fewer buttons is better:
      overlay.querySelector(".lbPrevBtn").hidden = true;
      overlay.querySelector(".lbNextBtn").hidden = true;
    }
  } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  overlay.querySelector(".lbCloseBtn").onclick = close;
  overlay.querySelector(".lbDelBtn").onclick = async () => {
    let cards = getImageCards();
    let idx = cards.findIndex(c => c.cardId === currentCardId);
    await deleteImageCard(currentCardId);
    if(window.imageCardsById?.get(currentCardId)) { refresh(); return; } // they cancelled the confirm
    let remaining = getImageCards();
    if(remaining.length === 0) { close(); return; }
    currentCardId = remaining[Math.min(Math.max(idx, 0), remaining.length - 1)].cardId;
    refresh();
  };
  keepBtn.onclick = async () => {
    keepBtn.disabled = true;
    keepBtn.textContent = "⏳ keeping";
    await keepImageCard(currentCardId);
    refresh();
  };
  regenBtn.onclick = () => {
    close(); // the regen progress is visible in the tray
    regenImageCard(currentCardId);
  };
  promptBtn.onclick = () => {
    close();
    showImagePromptEditor(currentCardId);
  };
  overlay.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if(e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); nav(-1); }
    else if(e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); nav(1); }
    else if(e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(); }
  });
  // touch swipe left/right navigates - the neighbor slides along with the finger:
  let swipe = null;
  viewport.style.touchAction = "pan-y"; // vertical gestures stay native; horizontal movement is ours
  overlay.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(im => im.addEventListener("dragstart", e => e.preventDefault()));
  viewport.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    if(e.pointerType === "mouse") return; // mouse users have the buttons/arrow keys
    if(swipe) return; // ignore extra fingers
    swipe = {id: e.pointerId, startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, active: false};
    try { viewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err) {}
  });
  viewport.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if(!swipe || e.pointerId !== swipe.id) return;
    let dx = e.clientX - swipe.startX;
    let dy = e.clientY - swipe.startY;
    if(!swipe.active) {
      if(Math.abs(dx) < 8) return;
      if(Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) { swipe = null; return; } // mostly vertical - not a swipe
      swipe.active = true;
    }
    if(getImageCards().length < 2) dx = dx * 0.3; // rubber-band when there's nothing to swipe to
    setOffset(dx, false);
  });
  let endSwipe = (e) => {
    if(!swipe || e.pointerId !== swipe.id) return;
    let dx = e.clientX - swipe.startX;
    let wasActive = swipe.active;
    swipe = null;
    try { viewport.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err) {}
    if(!wasActive) return;
    let W = viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320;
    let threshold = Math.min(70, W * 0.2);
    if(Math.abs(dx) > threshold && getImageCards().length > 1) {
      slideTo(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1); // swipe left = next
    } else {
      setOffset(0, true); // not far enough - snap back
    }
  };
  viewport.addEventListener("pointerup", endSwipe);
  viewport.addEventListener("pointercancel", endSwipe);
  // close on *click* (not pointerdown): the overlay must still exist when the finger releases,
  // otherwise the tap falls through to whatever is underneath (feed images re-opening the
  // lightbox, or the guidance textarea popping the mobile keyboard)
  overlay.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if(e.target === overlay) e.preventDefault(); });
  overlay.addEventListener("click", e => { if(e.target === overlay) close(); });
  document.body.append(overlay);
  refresh();
  overlay.focus({preventScroll:true});
````

```html
  window.currentBackgroundMusic = window.currentBackgroundMusic || "";
  window.currentBackgroundVisual = window.currentBackgroundVisual || "";
  window.hideDefaultMusic = !!window.hideDefaultMusic;
  window.hideDefaultBackgrounds = !!window.hideDefaultBackgrounds;
  window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme = window.currentStoryThemeSettingsByScheme || null;
  window.themeSettingsByScheme = window.themeSettingsByScheme || null;
  window.themeAdvancedVisible = !!window.themeAdvancedVisible;
  window.themeAdvancedReady = !!window.themeAdvancedReady;
  window.currentStoryNotebookData = window.currentStoryNotebookData || normalizeNotebookData(null);
  window.appNotebookData = window.appNotebookData || normalizeNotebookData(null);
  window.notepadScope = (window.notepadScope === "app") ? "app" : "story";
  try {
    let savedNotepadWidth = Number(localStorage.notepadWidth || 0);
    if(savedNotepadWidth) document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--notepad-width", `${Math.round(savedNotepadWidth)}px`);
  } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

  let alreadyResolvedUserActivation = false;
  let userActivationResolver;
  window.userActivationPromise = new Promise(r => userActivationResolver = r);
  window.addEventListener("click", function() {
    if(!alreadyResolvedUserActivation) {
      alreadyResolvedUserActivation = true;
      userActivationResolver();
    }
  });

  themeSettingsDefault = {
    storyTextColor:"",
    storyBackgroundColor:"",
    storyFontFamily:"",
    italicColor:"",
    italicItalic:true,
    quoteColor:"",
    quoteItalic:true,
    actionColor:"",
    actionItalic:true,
    advancedRules:[],
  };
</script>

<div id="topStuffEl">
  <h1 hidden style="margin-top:1rem; font-size:140%;">[pageTitle]</h1>

  <p id="subtitleEl" style="font-size:85%; opacity:0.8; padding:0 0.5rem;">Add some keywords or ideas below, then click the button to begin.</p>

</div>
<script>
  if(localStorage.generateCount && Number(localStorage.generateCount) > 5) {
    subtitleEl.style.display = "none";
  }
</script>

<script>
  (async function() {
    window.massiveWordList = await fetch("https://user.uploads.dev/file/fdd83a6f7348fec983cb2583936beaf5.txt").then(r => r.text()).then(t => t.split("\n")).catch(e => null);
    window.massiveStoryTagsList = await fetch("https://user.uploads.dev/file/f81d2b202b03da473014d0f2db351931.txt").then(r => r.text()).then(t => t.split("\n")).catch(e => null);
  })();
</script>


<div id="shareIntroCtn" class="settingsModule" hidden style="width:100%; max-width:700px; box-sizing:border-box; margin:0.5rem auto 0; text-align:left; padding:0.4rem 0.6rem;"></div>

<!-- ADVENTURES DRAWER (overlay side panel) -->
<div id="storiesDrawerOverlay" onpointerdown="closeStoriesPanel()" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="storiesDrawer" role="dialog" aria-label="Adventures">
  <div class="storiesDrawerHeader">
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem;">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">📚 Adventures</div>
      <button onclick="createNewStory()" title="New adventure" style="font-size:80%;">➕ New</button>
    </div>
    <button onclick="closeStoriesPanel()" title="Close" style="font-size:90%;">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="storiesDrawerSearch">
    <input id="storiesSearchInputEl" type="search" placeholder="Search adventures..." oninput="setStoriesSearchQuery(this.value)" style="width:100%; font-size:80%; padding:0.35rem;">
    <button id="storiesSearchClearBtn" onclick="clearStoriesSearch()" title="Clear search" style="font-size:80%;" hidden>✕</button>
  </div>
  <div id="storiesListCtn" class="storiesListCtn"></div>
  <div class="storiesDrawerFooter">
    <div id="storiesFooterNotices" style="font-size:75%; opacity:0.8;"></div>
    <div class="storiesDrawerFooterActions">
      <button onclick="openExportModal()" title="Export your adventures">💾 export</button>
      <button onclick="importStoriesFromUser()" title="Import adventures">📁 import</button>
      <button onclick="deleteAllStoriesData()" title="Delete all data">🗑️</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="storyMenuEl" class="storyMenuEl" hidden></div>

<div id="notepadPanel" hidden>
  <div id="notepadResizeHandle" title="Resize"></div>
  <div class="notepadHeader">
    <button id="closeNotepadBtn" onclick="closeNotepadPanel()" title="Close">✕</button>
    <select id="notepadScopeSelectEl" onchange="setNotepadScope(this.value)">
      <option value="story" selected>this adventure's notebook</option>
      <option value="app">general notebook</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="notepadTabsRow">
    <select id="notepadTabsSelectEl" onchange="onNotepadTabsSelectChange(this.value)"></select>
    <button id="notepadTabsMenuBtn" onclick="toggleNotepadTabMenu()" title="Tab options">⚙️</button>
  </div>
  <div id="notepadEditorCtn"></div>
  <div id="notepadTabMenu" class="notepadTabMenu" hidden>
    <button onclick="renameActiveNotepadTab()">🏷️ rename page</button>
    <hr class="storyToolsDivider">
    <button onclick="deleteActiveNotepadTab()">🗑️ delete page</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="notepadOverlay" hidden></div>

<div id="exportModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Export adventures</div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeExportModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div id="exportFormSection">
      <label style="display:block; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
        <select id="exportFormatSelectEl" style="width:100%; margin-top:0.25rem;">
          <option value="native" selected>📦 default format</option>
          <option value="folders">📁 zip of folders</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label style="display:block; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
        <select id="exportDeliverySelectEl" style="width:100%; margin-top:0.25rem;">
          <option value="download" selected>⬇️ download to your device</option>
          <option value="temp">🔗 save to temporary URL (3 days)</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label style="display:block; margin-top:0.35rem; display:flex; align-items:center;"><input id="exportEncryptCheckboxEl" type="checkbox" onchange="setExportPasswordVisibility(this.checked)" style="margin-right:3px;"> 🔒 encrypt <span style="margin-left:0.5rem; opacity:0.6; font-size:70%;">(recommended for URL export)</span></label>
      <input id="exportEncryptPasswordEl" hidden placeholder="password" type="text" style="width:100%; margin-top:0.35rem;">
      <input id="exportEncryptPasswordConfirmEl" hidden placeholder="confirm password" type="text" style="width:100%; margin-top:0.35rem;">
      <div class="modalActions" style="margin-top:0.35rem;">
        <button onclick="closeExportModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button id="exportRunBtn" onclick="runExportFromModal()">💾 export</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="exportResultSection" hidden>
      <div class="modalSection">
        <div class="modalSectionTitle">Temporary URL</div>
        <div class="modalRow exportUrlRow">
          <input id="exportTempUrlInputEl" readonly placeholder="temporary URL will appear here" style="width:100%;">
          <button id="exportTempUrlCopyBtn" onclick="copyExportTempUrl()" title="Copy">📋</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modalActions">
        <button onclick="closeExportModal()">Done</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="shareModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox" style="max-width:min(95vw, 560px);">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Share adventure</div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeShareModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div id="shareFormSection">
      <div class="modalSection">
        <div class="modalSectionTitle">Include</div>
        <label class="modalField" style="font-size:85%;"><input id="shareIncludeNotesEl" type="checkbox" checked style="margin-right:6px;"> include this adventure's notebook</label>
        <label class="modalField" style="font-size:85%;"><input id="shareIncludeImagesEl" type="checkbox" style="margin-right:6px;"> include kept images <span style="opacity:0.6; font-size:80%;">(can make the link data large)</span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="modalSection">
        <div class="modalSectionTitle">Intro message</div>
        <textarea id="shareIntroMessageEl" placeholder="Optional note for players (AI cannot see this)" style="width:100%; min-height:4rem; resize:vertical;"></textarea>
      </div>
      <div class="modalActions">
        <button onclick="closeShareModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button id="shareGenerateBtn" onclick="runShareFromModal()">🔗 generate link</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="shareResultSection" class="modalSection" hidden>
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Share link</div>
      <div class="modalRow exportUrlRow">
        <input id="shareStoryLinkInputEl" readonly placeholder="Share link will appear here" style="width:100%;">
        <button id="shareLinkCopyBtn" onclick="copyShareLink()" title="Copy">📋</button>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:70%; opacity:0.7; margin-top:0.25rem;">(this link contains a snapshot of the adventure data at the time the link was generated)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="importModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox" style="max-width:min(95vw, 560px);">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Import adventures</div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeImportModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">From file</div>
      <div class="modalRow">
        <button onclick="triggerImportFilePicker()">📁 choose file</button>
        <div id="importDropZone" class="importDropZone">Drag &amp; drop file here</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">From URL</div>
      <div class="modalRow importUrlRow">
        <input id="importUrlInputEl" placeholder="https://perchance.org/...#data=... or https://user.uploads.dev/file/..." style="width:100%;">
        <button onclick="importStoriesFromUrl()">⬇️ load</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="musicModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox" style="max-width:min(95vw, 600px);">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Add custom music</div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeMusicModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection" style="padding-top:0.5rem;">
      <div class="modalRow mediaInputRow">
        <input id="newMusicTitleEl" class="mediaTitleInput" placeholder="Title">
        <div class="mediaUrlRow">
          <input id="newMusicUrlEl" class="mediaUrlInput" placeholder="https://user.uploads.dev/file/song.mp3">
          <button id="uploadMusicBtn" class="mediaUploadBtn" onclick="uploadCustomMusicFile()" title="Upload music">📁</button>
          <button onclick="addCustomMusic()">➕ Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modalRow" style="justify-content:space-between;">
        <div style="font-size:70%; opacity:0.6;">(YouTube URLs work too, but play via an embedded player)</div>
        <label id="hideDefaultMusicRow" style="font-size:80%; opacity:0.8; display:flex; margin-top:3px;" hidden><input id="hideDefaultMusicCheckboxEl" type="checkbox" onchange="toggleHideDefaultMusic(this.checked)" style="margin-right:3px;"> hide default music</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="customMusicListSection" class="modalSection">
      <div id="customMusicListEl"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="backgroundModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox" style="max-width:min(95vw, 600px);">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div style="font-weight:bold;">Add custom background</div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeBackgroundModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection" style="padding-top:0.5rem;">
      <div class="modalRow mediaInputRow">
        <input id="newBackgroundTitleEl" class="mediaTitleInput" placeholder="Title">
        <div class="mediaUrlRow">
          <input id="newBackgroundUrlEl" class="mediaUrlInput" placeholder="https://user.uploads.dev/file/scene.mp4">
          <button id="uploadBackgroundBtn" class="mediaUploadBtn" onclick="uploadCustomBackgroundFile()" title="Upload background">📁</button>
          <button onclick="addCustomBackground()">➕ Add</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modalRow" style="justify-content:flex-end;">
        <label id="hideDefaultBackgroundsRow" style="font-size:80%; opacity:0.8; display:flex; margin-top:3px;" hidden><input id="hideDefaultBackgroundsCheckboxEl" type="checkbox" onchange="toggleHideDefaultBackgrounds(this.checked)" style="margin-right:3px;"> hide default backgrounds</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="customBackgroundListSection" class="modalSection">
      <div id="customBackgroundListEl"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="themeModalEl" class="modalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="modalBox" style="max-width:min(95vw, 560px);">
    <div class="modalHeader">
      <div class="themeModalTitleRow">
        <div style="font-weight:bold;">Theme & text styling</div>
        <select id="themeSchemeSelectEl" class="themeSchemeSelectEl">
          <option value="light">🌄 light</option>
          <option value="dark">🌃 dark</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <button class="modalCloseBtn" onclick="closeThemeModal()" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Page background</div>
      <div class="modalRow" style="align-items:center; gap:0.35rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <select id="backgroundVisualSelectEl" style="flex:1;" onchange="updateThemeModalBackgroundPreview()"></select>
        <button onclick="openMediaModal('background')" title="Add custom background">➕</button>
        <button id="mobileBackgroundToggleBtn" onclick="toggleMobileBackgroundSelect()" title="Use a different background on mobile/portrait screens" style="opacity:0.55;">📱</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modalRow" id="mobileBackgroundRowEl" hidden style="align-items:center; gap:0.35rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <select id="backgroundVisualMobileSelectEl" style="flex:1;" onchange="updateThemeModalBackgroundPreview()"></select>
        <span style="font-size:70%; opacity:0.6;" title="Used on mobile/portrait screens; the select above is used on desktop/landscape screens">📱 mobile</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Text editor background</div>
      <div class="modalRow">
        <div class="themeColorModule" title="Tap the color picker to choose a color for the text editor background. Check the 'auto' checkbox to use the default value.">
          <label class="modalField"><input id="themeBackgroundColorEl" type="color"></label>
          <label class="modalField themeAutoToggle"><input id="themeBackgroundAutoEl" type="checkbox"> auto</label>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Adventure text</div>
      <div class="modalRow">
        <div class="themeColorModule" title="Tap the color picker to choose a color for the adventure text. Check the 'auto' checkbox to use the default value.">
          <label class="modalField themeTextColorField"><input id="themeTextColorEl" type="color"></label>
          <label class="modalField themeAutoToggle"><input id="themeTextAutoEl" type="checkbox"> auto</label>
        </div>
        <div class="modalField fontField">
          <div class="fontFieldInputRow">
            <input id="themeFontFamilyEl" placeholder="fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto">
            <div id="fontHelpCtn" class="fontHelpCtn">
              <button id="fontHelpBtn" class="fontHelpBtn" title="Google Fonts">❓</button>
              <div id="fontHelpTooltip" class="fontHelpTooltip" hidden>
                <div style="font-size:85%;">Paste the full URL from <a href="https://fonts.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Google Fonts</a>, e.g. <span style="white-space:nowrap;">fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalRow modalSectionRow">
      <div class="modalSection modalSectionHalf">
        <div class="modalSectionTitle">Asterisked text</div>
        <div class="modalRow themeInlineRow">
          <div class="themeColorModule" title="Tap the color picker to choose a color for asterisked text. Check the 'auto' checkbox to use the default value.">
            <label class="modalField"><input id="themeItalicColorEl" type="color"></label>
            <label class="modalField themeAutoToggle"><input id="themeItalicAutoEl" type="checkbox"> auto</label>
          </div>
          <label class="modalField"><input id="themeItalicIsItalicEl" type="checkbox"> Italic</label>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modalSection modalSectionHalf">
        <div class="modalSectionTitle">Quoted text</div>
        <div class="modalRow themeInlineRow">
          <div class="themeColorModule" title="Tap the color picker to choose a color for quoted text. Check the 'auto' checkbox to use the default value.">
            <label class="modalField"><input id="themeQuoteColorEl" type="color"></label>
            <label class="modalField themeAutoToggle"><input id="themeQuoteAutoEl" type="checkbox"> auto</label>
          </div>
          <label class="modalField"><input id="themeQuoteIsItalicEl" type="checkbox"> Italic</label>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Action text (lines starting with "&gt;")</div>
      <div class="modalRow themeInlineRow">
        <div class="themeColorModule" title="Tap the color picker to choose a color for your action lines (the ones starting with '>'). Check the 'auto' checkbox to use the default value.">
          <label class="modalField"><input id="themeActionColorEl" type="color"></label>
          <label class="modalField themeAutoToggle"><input id="themeActionAutoEl" type="checkbox"> auto</label>
        </div>
        <label class="modalField"><input id="themeActionIsItalicEl" type="checkbox"> Italic</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="themeAdvancedSection" class="modalSection" hidden>
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">
        Custom style rules
        <button id="themeRulesHelpBtn" class="themeRulesHelpBtn" title="Help">❓</button>
      </div>
      <div id="themeAdvancedRulesCtn"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalSection">
      <div class="modalSectionTitle">Save theme</div>
      <div class="modalRow">
        <label class="modalField">
          <select id="themeScopeSelectEl">
            <option value="story">this adventure only</option>
            <option value="app">default for all adventures</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="modalActions">
      <button onclick="resetThemeSettingsToDefault()" style="margin-right:0.5rem;">↺ reset</button>
      <button id="themeAdvancedToggleBtn" onclick="toggleThemeAdvancedSection()" style="margin-right:auto;">⚙️ advanced</button>
      <button hidden onclick="closeThemeModal({skipConfirm:true})">Cancel</button>
      <button onclick="saveThemeSettingsFromModal()">💾 save</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  if(typeof storyMenuEl !== "undefined") {
    storyMenuEl.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      let btn = e.target.closest("button[data-action]");
      if(!btn) return;
      let action = btn.dataset.action;
      let id = Number(btn.dataset.id);
      let folderPath = btn.dataset.folder || "";
      if(action === "new-story") createNewStory();
      else if(action === "rename-story") renameStory(id);
      else if(action === "duplicate-story") duplicateStory(id);
      else if(action === "delete-story") deleteStory(id);
      else if(action === "download-story") downloadStory(id);
      else if(action === "share-story") openShareModal({storyId: id});
      else if(action === "toggle-pin") togglePinStory(id);
      else if(action === "set-folder") setStoryFolderPath(id);
      else if(action === "rename-folder") renameFolder(folderPath);
      else if(action === "choose-folder-emoji") chooseFolderEmoji(folderPath);
      else if(action === "delete-folder") deleteFolder(folderPath);
      else if(action === "download-folder") downloadFolder(folderPath);
      closeStoryMenu();
    });
  }
  if(typeof storiesListCtn !== "undefined") {
    storiesListCtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      let actionEl = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
      if(!actionEl || !storiesListCtn.contains(actionEl)) return;
      let action = actionEl.dataset.action;
      let id = Number(actionEl.dataset.id);
      let folderPath = actionEl.dataset.folder || "";
      if(action === "open-story") switchToStory(id);
      else if(action === "open-folder") setCurrentFolderPath(folderPath);
      else if(action === "story-menu") openStoryRowMenu({currentTarget: actionEl, stopPropagation: () => e.stopPropagation()}, id);
      else if(action === "folder-menu") openFolderRowMenu({currentTarget: actionEl, stopPropagation: () => e.stopPropagation()}, folderPath);
    });
  }
  function setupModalOverlayDismiss(modalEl, closeFn) {
    if(!modalEl) return;
    modalEl.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
      if(e.target === modalEl) closeFn();
    });
  }
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof musicModalEl !== "undefined" ? musicModalEl : null, closeMusicModal);
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof backgroundModalEl !== "undefined" ? backgroundModalEl : null, closeBackgroundModal);
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof themeModalEl !== "undefined" ? themeModalEl : null, closeThemeModal);
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof importModalEl !== "undefined" ? importModalEl : null, closeImportModal);
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof exportModalEl !== "undefined" ? exportModalEl : null, closeExportModal);
  setupModalOverlayDismiss(typeof shareModalEl !== "undefined" ? shareModalEl : null, closeShareModal);
  if(typeof notepadOverlay !== "undefined") {
    notepadOverlay.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
      if(e.target === notepadOverlay) closeNotepadPanel();
    });
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    if(typeof notepadPanel !== "undefined" && !notepadPanel.hidden) updateNotepadOverlayMode();
  });
  if(typeof fontHelpBtn !== "undefined") {
    fontHelpBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      fontHelpTooltip.hidden = !fontHelpTooltip.hidden;
    });
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if(fontHelpTooltip.hidden) return;
      if(fontHelpCtn.contains(e.target)) return;
      fontHelpTooltip.hidden = true;
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeRulesHelpBtn !== "undefined") {
    themeRulesHelpBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      alert("Left input: text to match, or a regex (e.g. /Alice/gi). Right input: CSS text styling rules.");
    });
  }
  if(typeof themeAdvancedRulesCtn !== "undefined") {
    themeAdvancedRulesCtn.addEventListener("input", e => {
      if(e.target.classList.contains("themePatternInput") || e.target.classList.contains("themeCssInput")) {
        ensureThemeAdvancedRowCount();
      }
    });
    themeAdvancedRulesCtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      let aiBtn = e.target.closest(".themeRuleAiBtn");
      if(aiBtn) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        let row = aiBtn.closest(".themeAdvancedRow");
        if(!window.themeAdvancedReady) return;
        if(row) generateThemeRuleWithAi(row, aiBtn);
      }
    });
  }
  if(typeof importDropZone !== "undefined") {
    importDropZone.addEventListener("click", () => triggerImportFilePicker());
    importDropZone.addEventListener("dragover", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      importDropZone.classList.add("dragOver");
    });
    importDropZone.addEventListener("dragleave", () => importDropZone.classList.remove("dragOver"));
    importDropZone.addEventListener("drop", async e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      importDropZone.classList.remove("dragOver");
      let file = e.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];
      if(!file) return;
      try {
        await importStoriesFromBlob(file);
        closeImportModal();
      } catch(err) {
        console.error(err);
        alert(`Import failed: ${err?.message || err}`);
      }
    });
  }
  function setupCustomMediaListHandlers(listEl, listType) {
    if(!listEl) return;
    listEl.addEventListener("input", e => {
      let row = e.target.closest(".mediaListRow");
      if(!row || !listEl.contains(row)) return;
      let scope = row.dataset.scope;
      let index = Number(row.dataset.index);
      if(e.target.classList.contains("mediaEmojiEdit")) {
        updateCustomMediaField(scope, listType, index, "emoji", e.target.value.trim());
      } else if(e.target.classList.contains("mediaTitleEdit")) {
        updateCustomMediaField(scope, listType, index, "title", e.target.value.trim());
      }
    });
    listEl.addEventListener("change", e => {
      if(!e.target.classList.contains("mediaScopeSelect")) return;
      let row = e.target.closest(".mediaListRow");
      if(!row || !listEl.contains(row)) return;
      let scope = row.dataset.scope;
      let index = Number(row.dataset.index);
      moveCustomMediaScope(listType, scope, index, e.target.value);
    });
    listEl.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if(e.target.classList.contains("mediaCopyLinkBtn")) {
        let url = e.target.dataset.url || "";
        if(url) {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
            e.target.textContent = "✅";
            setTimeout(() => { e.target.textContent = "🔗"; }, 1200);
          }).catch(() => alert(url));
        }
        return;
      }
      if(!e.target.classList.contains("mediaRemoveBtn")) return;
      let row = e.target.closest(".mediaListRow");
      if(!row || !listEl.contains(row)) return;
      let scope = row.dataset.scope;
      let index = Number(row.dataset.index);
      if(listType === "music") removeCustomMusic(index, scope);
      else removeCustomBackground(index, scope);
    });
  }
  setupCustomMediaListHandlers(typeof customMusicListEl !== "undefined" ? customMusicListEl : null, "music");
  setupCustomMediaListHandlers(typeof customBackgroundListEl !== "undefined" ? customBackgroundListEl : null, "background");
  window.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if(typeof storyMenuEl === "undefined") return;
    if(storyMenuEl.hidden) return;
    if(storyMenuEl.contains(e.target)) return;
    if(e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains("storyMenuBtn")) return;
    closeStoryMenu();
  });
  window.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if(typeof storyToolsMenu === "undefined" || typeof storyToolsBtn === "undefined") return;
    if(storyToolsMenu.hidden) return;
    if(storyToolsMenu.contains(e.target) || storyToolsBtn.contains(e.target)) return;
    closeStoryToolsMenu();
  });
  window.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if(typeof notepadTabMenu === "undefined" || typeof notepadTabsMenuBtn === "undefined") return;
    if(notepadTabMenu.hidden) return;
    if(notepadTabMenu.contains(e.target) || notepadTabsMenuBtn.contains(e.target)) return;
    notepadTabMenu.hidden = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey && (e.key === "i" || e.key === "I")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      try { if(typeof toggleImageTray === "function") toggleImageTray(); } catch(err) { console.error(err); }
      return;
    }
    if(e.key === "Escape") {
      // if nothing else that uses Esc is open, Esc closes the image tray:
      let somethingElseWasOpen = false;
      try {
        somethingElseWasOpen = (typeof storyMenuEl !== "undefined" && !storyMenuEl.hidden)
          || (typeof exportModalEl !== "undefined" && !exportModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof importModalEl !== "undefined" && !importModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof shareModalEl !== "undefined" && !shareModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof musicModalEl !== "undefined" && !musicModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof backgroundModalEl !== "undefined" && !backgroundModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof themeModalEl !== "undefined" && !themeModalEl.hidden)
          || (typeof storyToolsMenu !== "undefined" && !storyToolsMenu.hidden)
          || document.body.classList.contains("notepadOpen")
          || document.body.classList.contains("storiesDrawerOpen")
          || !!document.querySelector(".imageOverlayModal");
      } catch(err) {}
      closeStoryMenu();
      if(typeof exportModalEl !== "undefined") exportModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof importModalEl !== "undefined") importModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof shareModalEl !== "undefined") shareModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof musicModalEl !== "undefined") musicModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof backgroundModalEl !== "undefined") backgroundModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof themeModalEl !== "undefined") themeModalEl.hidden = true;
      if(typeof storyToolsMenu !== "undefined") storyToolsMenu.hidden = true;
      if(typeof notepadPanel !== "undefined" && !notepadPanel.hidden) closeNotepadPanel();
      if(!somethingElseWasOpen) {
        try { if(typeof isImageTrayOpen === "function" && isImageTrayOpen()) closeImageTray(); } catch(err) { console.error(err); }
      }
    }
  });
</script>

<style>
#storiesDrawerOverlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 120ms ease-out;
  z-index: 9999990;
}
#storiesDrawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 100dvh;
  width: min(360px, 88vw);
  background: var(--box-color);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  transform: translateX(-105%);
  transition: transform 120ms ease-out;
  z-index: 9999991;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
body.storiesDrawerOpen #storiesDrawerOverlay {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
body.storiesDrawerOpen #storiesDrawer {
  transform: translateX(0%);
}
.storiesDrawerHeader {
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  padding:0.6rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--box-border-color);
}
.storiesDrawerSearch {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:0.35rem;
  padding:0.4rem;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--box-border-color);
}
.storiesListCtn {
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 0.35rem;
  flex: 1;
}
.storiesDrawerFooter {
  border-top:1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  padding:0.4rem;
  background: var(--box-color);
}
.storiesDrawerFooterActions {
  display:flex;
  gap:0.35rem;
  justify-content:space-between;
}
.storyRow {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:0.35rem;
  padding:0.35rem;
  border:1px solid transparent;
  border-radius:3px;
  margin:0.25rem 0.1rem;
}
.storyRow:hover {
  background: rgba(120,120,120,0.12);
}
.storyRow.current {
  border-color: #2b87ff66;
  background: rgba(43,135,255,0.12);
}
.storyPickBtn {
  flex: 1;
  text-align:left;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 95%;
  overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.storyRowRight {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:0.25rem;
}
.storyTime {
  font-size: 70%;
  opacity: 0.7;
  min-width: max-content;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.storyMenuBtn {
  font-size: 90%;
  min-width: 2.2rem;
}
.storyRowSub {
  font-size: 75%;
  opacity: 0.7;
  margin-left: 0.25rem;
}
.storiesStorageWarning {
  font-size: 75%;
  opacity: 0.7;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0.35rem 0.1rem 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(120,120,120,0.08);
  text-align: left;
  margin-top: 4rem;
}
.folderRow .storyPickBtn {
  font-weight: bold;
}
.storyMenuEl {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 9999993;
  background: var(--box-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0;
  min-width: 160px;
}
.storyMenuEl button {
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  text-align:left;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: inherit;
}
.storyMenuEl button:hover {
  background: rgba(120,120,120,0.15);
}
.storyToolsMenu {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0.5rem;
  top: -0.5rem;
  transform: translateY(1.25rem);
  background: var(--box-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0;
  min-width: 210px;
  z-index: 5;
}
.storyToolsMenu button {
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  text-align:left;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: inherit;
}
.storyToolsMenu button:hover {
  background: rgba(120,120,120,0.15);
}
.storyToolsDivider {
  height: 1px;
  border: 0;
  background: rgba(120,120,120,0.2);
  margin: 0.4rem 0.45rem;
}
.backgroundImageIsActive #storyToolsMenu button {
  box-shadow: none;
}
#notepadOverlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 140ms ease-out;
  z-index: 9999955;
}
#notepadPanel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: var(--notepad-width, 320px);
  height: 100dvh;
  background: var(--box-color);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  box-shadow: -4px 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 140ms ease-out;
  z-index: 9999960;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
body.notepadOpen #notepadPanel {
  transform: translateX(0);
}
body.notepadOpen {
  padding-right: var(--notepad-width, 320px);
  transition: padding-right 140ms ease-out;
}
body.notepadOpen.notepadOverlayMode {
  padding-right: 0;
}
body.notepadOpen.notepadOverlayMode #notepadOverlay {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
body.notepadOverlayMode #notepadPanel {
  width: min(360px, 88vw);
}
body.notepadOverlayMode #notepadResizeHandle {
  display: none;
}
#notepadResizeHandle {
  position: absolute;

<div id="mainCtn" style="text-align:left; display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:95%; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto; justify-content:center; align-items:center; margin-top:0.5rem;">
  <!-- Adventure header bar -->
  <div id="storyHeaderBar" style="width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:0.5rem; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
    <button id="openStoriesPanelBtn" onclick="toggleStoriesPanel()" style="min-width:max-content; font-size:80%;">📚 adventures</button>
    <div id="storyTitleCtn" class="settingsModule" style="flex:1; min-width:0; text-align:center; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-size:80%; opacity:0.85; padding:0.25rem 0.45rem; max-width:max-content; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.25rem; margin:0 auto;">
      <span id="currentStoryFolderPrefixEl" style="opacity:0.65;"></span>
      <span id="currentStoryTitleEl" style="font-weight:bold; max-width:180px; display:inline-block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;">Untitled adventure</span>
      <button id="currentStoryMenuBtn" class="storyMenuBtn" onclick="openCurrentStoryMenu(event)" title="Adventure menu" style="font-size:90%;">⋯</button>
    </div>
    <button id="openNotepadBtn" onclick="toggleNotepadPanel()" title="Notepad" style="font-size:80%;">📝 notes</button>
  </div>

  <div id="storyOverviewPaddingEl" hidden style="height:5vh;"></div>
  <div style="height:0px;position:relative;width:100%;text-align:right;"><span id="storyOverviewLengthNoticeEl" hidden style="font-size:70%;background:#202020;color:#cb6900;padding:0.2rem;border-radius:3px;width:max-content;bottom: 0;position: absolute;right: 0;">⚠️ long overview = reduced memory</span></div>
  <div id="storyOverviewTagWrap" style="position:relative;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;">
    <textarea id="storyOverviewEl" oninput="checkOverlyLongFixedTokens(); requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:700});" placeholder="(Optional) Who are you in this adventure, and what should the adventure be about? Write some keywords, or an overview, or starter for the story - you can optionally include characters, plot, desired writing style, world lore, rules/mechanics, genre, etc." style="display:block; width:100%; min-height:7rem; margin-bottom:0.5rem; padding-bottom:0.5rem;"></textarea>
    <button id="storyTagSuggestBtn" type="button" title="Suggest tags" style="position:absolute; right:0.4rem; bottom:0.9rem; font-size:60%; z-index:4;">🏷️ tags</button>
    <div id="storyTagSuggestCtn" hidden style="position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:100%; z-index:6;"></div>
  </div>
  <script>
    let { countTokens, idealMaxContextTokens } = ai({getMetaObject:true});
    let checkOverlyLongFixedTokens_debounce = null;
    function checkOverlyLongFixedTokens() {
      clearTimeout(checkOverlyLongFixedTokens_debounce);
      checkOverlyLongFixedTokens_debounce = setTimeout(() => {
        storyOverviewLengthNoticeEl.hidden = (countTokens(storyOverviewEl.value) < idealMaxContextTokens*0.5);
      }, 600);
    }
    setTimeout(checkOverlyLongFixedTokens, 3000);
  </script>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("storyTagSuggestBtn");
    const ctn = document.getElementById("storyTagSuggestCtn");
    const overviewEl = document.getElementById("storyOverviewEl");
    let open = false, loaded = false, loadPromise = null, outsideHandler = null, state = null;

    const ensureStyle = () => {
      if (document.getElementById("tagSuggestStyle")) return;
      const s = document.createElement("style");
      s.id = "tagSuggestStyle";
      s.textContent = ".tagSugBox{--bg:light-dark(#f6f1ea,#1c1a17);--ink:light-dark(#1b1a17,#efe9e1);--accent:light-dark(#1e6f5c,#7ad0ba);--chip:light-dark(#e8dfd4,#2a2521);--chip-on:light-dark(#1e6f5c,#7ad0ba);--chip-on-text:light-dark(#fdfbf7,#0f0f0e);--border:light-dark(#ddd2c4,#3a332c);--input:light-dark(#fffdfa,#221e1a);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:3px;padding:0.5rem;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);}"+
        ".tagSugControls{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;width:100%;}"+
        ".tagSugSearchWrap{position:relative;width:100%;}"+
        ".tagSugSearch{box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 22px 6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:3px;font-size:12px;width:100%;background:var(--input);color:var(--ink);}"+
        ".tagSugClear{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#6a655d);font-size:12px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:none;}"+
        ".tagSugList{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(192px,1fr));gap:6px;max-height:260px;overflow:auto;}"+
        ".tagSugTag{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--chip);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);user-select:none;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;}"+
        ".tagSugTag .label{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}"+
        ".tagSugTag.selected{background:light-dark(#2e6a5b,#4f9c89);color:light-dark(#fdfbf7,#0f0f0e);border-color:light-dark(#285e50,#5bb3a0);}";
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    };


    const decodePacked = (buffer) => {
      const view = new DataView(buffer);
      const magic = String.fromCharCode(view.getUint8(0), view.getUint8(1), view.getUint8(2), view.getUint8(3));
      if (magic !== "ALSH") throw new Error("Bad packed header");
      const version = view.getUint32(4, true);
      if (version !== 1) throw new Error("Unsupported packed version");
      const nTags = view.getUint32(8, true);
      const dim = view.getUint32(12, true);
      const bits = view.getUint32(16, true);
      const q4Offset = view.getUint32(20, true);
      const q4Bytes = view.getUint32(24, true);
      const scaleOffset = view.getUint32(28, true);
      const scaleBytes = view.getUint32(32, true);
      const planesOffset = view.getUint32(36, true);
      const planesBytes = view.getUint32(40, true);
      const offsetsOffset = view.getUint32(44, true);
      const offsetsBytes = view.getUint32(48, true);
      const indicesOffset = view.getUint32(52, true);
      const indicesBytes = view.getUint32(56, true);
      return {
        nTags, dim, bits,
        q4: new Uint8Array(buffer, q4Offset, q4Bytes),
        scales: new Float32Array(buffer, scaleOffset, scaleBytes / 4),
        planes: new Float32Array(buffer, planesOffset, planesBytes / 4),
        lshOffsets: new Uint32Array(buffer, offsetsOffset, offsetsBytes / 4),
        lshIndices: new Uint32Array(buffer, indicesOffset, indicesBytes / 4),
      };
    };

    const parseStoryTags = (text, tagToId) => {
      const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
      let i = lines.length - 1;
      while (i >= 0 && !lines[i].trim()) i--;
      if (i >= 0 && /^TAGS:/.test(lines[i].trim())) {
        const line = lines[i].trim().replace(/^TAGS:\s*/, "");
        const tags = line.split(",").map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const items = tags.map(t => ({ raw: t, key: t.toLowerCase(), known: tagToId.has(t.toLowerCase()) }));
        const body = lines.slice(0, i).join("\n").replace(/\s+$/,"");
        return { body, items };
      }
      return { body: text.replace(/\s+$/,""), items: [] };
    };

    const buildQuery = () => {
      const { selected, scales, q4, bytesPerRow, dim } = state;
      const q = new Float32Array(dim);
      if (!selected.size) return q;
      for (const id of selected) {
        const base = id * bytesPerRow;
        const scale = scales[id];
        let qi = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < bytesPerRow; j++) {
          const byte = q4[base + j];
          q[qi++] += ((byte >> 4) - 8) * scale;
          q[qi++] += ((byte & 0x0f) - 8) * scale;
        }
      }
      const inv = 1 / selected.size;
      for (let i = 0; i < dim; i++) q[i] *= inv;
      return q;
    };

    const buildTable = (q) => {
      const { bytesPerRow } = state;
      const table = new Float32Array(bytesPerRow * 256);
      for (let j = 0; j < bytesPerRow; j++) {
        const q0 = q[j * 2], q1 = q[j * 2 + 1], base = j * 256;
        for (let b = 0; b < 256; b++) table[base + b] = q0 * ((b >> 4) - 8) + q1 * ((b & 0x0f) - 8);
      }
      return table;
    };

    const hashQuery = (q) => {
      const { bits, dim, planes } = state;
      let key = 0;
      for (let b = 0; b < bits; b++) {
        let dot = 0, off = b * dim;
        for (let i = 0; i < dim; i++) dot += q[i] * planes[off + i];
        if (dot > 0) key |= (1 << b);
      }
      return key;
    };

    const scoreRow = (id, table) => {
      const { q4, scales, bytesPerRow } = state;
      const base = id * bytesPerRow;
      let sum = 0, tBase = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < bytesPerRow; j++) { sum += table[tBase + q4[base + j]]; tBase += 256; }
      return sum * scales[id];
    };

    const recomputeScores = () => {
      const { scores, selected, counts, lshOffsets, lshIndices, visit, bits } = state;
      scores.fill(0);
      if (!selected.size) return;
      const query = buildQuery();
      const table = buildTable(query);
      const key = hashQuery(query);
      const buckets = [key]; for (let b = 0; b < bits; b++) buckets.push(key ^ (1 << b));
      let queryCount = 0; for (const id of selected) queryCount += counts[id] || 1; queryCount /= selected.size;
      state.visitToken = (state.visitToken + 1) >>> 0; if (!state.visitToken) { visit.fill(0); state.visitToken = 1; }
      const token = state.visitToken;
      for (const b of buckets) {
        const start = lshOffsets[b], end = lshOffsets[b + 1];
        for (let p = start; p < end; p++) {
          const id = lshIndices[p];
          if (visit[id] === token || selected.has(id)) continue;
          visit[id] = token;
          let score = scoreRow(id, table);
          const denom = Math.sqrt(queryCount * (counts[id] || 1));
          scores[id] = denom ? (score / denom) : 0;
        }
      }
      for (const id of selected) scores[id] = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    };

    const getSortedOrder = () => {
      const { tags, scores, selected, alphaOrder } = state;
      if (!selected.size) return state.randomOrder || alphaOrder;
      const ids = Array.from({ length: tags.length }, (_, i) => i);
      ids.sort((a, b) => {
        const sa = scores[a], sb = scores[b];
        if (sa !== sb) return sb - sa;
        const ta = tags[a], tb = tags[b];
        return ta < tb ? -1 : ta > tb ? 1 : 0;
      });
      return ids;
    };

    const updateOverviewTags = () => {
      const { tagToId } = state;
      const { body, items } = parseStoryTags(overviewEl.value, tagToId);
      const selectedKeys = new Set(Array.from(state.selected).map(id => state.tags[id].toLowerCase()));
      const keptKeys = new Set();
      const out = [];
      for (const item of items) {
        if (item.known) {
          if (selectedKeys.has(item.key)) {
            out.push(item.raw);
            keptKeys.add(item.key);
          }
        } else {
          out.push(item.raw);
        }
      }
      for (const key of selectedKeys) {
        if (keptKeys.has(key)) continue;
        out.push(key);
      }
      overviewEl.value = out.length ? `${body}${body ? "\n\n" : ""}TAGS: ${out.join(", ")}` : body;
      checkOverlyLongFixedTokens();
      requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:700});
    };

    const render = () => {
      const listEl = ctn.querySelector(".tagSugList");
      const filter = ctn.querySelector(".tagSugSearch").value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const order = getSortedOrder();
      let orderIndex = null;
      if (filter) { orderIndex = new Int32Array(state.tags.length); for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++) orderIndex[order[i]] = i; }
      let candidates = order;
      if (filter) {
        candidates = [];
        for (const id of order) if (state.tags[id].includes(filter)) candidates.push(id);
        candidates.sort((a, b) => {
          const ta = state.tags[a], tb = state.tags[b];
          const ea = ta === filter ? 1 : 0, eb = tb === filter ? 1 : 0;
          if (ea !== eb) return eb - ea;
          const ra = filter.length / ta.length, rb = filter.length / tb.length;
          if (ra !== rb) return rb - ra;
          return orderIndex[a] - orderIndex[b];
        });
      }
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      let shown = 0, selectedRemaining = state.selected.size, sinceRandom = 0, unselectedShown = 0;
      const used = new Set();
      const addTag = (id) => {
        const tag = document.createElement("div");
        tag.className = state.selected.has(id) ? "tagSugTag selected" : "tagSugTag";
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "label";
        span.textContent = state.tags[id];
        tag.title = state.tags[id];
        tag.appendChild(span);
        tag.onclick = () => { const search = ctn.querySelector(".tagSugSearch"); if (search && search.value) search.value = ""; state.selected.has(id) ? state.selected.delete(id) : state.selected.add(id); recomputeScores(); render(); updateOverviewTags(); };
        frag.appendChild(tag);
        used.add(id);
        shown++;
      };
      const insertRandom = () => {
        const { randomOrder } = state;
        if (!randomOrder || !randomOrder.length) return;
        let attempts = 0;
        while (attempts < randomOrder.length) {
          const id = randomOrder[state.randomCursor++ % randomOrder.length];
          attempts++;
          if (used.has(id) || state.selected.has(id)) continue;
          addTag(id);
          break;
        }
      };
      for (const id of candidates) {
        if (shown >= 1000) break;
        if (!used.has(id)) addTag(id);
        if (state.selected.has(id)) selectedRemaining--;
        else {
          unselectedShown++; sinceRandom++;
          if (!filter && selectedRemaining <= 0 && unselectedShown > 20 && sinceRandom >= 3 && shown < 1000) { insertRandom(); sinceRandom = 0; }
        }
      }
      listEl.innerHTML = ""; listEl.appendChild(frag);
    };

    const syncSelectedFromOverview = () => {
      const { tagToId } = state;
      const parsed = parseStoryTags(overviewEl.value, tagToId);
      state.selected.clear();
      for (const item of parsed.items) if (item.known) state.selected.add(tagToId.get(item.key));
      recomputeScores();
    };

    const load = async () => {
      ensureStyle();
      ctn.innerHTML = '<div class="tagSugBox" style="font-size:12px;">Loading tags...</div>';
      const [tagsRes, packedRes, countsRes] = await Promise.all([fetch("https://user.uploads.dev/file/f81d2b202b03da473014d0f2db351931.txt"), fetch("https://user.uploads.dev/file/a5aed167ed50de1e081c05fea18a9010.bin"), fetch("https://user.uploads.dev/file/77c9fc95d491d1d4ce8d0018a29315c1.bin")]);
      const tags = (await tagsRes.text()).split("\n");
      const packed = decodePacked(await packedRes.arrayBuffer());
      if (packed.nTags !== tags.length) throw new Error("Tag count mismatch");
      const counts = new Uint32Array(await countsRes.arrayBuffer());
      const tagToId = new Map(); tags.forEach((t, i) => tagToId.set(t.toLowerCase(), i));
      const alphaOrder = Array.from({ length: tags.length }, (_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => tags[a] < tags[b] ? -1 : tags[a] > tags[b] ? 1 : 0);
      const randomOrder = alphaOrder.slice(); for (let i = randomOrder.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [randomOrder[i], randomOrder[j]] = [randomOrder[j], randomOrder[i]]; }
      state = {
        tags, tagToId, counts,
        q4: packed.q4, scales: packed.scales, planes: packed.planes,
        lshOffsets: packed.lshOffsets, lshIndices: packed.lshIndices,
        bits: packed.bits, dim: packed.dim, bytesPerRow: packed.dim / 2,
        scores: new Float32Array(tags.length), visit: new Uint32Array(tags.length), visitToken: 1,
        selected: new Set(), alphaOrder, randomOrder, randomCursor: 0,
      };
      ctn.innerHTML = '<div class="tagSugBox"><div class="tagSugControls"><div class="tagSugSearchWrap"><input class="tagSugSearch" type="search" placeholder="Filter tags..." style="box-sizing:border-box;"><button class="tagSugClear" type="button">x</button></div></div><div class="tagSugList"></div></div>';
      const searchEl = ctn.querySelector(".tagSugSearch");
      const clearEl = ctn.querySelector(".tagSugClear");
      const syncClear = () => { clearEl.style.display = searchEl.value ? "block" : "none"; };
      searchEl.addEventListener("input", () => { syncClear(); render(); });
      clearEl.addEventListener("click", () => { searchEl.value = ""; syncClear(); render(); searchEl.focus(); });
      syncClear();
      loaded = true;
    };

    const openSuggestor = async () => {
      if (!loadPromise) loadPromise = load().catch(err => { loadPromise = null; throw err; });
      await loadPromise;
      if (!open) return;
      syncSelectedFromOverview();
      render();
    };

    const closeSuggestor = () => {
      ctn.hidden = true;
      open = false;
      if (outsideHandler) document.removeEventListener("mousedown", outsideHandler);
    };

    const syncOverviewVisibility = () => {
      const hidden = !!overviewEl.hidden;
      btn.hidden = hidden;
      if (hidden) closeSuggestor();
    };

    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (open) return closeSuggestor();
      open = true;
      ctn.hidden = false;
      if (!loaded) ctn.innerHTML = '<div class="tagSugBox" style="font-size:12px;">Loading tags...</div>';
      outsideHandler = (ev) => { if (!ctn.contains(ev.target) && ev.target !== btn) closeSuggestor(); };
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", outsideHandler);
      openSuggestor().catch(err => { console.error(err); ctn.hidden = true; open = false; });
    });
    syncOverviewVisibility();
    new MutationObserver(syncOverviewVisibility).observe(overviewEl, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["hidden"] });
  })();
  </script>
````
