      <button id="addShortcutButtonEl" title="Add a shortcut button" onclick="this.disabled=true; setTimeout(()=>this.disabled=false, 1000); showShortcutEditor()" style="margin-top:0.25rem; font-size:70%; text-shadow: 0px 0px 1px #000000;">⚡</button>
      <script>
        async function showShortcutEditor(opts={}) {
          
          let shortcutButtons = getShortcutButtons().slice(0);
          
          function editIdOnChange(data) {
            if(!data.edit_id) return;
            let shortcutToEdit = shortcutButtons.find(b => b.id === Number(data.edit_id));
            data.add_type = shortcutToEdit.type;
            data.add_label = shortcutToEdit.label || "";
            data.add_insertionText = shortcutToEdit.insertionText || "";
            data.add_actionInsertionType = shortcutToEdit.actionInsertionType;
            data.add_storyContinuationType = shortcutToEdit.storyContinuationType;
            data.add_storyInsertionType = shortcutToEdit.storyInsertionType;
            data.add_autoContinue = shortcutToEdit.autoContinue;
            // data.add_slashCommand = shortcutToEdit.slashCommand || "";
          }
          
          function pageOnChange(data) {
            if(data.page === "add") { // clear some data in case it was just on edit page
              data.label = "";
              data.insertionText = "";
              data.slashCommand = "";
            }
          }
          
          let defaultEdit = null;
          if(opts.defaultEditId) defaultEdit = shortcutButtons.find(b => b.id === opts.defaultEditId);
          
          
          let d = await prompt2({
            // note that an 'edit' is actually just a delete+add, so it shows the add page, plus an edit id selector
            intro: {type:"none", html:`<div style="font-size:80%;margin-bottom:1rem;padding: 0.5rem;border: 1px solid #6f6f6f;border-radius: 3px;">Here you can add shortcut buttons to 'automate' commonly-used actions or story prompts. For example, you could add an action button for a common action like <span style="white-space:pre; background:#007600; color:white; border-radius:2px; padding:0.05rem 0.15rem;">look for possible exits</span> so you can just tap a button instead of typing it out every time. Or you could add a story button with <span style="white-space:pre; background:#007600; color:white; border-radius:2px; padding:0.05rem 0.15rem;">(Alice's thoughts: "</span> so that when you click it, the AI will 'autocomplete' that text to tell you what Alice is currently thinking. To add a dice roll to the end of your action before sending it, you'd use the "insert after existing action text" option to insert <span style="white-space:pre; background:#007600; color:white; border-radius:2px; padding:0.05rem 0.15rem;">I rolled a {1-20}</span>.</div>`, show:(d)=>!d.page && !defaultEdit},
            page: !defaultEdit && shortcutButtons.length > 0 ? {label:"", type:"select", options:[{content:"➕ Add a shortcut button", value:"add"}, shortcutButtons.length>0?({content:"✏️ Edit a shortcut button", value:"edit"}):null, shortcutButtons.length>0?({content:"❌ Delete a shortcut button", value:"delete"}):null].filter(o => o), defaultValue:defaultEdit?"edit":"add"} : null,
            
            edit_id: !defaultEdit && shortcutButtons.length > 0 ? {label:`Choose an existing shortcut button to edit.${window.innerWidth > 600 ? ` <i style="opacity:0.7;"><b style="color:#009900;">Tip:</b> You can right-click on a shortcut button as a faster way to edit it.</i>` : ""}`, onChange:editIdOnChange, type:"select", options:[{content:"Select a shortcut to edit", value:""}, ...shortcutButtons.map(b => ({content:"✏️ "+b.label, value:b.id}))], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.id??"", show:(d)=>d.page==="edit"} : null,
            
            // 'add' page:
            add_type: {label:`Shortcut button type. <i style="opacity:0.7;">When the button is clicked, do you want to trigger a player action, or generate some story text?</i>`, type:"select", options:[{content:"⚔️ Player 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 button", value:"action"}, {content:"📖 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆 continuation button", value:"story"}], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.type??"action", show:(d)=>!d.page || d.page==="add" || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit")},
            add_label: {label:`Shortcut button label. <i style="opacity:0.7;">This is just the visible label/name of the button, and you can include emojis to help make your buttons more visually distinct.</i>`, type:"textLine", placeholder:``, defaultValue:defaultEdit?.label??"", show:(d)=>!d.page || d.page==="add" || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit")},
            add_insertionText: {label:`Text to insert. <i style="opacity:0.7;">When the shortcut button is pressed, this text will be inserted. Tip: If you write <span style="white-space:pre;">{1-20}</span> then it will be replaced with a random number between 1 and 20.</i>`, type:"text", placeholder:``, defaultValue:defaultEdit?.insertionText??"", show:(d)=>!d.page || d.page==="add" || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit")},
            add_actionInsertionType: {label:`Text insertion method. <i style="opacity:0.7;">Should the text overwrite any existing text in the action text box? Or should it get added before or after any existing text?</i>`, type:"select", options:[{content:"🆕 Replace text in input box (if any)", value:"replace"}, {content:"⬅️ Insert 𝗯𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗲 existing action text", value:"prepend"}, {content:"➡️ Insert 𝗮𝗳𝘁𝗲𝗿 existing action text", value:"append"}, {content:"✂️ Insert at cursor/caret position", value:"replace_selection"}], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.actionInsertionType??"replace", show:(d)=>d.add_type==="action" && ((d.page==="add" || !d.page) || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit"))},
            add_storyInsertionType: {label:`Text insertion method. <i style="opacity:0.7;">Should the text get inserted as the start of a new paragraph, or added to the end of the last one?</i>`, type:"select", options:[{content:"🆕 Add it as a new paragraph", value:"new_paragraph"}, {content:"➡️ Add to end of last paragraph", value:"inline"}], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.storyInsertionType??"new_paragraph", show:(d)=>d.add_type==="story" && ((d.page==="add" || !d.page) || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit"))},
            add_autoContinue: {label:`Auto-continue? <i style="opacity:0.7;">After the text is inserted, should the AI be automatically triggered?</i>`, type:"select", options:[{content:"▶️ Yes, continue immediately", value:"yes"}, {content:"✋ No, just insert the text", value:"no"}], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.autoContinue??"yes", show:(d)=>!d.page || d.page==="add" || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit")},
            add_storyContinuationType: {label:`Continuation method. <i style="opacity:0.7;">After insertion, should the AI continue writing from the end of the inserted text, or should it start a new paragraph after it, and then continue?</i>`, type:"select", options:[{content:"➡️ Continue from end of inserted text", value:"inline"}, {content:"🆕 Start a new paragraph after inserted text and then continue", value:"new_paragraph"}], defaultValue:defaultEdit?.storyContinuationType??"inline", show:(d)=>d.add_type==="story" && d.add_autoContinue==="yes" && ((d.page==="add" || !d.page) || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit"))},
            // add_slashCommand: {hidden:true, label:`(Optional) Slash command trigger. <i style="opacity:0.7;">If you input "abc" below, then typing "/abc" in the action input box will trigger this shortcut. Also, if your 'insertion text' has "$*" written in it somewhere, then when you use the command you can write e.g. "/abc hello there", and "hello there" will put in place of the "$*" placeholder.</i>`, type:"textLine", defaultValue:"", show:(d)=>!d.page || d.page==="add" || (d.edit_id && d.page==="edit")},
            
            // 'delete' page:
            delete_id: {label:"Choose an existing shortcut button to delete:", type:"select", options:[{content:"Select a shortcut to delete", value:""}, ...shortcutButtons.map(b => ({content:"❌ "+b.label, value:b.id}))], defaultValue:"", show:(d)=>d.page==="delete"},
          });
          if(!d) return;
          
          if(!d.page) d.page = "add";
          if(defaultEdit) d.page = "edit";
          
          let commandType = d.page;
          let shortcutIdToDelete = null;
          if(commandType === "edit") {
            shortcutIdToDelete = Number(d.edit_id || defaultEdit.id);
            commandType = "add";
          }
          
          if(commandType === "add") {
            let currentHighestId = shortcutButtons.reduce((a,v) => v.id > a ? v.id : a, 0);
            let id = currentHighestId+1;
            shortcutButtons.push({
              id,
              label: d.add_label.trim() || id,
              type: d.add_type,
              insertionText: d.add_insertionText,
              actionInsertionType: d.add_actionInsertionType,
              storyContinuationType: d.add_storyContinuationType,
              storyInsertionType: d.add_storyInsertionType,
              autoContinue: d.add_autoContinue,
              slashCommand: "", //d.add_slashCommand.trim(),
            });
            if(shortcutIdToDelete !== null) {
              shortcutButtons = shortcutButtons.filter(b => b.id !== shortcutIdToDelete);
            }
          } else if(commandType === "delete") {
            if(!d.delete_id) return;
            shortcutButtons = shortcutButtons.filter(b => b.id !== Number(d.delete_id));
          }
            
          setShortcutButtons(shortcutButtons);
          renderShortcutButtons();
        }
        
        function toggleShortcutButtonTrashMode() {
          if(!localStorage.knowsHowShortcutButtonTrashModeWorks) {
            if(!confirm("Tap a shortcut button to delete it.")) return;
            localStorage.knowsHowShortcutButtonTrashModeWorks = "1";
          }
          if(shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode === "1") {
            shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode = "";
            toggleShortcutButtonTrashModeBtn.textContent = "🗑️";
          } else {
            shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode = "1";
            toggleShortcutButtonTrashModeBtn.textContent = "🏁";
          }
        }
        
        function renderShortcutButtons() {
          let shortcutButtons = getShortcutButtons().slice(0);
          shortcutButtonsCtn.hidden = shortcutButtons.length === 0;
          let html = shortcutButtons.map(b => `<button class="shortcutButton" title="Right-click to edit, drag to re-order" oncontextmenu="showShortcutEditor({defaultEditId:${b.id}}); event.preventDefault();" data-config="${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(b))}" onclick="if(shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode) { deleteShortcutButton(JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(this.dataset.config))) } else { executeShortcutButton(JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(this.dataset.config))) }">${b.label}</button>`).join("");
          if(shortcutButtons.length > 0) {
            html += `<button id="toggleShortcutButtonTrashModeBtn" onclick="toggleShortcutButtonTrashMode()">${shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode ? "🏁" : "🗑️"}</button>`;
          }
          shortcutButtonsCtn.innerHTML = html;
          
          if(shortcutButtons.length > 3 && !localStorage.knowsAboutShortcutButtonDragReordering) {
            dragShortcutButtonsToReorderHintEl.hidden = false;
            dragShortcutButtonsToReorderHintEl.innerHTML = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches ? `(drag buttons to re-order, long-press to edit)` : `(drag buttons to re-order, right-click to edit)`;
          } else {
            dragShortcutButtonsToReorderHintEl.hidden = true;
          }
        }
        
        function deleteShortcutButton(data) {
          let shortcutButtons = getShortcutButtons().slice(0);
          shortcutButtons = shortcutButtons.filter(b => b.id !== data.id);
          if(shortcutButtons.length === 0) shortcutButtonsCtn.dataset.trashMode = "";
          setShortcutButtons(shortcutButtons);
          renderShortcutButtons();
        }
        
        function replaceSelectionInTextarea(ta, text) {
          let startI = ta.selectionStart;
          let endI = ta.selectionEnd;
          let textBefore = ta.value.substring(0, startI);
          // let textSelected = ta.value.substring(startI, endI);
          let textAfter = ta.value.substring(endI);
          ta.value = textBefore + text + textAfter;
          // move caret to end of new text
          ta.selectionStart = (textBefore + text).length;
          ta.selectionEnd = (textBefore + text).length;
        }
        
        function executeShortcutButton(data) {
          if(data.type === "action") {
            let insertionText = data.insertionText.replace(/\{[0-9]+-[0-9]+\}/g, m=>m.evaluateItem);
            if(data.actionInsertionType === "replace") whatHappensNextEl.value = insertionText;
            if(data.actionInsertionType === "append") whatHappensNextEl.value += insertionText;
            if(data.actionInsertionType === "prepend") whatHappensNextEl.value = whatHappensNextEl.value + insertionText;
            if(data.actionInsertionType === "replace_selection") replaceSelectionInTextarea(whatHappensNextEl, insertionText);
            handleWhatHappensNextInput();

            if(data.autoContinue === "yes") continueStory();
          } else if(data.type === "story") {
            let insertionText = data.insertionText.replace(/\{[0-9]+-[0-9]+\}/g, m=>m.evaluateItem);
            if(data.storyInsertionType === "inline") storySoFarEl.value = storySoFarEl.value.trim() + insertionText;
            if(data.storyInsertionType === "new_paragraph") storySoFarEl.value = storySoFarEl.value.trim() + "\n\n" + insertionText;
            storySoFarEl.scrollTop = storySoFarEl.scrollHeight;
            requestSaveCurrentStory({immediate:true});

            if(data.autoContinue === "yes") continueStory({continueInline: data.storyContinuationType==="inline" });
          }
        }
        
        
        
        function makeChildrenReorderableViaDrag(container, { childSelector='*', onEnd, onStart, excludeChildren=[] } = {}) {
          let draggedEl = null;
          let ghostEl = null;
          let started = false;
          let isTouchDevice = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;

          function createGhost(el) {
            const ghost = el.cloneNode(true);
            const styles = window.getComputedStyle(el);
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            Object.assign(ghost.style, { position: 'fixed', pointerEvents: 'none',  opacity: '0.7', zIndex: '1000', width: `${rect.width}px`, height: `${rect.height}px`, margin: '0', fontSize: styles.getPropertyValue("font-size") });
            return ghost;
          }

          function handleMove(x, y) {
            if(!draggedEl || !ghostEl) return;
            ghostEl.style.left = `${x - ghostEl.getBoundingClientRect().width / 2}px`;
            ghostEl.style.top = `${y - ghostEl.getBoundingClientRect().height / 2}px`;

            const children = [...container.querySelectorAll(`:scope > ${childSelector}`)].filter(child => !excludeChildren.includes(child));

            if(children.length === 0) {
              container.appendChild(draggedEl);
              return;
            }

            // Find the closest child to the pointer
            let closestChild = children[0];
            let minDistance = Infinity;

            children.forEach(child => {
              const rect = child.getBoundingClientRect();
              const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
              const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
              const distance = Math.hypot(x - centerX, y - centerY);

              if (distance < minDistance) {
                minDistance = distance;
                closestChild = child;
              }
            });

            // Determine whether to insert before or after the closest child
            const rect = closestChild.getBoundingClientRect();
            const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;

            if (x < centerX) {
              // Only move if it's not already in the correct position
              if (closestChild !== draggedEl && closestChild.previousElementSibling !== draggedEl) {
                container.insertBefore(draggedEl, closestChild);
              }
            } else {
              // Only move if it's not already in the correct position
              if (closestChild.nextElementSibling !== draggedEl) {
                container.insertBefore(draggedEl, closestChild.nextElementSibling);
              }
            }
          }

          let draggedElOriginalOpacity;
          function cleanup(timer) {
            if(timer) clearTimeout(timer);
            if(ghostEl) ghostEl.remove();
            if(draggedEl) draggedEl.style.opacity = draggedElOriginalOpacity;
            draggedEl = ghostEl = null;
            if(started) onEnd?.();
            started = false;
          }

          function initDrag(event) {
            let isTouch = event.type.includes('touch');
            let point = isTouch ? event.touches[0] : event;
            let target = event.target.closest(childSelector);
            if(!target || !container.contains(target) || excludeChildren.includes(target)) return;
            let startPos = { x: point.clientX, y: point.clientY };
            let startDelayMs = 200;

            function startDragging() {
              draggedEl = target;
              if(!started) { onStart?.(); started = true; }
              
              draggedElOriginalOpacity = draggedEl.style.opacity;
              draggedEl.style.opacity = '0.5';
              
              ghostEl = createGhost(draggedEl);
              document.body.appendChild(ghostEl);
              handleMove(point.clientX, point.clientY);
            }

            let timer = setTimeout(startDragging, startDelayMs);
            
            let moveHandlerCount = 0;
            function moveHandler(e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              let p = isTouch ? e.touches[0] : e;
              // in case they were scrolling and happened to hit the button in the process, we ignore if their pointer moves away too fast before the startDelayMs timeout:
              if(isTouch && !draggedEl && Math.hypot(p.clientX - startPos.x, p.clientY - startPos.y) > 30) {
                cleanup(timer);
                return;
              }
              if(moveHandlerCount % 2 === 0) handleMove(p.clientX, p.clientY);
              moveHandlerCount++;
            }

            function endHandler() {
              document.removeEventListener(isTouch ? 'touchmove' : 'mousemove', moveHandler);
              cleanup(timer);
            }
            document.addEventListener(isTouch ? 'touchmove' : 'mousemove', moveHandler, isTouch ? { passive: false } : undefined);
            document.addEventListener(isTouch ? 'touchend' : 'mouseup', endHandler, { once: true });
          }
          
          container.addEventListener('touchstart', initDrag);
          container.addEventListener('mousedown', initDrag);
        }
      </script>
    </div>

        if(typeof imageTrayToggleBtn !== "undefined") imageTrayToggleBtn.hidden = !!infoTrackingBtn.dataset.enabled;
      }
      function onVisibleOnce(element, callback) {
        new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            if(entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
              callback(element);
              observer.disconnect();
            }
          });
        }).observe(element);
      }
    </script>

    updateImagePromptModeUi();

  try { setupImageTrayResizer(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); } // the closed-state tab must be tappable/draggable from page load
</script>
<style>
#imageTrayEl {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  height: var(--image-tray-height, 35vh);
  min-height: 120px;
  max-height: 90vh;
  background: var(--box-color);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  z-index: 500; /* above the fixed footer buttons (dark mode / fullscreen / feedback), below drawers+modals */
  transition: transform 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out;
}
#imageTrayEl.trayClosed {
  transform: translateY(100%);
  box-shadow: none; /* the panel sits just below the viewport when closed - without this its upward shadow bleeds onto the bottom of the screen */
  border-top-color: transparent;
}
#imageTrayEl.trayClosed .imageTrayInner {
  visibility: hidden; /* keep offscreen controls out of tab-focus order */
}
#imageTrayDragStrip {
  position: absolute;
  top: -5px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 11px;
  cursor: ns-resize;
  touch-action: none; /* the whole top border is draggable */
}
#imageTrayEl.trayClosed #imageTrayDragStrip {
  display: none; /* when closed, only the tab is grabbable */
}
#imageTrayCloseTab {
  position: absolute;
  top: -1.3rem;
  right: 0.5rem;
  width: 1.3rem;
  height: 1.3rem;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--box-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1;
}
#imageTrayEl.trayClosed #imageTrayCloseTab {
  display: none;
}
#imageTrayEl.trayClosed #imageTrayGrabTab {
  display: none; /* nothing peeks when closed - the panel is opened via the generate-images button (or Ctrl+I) */
}
body.imageTrayOpen {
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--image-tray-height, 35vh) + 1rem);
}
#imageTrayGrabTab {
  position: absolute;
  top: -0.85rem;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 76px;
  height: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--box-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  cursor: ns-resize;
  touch-action: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
#imageTrayGrabTab:before {
  content: '';
  width: 38px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(128,128,128,0.7);
}
.imageTrayInner {
  display: flex;
  height: 100%;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.4rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.imageTrayControls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  width: 150px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}
@media screen and (min-width: 850px) {
  .imageTrayControls {
    width: 175px;
  }
}
#imageGuidanceEl {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  resize: none;
  font-size: 75%;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.imageTrayControlsBottom {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  align-items: center;
}
#imageBatchSizeEl {
  width: 2rem;
  font-size: 100%;
}
#imageGenerateBtn {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: max-content;
}
.imageFeedWrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
#imageFeedEl {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.imageFeedFade {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 2.5rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--box-color));
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
}
.imageCard {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; /* NOT stretch - stretch would force the media's width to the card width, overriding its aspect-ratio */
  gap: 0.25rem;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.imageCardMedia {
  /* definite height (card height minus the fixed-height button row + gap) so that
     aspect-ratio can reliably resolve the width from it - deriving the width via
     flex-basis transfer is flaky, and the img's natural 768px width was winning */
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: calc(100% - 1.95rem);
  width: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1/1;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(128,128,128,0.12);
  border: 1px solid var(--box-border-color);
  border-radius: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.imageCardMedia img {
  /* absolutely positioned so the image's natural size can never drive the card's intrinsic width */
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain; /* always show the whole image */
  cursor: zoom-in;
}
.imageCardStatus {
  font-size: 70%;
  opacity: 0.8;
  padding: 0.4rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.imageCardBtns {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: stretch;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  height: 1.7rem; /* fixed, so .imageCardMedia's calc(100% - ...) height is exact */
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.imageCardBtns button {
  font-size: 70%;
  min-width: max-content;
}
#imageTrayEl.compact .imageBtnLabel {
  display: none;
}
.imageFeedEmptyMsg {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  font-size: 80%;
  opacity: 0.55;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#imageFeedEl:empty ~ .imageFeedEmptyMsg {
  display: flex;
}
#imageFeedEl:empty ~ .imageFeedFade {
  display: none;
}
</style>

<div id="backgroundImageCtn" style="position:fixed; top:0px; left:0px; right:0px; bottom:0px; z-index:-10; background-size:cover; background-position:center; background-attachment:fixed; pointer-events:none;"></div>
<script>
  function createCrossfadePseudoVideoElement(opts={}) {
    const container = document.createElement('div');
    const subContainer = document.createElement('div');
    const video1 = document.createElement('video');
    const video2 = document.createElement('video');

    const fadeDuration = opts.fadeDuration ?? 1000;

    // Sub-container is so we can have relative positioning without affecting top-level container userland styles.
    container.append(subContainer);
    subContainer.style.cssText = "position:relative; width:100%; height:100%;";

    [video1, video2].forEach(video => {
      video.style.cssText = `pointer-events:none; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; mix-blend-mode:plus-lighter; transition:opacity ${fadeDuration}ms ease-in-out;`;
      video.autoplay = true;
      // not sure why setAttribute is needed for these (unlike autoplay):
      video.setAttribute("muted", "");
      video.setAttribute("playsinline", ""); // prevent safari from opening it in fullscreen
      video.setAttribute("disablepictureinpicture", "");
      subContainer.appendChild(video);
    });

    video2.style.opacity = '0';

    let activeVideo = video1;
    let waitingVideo = video2;
    let isTransitioning = false;
    let currentSrc = "";

    function switchVideos() {
      if (isTransitioning) return;
      isTransitioning = true;

      waitingVideo.currentTime = 0;
      waitingVideo.play();

      waitingVideo.style.opacity = '1';
      activeVideo.style.opacity = '0';

      let prevActiveVideo = activeVideo;
      setTimeout(() => {
        prevActiveVideo.pause();
        prevActiveVideo.currentTime = 0;
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, fadeDuration);

      activeVideo = waitingVideo;
      waitingVideo = prevActiveVideo;
    }

    function onTimeUpdate() {
      const timeLeft = activeVideo.duration - activeVideo.currentTime;
      if (timeLeft <= (fadeDuration / 1000)) {
        let prevActiveVideo = activeVideo;
        prevActiveVideo.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
        switchVideos(); // caution: this function swaps active/waiting variables
        activeVideo.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
      }
    }

    // Add video-like properties and methods to container
    Object.defineProperties(container, {
      src: {
        get: () => currentSrc,
        set: (newSrc) => {
          currentSrc = newSrc;
          video1.src = video2.src = newSrc;
        },
      },
      paused: {
        get: () => activeVideo.paused,
      },
      currentTime: {
        get: () => activeVideo.currentTime,
        set: (time) => {
          activeVideo.currentTime = time;
          waitingVideo.currentTime = time;
        },
      },
      duration: {
        get: () => activeVideo.duration,
      },
    });

    container.play = () => {
      activeVideo.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
      return activeVideo.play();
    };
    container.pause = () => {
      video1.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
      video2.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
      video1.pause();
      video2.pause();
    };
    return container;
  }
  
  {
    let el = createCrossfadePseudoVideoElement({});
    el.id = "backgroundVideoEl";
    el.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%;";
    backgroundImageCtn.append(el);
  }
</script>

<script>
  window.initialDataLoadFinished = false;
  (async function() {
    // init multi-adventure system + load current adventure into UI
    try {
      await initStoriesSystem();
      try { renderMediaSelectOptions(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    } catch(e) {
      console.error(e);
      // fallback: just load blank adventure
      try { loadChatDataIntoInputAreas(getBlankStoryData()); } catch(e2) { console.error(e2); }
    }

    let hash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
    if(hash && hash.startsWith("data=") && !hash.startsWith("data=id:")) {
      let result = await loadDataFromUrlHash();
      if(result.success) {
        // clear hash after import, so refresh doesn't keep importing
        try { window.location.hash = ""; } catch(e) {}
      }
    }

    try { window.matchMedia("(orientation: portrait)").addEventListener("change", () => { try { updateBackgroundVisual(false); } catch(e) {} }); } catch(e) {}

    window.initialDataLoadFinished = true;
    checkOverlyLongFixedTokens();
    try { startExternalUpdateWatcher(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    try { scheduleImageGcSweep(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    try { if(localStorage.imageTrayOpen) openImageTray(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  })();
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if(document.hidden) {
      // best-effort immediate save (async, but usually fine)
      try { requestSaveCurrentStory({immediate:true}); } catch(e) {}
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", function() {
    try { requestSaveCurrentStory({immediate:true}); } catch(e) {}
  });
</script>

<script>
  // NOTE TO SELF: this is pretty self-contained. Just need to change storySoFarEl, storyOverviewEl, autoBackupsOuterEl, and autoBackupsListCtn to suit.
  (async function() {
    while(!window.initialDataLoadFinished) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));

    function getFileId() {
      return window.currentStoryId ?? (window.storyManager?.currentId ?? 0);
    }

    function getFileContentHash() { // just some roughly unique identifier of file to test if content has changed.
      return storySoFarEl.value + storyOverviewEl.value;
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////
    //             BACKUPS              //
    //////////////////////////////////////
    const maxAutoBackupInterval = 1000*60*5;
    const oldAutoBackupCleaningInterval = 1000*60*20;
    const maxAutoBackupAge = 1000*60*60*24*30;
    const maxAutoBackupsPerFile = 15;

    if(!window.autoBackupStateByStoryId) window.autoBackupStateByStoryId = {};
    function getStateForCurrentStory() {
      let id = getFileId();
      if(!window.autoBackupStateByStoryId[id]) {
        window.autoBackupStateByStoryId[id] = {
          lastAutoBackupTime: Date.now(),
          lastFileContentHashSeen: getFileContentHash(),
        };
      }
      return window.autoBackupStateByStoryId[id];
    }

    async function doAutoBackupIfNeeded() {
      let fileId = getFileId();
      let state = getStateForCurrentStory();
      if(Date.now()-state.lastAutoBackupTime < maxAutoBackupInterval) return; // at most once every few mins
      if(state.lastFileContentHashSeen === getFileContentHash()) return; // only if text has changed
      state.lastFileContentHashSeen = getFileContentHash();

      state.lastAutoBackupTime = Date.now();
      let backupsArray = await kv.autoBackups.get(fileId) || [];
      let data = getCurrentStoryData();
      backupsArray.unshift({creationTime:Date.now(), data});
      // if there are more than `maxAutoBackupsPerFile` backups, delete every second one in the second half of the array:
      if(backupsArray.length > maxAutoBackupsPerFile) {
        backupsArray = backupsArray.filter((backup, i) => i < maxAutoBackupsPerFile/2 ? true : i%2===0);
      }
      await kv.autoBackups.set(fileId, backupsArray);
      console.log(`Saved AUTO-backup for fileId=${fileId}. New backupsArray:`, backupsArray);
      renderAutoBackupsList();
    };

    async function forceAutoBackupNow() {
      let fileId = getFileId();
      let state = getStateForCurrentStory();
      state.lastFileContentHashSeen = getFileContentHash();
      state.lastAutoBackupTime = Date.now();
      let backupsArray = await kv.autoBackups.get(fileId) || [];
      let data = getCurrentStoryData();
      backupsArray.unshift({creationTime:Date.now(), data});
      if(backupsArray.length > maxAutoBackupsPerFile) {
        backupsArray = backupsArray.filter((backup, i) => i < maxAutoBackupsPerFile/2 ? true : i%2===0);
      }
      await kv.autoBackups.set(fileId, backupsArray);
      renderAutoBackupsList();
    }
    window.forceAutoBackupNow = forceAutoBackupNow;

    setTimeout(async () => {
      let persistent = await navigator.storage.persist();
      if(!persistent) console.warn("Browser denied persistent local storage.");
    }, 1000*60*20);

    setInterval(async () => {
      let changed = false;
      let entries = await kv.autoBackups.entries();
      // for *every* file they have backups for (not just the file they're currently viewing/editing):
      for(let [fileId, backupsArray] of entries) {
        let originalLength = backupsArray.length;
        // delete the backup array entries older than several weeks:
        backupsArray = backupsArray.filter(backup => Date.now()-backup.creationTime < maxAutoBackupAge);
        if(originalLength === backupsArray.length) continue;
        // save changes:
        if(backupsArray.length === 0) {
          await kv.autoBackups.delete(fileId);
          changed = true;
        } else {
          console.log(`Cleared ${originalLength-backupsArray.length} old auto-backups for fileId=${fileId}. New backupsArray:`, backupsArray);
          await kv.autoBackups.set(fileId, backupsArray);
          changed = true;
        }
      }
      if(changed) renderAutoBackupsList();
    }, oldAutoBackupCleaningInterval);

    window.loadAutoBackupClickHandler = function(index) {
      if(!confirm("⚠️ 𝗖𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Loading this backup will overwrite your current adventure. Please save your current adventure first if you want to keep it. Continue loading the selected backup?")) return;
      let backupObj = window.lastRenderedAutoBackupsArray[index];
      loadChatDataIntoInputAreas(backupObj.data);
      requestSaveCurrentStory({immediate:true});
      document.scrollingElement.scrollTop = 0;
      // update per-adventure hash state
      let state = getStateForCurrentStory();
      state.lastFileContentHashSeen = getFileContentHash();
    };

    window.deleteAllAutoBackupsClickHandler = async function() {
      if(!confirm("⚠️ 𝗖𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: This will delete the full list of auto-backup files for the CURRENT adventure. Are you sure?")) return;
      await kv.autoBackups.delete(getFileId());
      renderAutoBackupsList();
    };

    async function renderAutoBackupsList(opts={}) {
      let fileId = getFileId();
      let autoBackupsArray = await kv.autoBackups.get(fileId) || [];
      if(autoBackupsArray.length > 0) {
        window.lastRenderedAutoBackupsArray = autoBackupsArray;
        let html = autoBackupsArray.slice(0, opts.maxItems||999999).map((d, i) => `<li style="list-style-type:none; margin-top:${i===0 ? 0 : 0.25}rem; font-size:80%;"><button onclick="window.loadAutoBackupClickHandler(${i})" style="margin-right:0.25rem;">📦 load</button><span>${new Date(d.creationTime).toString().split(" ").slice(1, 5).join(" ").replace(/:[0-9][0-9]$/, "").replace(` ${new Date().getFullYear()} `, " ")}</span> (<b>browser storage</b>)</li>`).join("");
        autoBackupsListCtn.innerHTML = html;
        autoBackupsOuterEl.hidden = false;
      } else {
        autoBackupsListCtn.innerHTML = "";
        autoBackupsOuterEl.hidden = true;
      }
    }
    window.renderAutoBackupsList = renderAutoBackupsList;
    renderAutoBackupsList();

    let lastChangeHandlerCallTime = Date.now();
    storySoFarEl.addEventListener("input", function() {
      if(Date.now()-lastChangeHandlerCallTime < 1000) return;
      mainTextChangeHandler();
      lastChangeHandlerCallTime = Date.now();
    });
    storyOverviewEl.addEventListener("input", function() {
      if(Date.now()-lastChangeHandlerCallTime < 1000) return;
      mainTextChangeHandler();
      lastChangeHandlerCallTime = Date.now();
    });

    let doAutoBackupDebounceTimeout = null;
    function mainTextChangeHandler() {
      try {
        doAutoBackupIfNeeded();
        clearTimeout(doAutoBackupDebounceTimeout);
        doAutoBackupDebounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => { // without this, we can still lose up to 5 minutes of work, which is annoying
          doAutoBackupIfNeeded();
        }, maxAutoBackupInterval*1.2);
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    }

  })();
</script>


<script>
  window.continueTextButtonClickHandler = function() { // NOTE: this handler is also used for Tab key press event when the continue button is visible.
    if(storySoFarEl.selectionStart !== storySoFarEl.selectionEnd && storySoFarEl.value.slice(storySoFarEl.selectionEnd).trim() === "") { // they highlighted some text at the end of the chat logs and then clicked the continue button that appears above it
      storySoFarEl.value = storySoFarEl.value.slice(0, storySoFarEl.selectionStart);
      requestSaveCurrentStory({debounceMs:600});
    }
    continueStory({continueInline:true});
  };
  if(typeof continueTextBtn === "undefined") { // <-- just so, while generator is being edited, multiple buttons aren't created
    let tmp = document.createElement("div");
    tmp.innerHTML = `<button id="continueTextBtn" hidden style="position:absolute; cursor:pointer; font-size:65%; min-width:max-content;">▶️<span id="continueTextBtnTabLabel" hidden> (tab)</span></button>`;
    let btn = tmp.firstElementChild;
    btn.onmousedown = window.continueTextButtonClickHandler;
    
    let isTouchScreen = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
    if(!isTouchScreen && !localStorage.haveUsedTabToContinueText) btn.querySelector("#continueTextBtnTabLabel").hidden = false;
    
    storySoFarEl.view.scrollDOM.append(btn);
  }
  
  storySoFarEl.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if(e.key === 'Tab') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if(continueTextBtn.offsetHeight !== 0) {
        localStorage.haveUsedTabToContinueText = "1";
        continueTextBtnTabLabel.hidden = true;
        window.continueTextButtonClickHandler(); // if it's visible, and they press tab, then click it for them
      }
    } else if(storySoFarEl.value.length !== storySoFarEl.selectionEnd) {
      continueTextBtn.hidden = true;
    }
  });
  storySoFarEl.caret.observe(function(e) {
    if(storySoFarEl.selectionEnd < storySoFarEl.value.length-100) { // early exit optimization. and can't check if they're equal because we want to show button if only whitespace after cursor
      continueTextBtn.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    
    let lineHeight = e.offsetHeight;
        
    let textAfterSelectionEnd = storySoFarEl.value.slice(storySoFarEl.selectionEnd);
    let thereIsOnlyWhiteSpaceAfterCaret = /^\s*$/.test(textAfterSelectionEnd);
    
    if(e.isVisible && thereIsOnlyWhiteSpaceAfterCaret) {
      continueTextBtn.hidden = false;
      let buttonHeight = continueTextBtn.offsetHeight;
      if(storySoFarEl.selectionStart == storySoFarEl.selectionEnd) {
        continueTextBtn.style.left = `${e.offsetLeft + 15}px`;
        continueTextBtn.style.top = `${e.offsetTop - 0.5*(buttonHeight-lineHeight)}px`;
      } else {
        continueTextBtn.style.left = `${e.offsetLeft}px`;
        continueTextBtn.style.top = `${e.offsetTop - buttonHeight*1.3 - 0.5*(buttonHeight-lineHeight)}px`;
      }
    } else {
      continueTextBtn.hidden = true;
    }
  });
  
  storySoFarEl.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    continueTextBtn.hidden = true;
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if(!storySoFarEl.contains(event.target)) {
      continueTextBtn.hidden = true; // not sure why this is required in Chrome Android (blur event handler should be enough)
    }
  });
  
  // If down arrow pressed when caret is at bottom of storySoFarEl textarea, move caret to whatHappensNextEl, and vice versa for up arrow press when at top of whatHappensNextEl
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if(e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() !== 'textarea' && !storySoFarEl.contains(e.target)) return;
    
    let target = e.target;
    if(storySoFarEl.contains(target)) target = storySoFarEl;
    
    // Note that an element `contains()` itself.
    let isTopTextarea = storySoFarEl.contains(target);
    let isMiddleTextarea = whatHappensNextEl.contains(target);
    let isBottomTextarea = storyArcInstructionEl.contains(target);

    if(e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      if(isTopTextarea && target.selectionStart === target.value.length) {
        e.preventDefault();
        whatHappensNextEl.focus();
      }
      if(isMiddleTextarea && target.selectionStart === target.value.length) {
        e.preventDefault();
        storyArcInstructionEl.focus();
      }
    } else if(e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      if(isMiddleTextarea && target.selectionStart === 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        storySoFarEl.focus();
      }
      if(isBottomTextarea && target.selectionStart === 0) {
        e.preventDefault();
        whatHappensNextEl.focus();
      }
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  setInterval(async () => {
    let persistent = await navigator.storage.persist();
    if(persistent) console.log("Storage will not be cleared except by explicit user action.");
    else console.warn("Storage may be cleared by the browser under storage pressure.");
  }, 1000*60*15);
</script>

    padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .premadeCardPinBtn:not(.pinned) { opacity: 0.5; }
  .premadeCardBinBtn { margin-left: auto; }
  .premadeCardBinBtn:not(.binned) { opacity: 0.5; }
  .premadeCardImage {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    background-color: rgba(128,128,128,0.15);
  }
  .premadeCardText { padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem 0.45rem; }
  .premadeCardTitle { font-weight: bold; font-size: 78%; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
  .premadeCardDesc { font-size: 66%; opacity: 0.75; line-height: 1.3; }
  #backgroundAudioPlayerEl { height: 1.8rem; }
</style>

<div id="premadeAdventuresCtn" hidden>
  <div id="premadeFeedNote"><span id="premadeFeedNoteText">Adventure ideas based on popular anime and character cards. Bulk-converted to PG-13 using AI, not manually reviewed </span><button id="premadeFeedToggleBtn" onclick="togglePremadeFeedHidden()" style="font-size:90%; padding:0 0.4rem; box-shadow:none;">hide</button></div>
  <div id="premadeRowWrap">
    <div id="premadeAdventuresRow"></div>
    <div id="premadeAdventuresFadeRight"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  // Collapsible feed: "hide" collapses the cards row (note text shrinks to a "show" button);
  // state is remembered in localStorage. Runs at parse time so the first paint is correct.
  function applyPremadeFeedHidden() {
    let hidden = false;
    try { hidden = localStorage.premadeFeedHidden === "1"; } catch(e) {}
    premadeRowWrap.hidden = hidden;
    premadeFeedNoteText.hidden = hidden;
    premadeFeedToggleBtn.textContent = hidden ? "show adventure ideas" : "hide";
  }
  function togglePremadeFeedHidden() {
    try { localStorage.premadeFeedHidden = (localStorage.premadeFeedHidden === "1") ? "" : "1"; } catch(e) {}
    applyPremadeFeedHidden();
  }
  applyPremadeFeedHidden();
</script>
<script>
  // Lazy-load card images: only cards actually visible in the horizontal row
  // fetch their image; the rest load as they scroll into view.
  window.premadeCardImageObserver = null;
  function getPremadeCardObserver() {
    if(window.premadeCardImageObserver) return window.premadeCardImageObserver;
    window.premadeCardImageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for(let entry of entries) {
        if(!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
        let card = entry.target;
        let imgEl = card.querySelector(".premadeCardImage");
        if(card.dataset.bg && imgEl) imgEl.style.backgroundImage = `url(${card.dataset.bg})`;
        window.premadeCardImageObserver.unobserve(card);
      }
    }, {rootMargin: "120px"});
    return window.premadeCardImageObserver;
  }
  function getPremadePlayCounts() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.premadePlayCounts || "{}"); } catch(e) { return {}; }
  }
  function getPremadeTagCounts() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.premadeTagCounts || "{}"); } catch(e) { return {}; }
  }
  function recordPremadePlay(adv) {
    if(!adv?.id) return;
    try {
      let counts = getPremadePlayCounts();
      counts[adv.id] = (counts[adv.id] || 0) + 1;
      localStorage.premadePlayCounts = JSON.stringify(counts);
      let tagCounts = getPremadeTagCounts();
      for(let t of (adv.tags || [])) {
        t = String(t).trim().toLowerCase();
        if(t) tagCounts[t] = (tagCounts[t] || 0) + 1;
      }
      localStorage.premadeTagCounts = JSON.stringify(tagCounts);
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  function orderPremadeAdventures(list) {
    // score = direct plays (weighted) + affinity for tags the user has played;
    // then interleave: each even slot takes the best-scored remaining card,
    // each odd slot takes a RANDOM remaining card, so roughly every second
    // card is a discovery rather than more-of-the-same.
    let counts = getPremadePlayCounts();
    let tagCounts = getPremadeTagCounts();
    let pins = getPremadePinnedIds();
    let bins = getPremadeBinnedIds();
    let pinned = pins.map((id) => list.find((a) => a.id === id)).filter(Boolean);
    let binned = bins.map((id) => list.find((a) => a.id === id)).filter(Boolean);
    let rest = list.filter((a) => !pins.includes(a.id) && !bins.includes(a.id));
    let ranked = rest.map((a) => {
      // base score = editorial rating (default sort); plays and tag affinity dominate once the user has history
      let score = (a.rating || 0) + (counts[a.id] || 0) * 3;
      for(let t of (a.tags || [])) score += (tagCounts[String(t).trim().toLowerCase()] || 0);
      return {a, score};
    }).sort((x, y) => y.score - x.score).map((x) => x.a);
    let out = [];
    while(ranked.length) {
      out.push(ranked.shift());
      if(ranked.length) out.push(ranked.splice(Math.floor(Math.random() * ranked.length), 1)[0]);
    }
    return pinned.concat(out, binned);
  }
  function updatePremadeFadeColor() {
    // NOT in the scroll handler: getComputedStyle forces style recalc and janks scrolling
    try {
      let c = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor;
      if(c && c !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)") premadeAdventuresCtn.style.setProperty("--premade-fade-color", c);
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  function updatePremadeRowFade() {
    try {
      let el = premadeAdventuresRow;
      let atEnd = el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth >= el.scrollWidth - 4;
      let scrollable = el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 4;
      let ended = atEnd || !scrollable;
      if(ended !== premadeAdventuresCtn.classList.contains("premadeScrolledEnd")) {
        premadeAdventuresCtn.classList.toggle("premadeScrolledEnd", ended);
      }
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  function getPremadePinnedIds() {
    try { let a = JSON.parse(localStorage.premadePinnedIds || "[]"); return Array.isArray(a) ? a : []; } catch(e) { return []; }
  }
  function getPremadeBinnedIds() {
    try { let a = JSON.parse(localStorage.premadeBinnedIds || "[]"); return Array.isArray(a) ? a : []; } catch(e) { return []; }
  }
  function togglePremadePin(id) {
    if(!id) return;
    try {
      let pins = getPremadePinnedIds();
      if(pins.includes(id)) pins = pins.filter(p => p !== id);
      else {
        pins.unshift(id);
        localStorage.premadeBinnedIds = JSON.stringify(getPremadeBinnedIds().filter(b => b !== id)); // pinning un-bins
      }
      localStorage.premadePinnedIds = JSON.stringify(pins);
    } catch(e) {}
    renderPremadeAdventures();
  }
  function togglePremadeBin(id) {
    if(!id) return;
    try {
      let bins = getPremadeBinnedIds();
      if(bins.includes(id)) bins = bins.filter(b => b !== id);
      else {
        bins.push(id);
        localStorage.premadePinnedIds = JSON.stringify(getPremadePinnedIds().filter(p => p !== id)); // binning un-pins
      }
      localStorage.premadeBinnedIds = JSON.stringify(bins);
    } catch(e) {}
    renderPremadeAdventures();
  }
  function getPremadeShareLink(adv) {
    // the app runs in a sandboxed sub-iframe, so location.origin would give the
    // sandbox domain — build the public URL from the perchance generator name.
    // Format matches the share-link convention: #data=id:<premade_id>
    let genName = window.generatorName || location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, "") || "ai-rpg";
    return "https://perchance.org/" + genName + "#data=id:" + String(adv.id || "").replace(/-/g, "_");
  }
  function makePremadeCard(adv) {
    let card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "premadeCard";
    let main = document.createElement("button");
    main.type = "button";
    main.className = "premadeCardMain";
    main.title = "Start this adventure";
    let imgEl = document.createElement("div");
    imgEl.className = "premadeCardImage";
    let text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "premadeCardText";
    let titleEl = document.createElement("div");
    titleEl.className = "premadeCardTitle";
    titleEl.textContent = adv.title || "";
    let descEl = document.createElement("div");
    descEl.className = "premadeCardDesc";
    descEl.textContent = adv.shortDescription || "";
    text.append(titleEl, descEl);
    main.append(imgEl, text);
    main.onclick = () => startPremadeAdventure(adv);
    let btns = document.createElement("div");
    btns.className = "premadeCardBtns";
    let pinBtn = document.createElement("button");
    pinBtn.type = "button";
    pinBtn.className = "premadeCardPinBtn" + (getPremadePinnedIds().includes(adv.id) ? " pinned" : "");
    pinBtn.textContent = "\u{1F4CC}";
    pinBtn.title = getPremadePinnedIds().includes(adv.id) ? "Unpin from the start of the list" : "Pin to the start of the list";
    pinBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); togglePremadePin(adv.id); };
    let linkBtn = document.createElement("button");
    linkBtn.type = "button";
    linkBtn.className = "premadeCardLinkBtn";
    linkBtn.textContent = "\u{1F517}";
    linkBtn.title = "Copy a shareable link to this adventure";
    linkBtn.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(getPremadeShareLink(adv)).then(() => {
        linkBtn.textContent = "\u2705";
        setTimeout(() => { linkBtn.textContent = "\u{1F517}"; }, 1200);
      }).catch(() => prompt("Copy this link:", getPremadeShareLink(adv)));
    };
    let binBtn = document.createElement("button");
    binBtn.type = "button";
    binBtn.className = "premadeCardBinBtn" + (getPremadeBinnedIds().includes(adv.id) ? " binned" : "");
    binBtn.textContent = "\u{1F5D1}\uFE0F";
    binBtn.title = getPremadeBinnedIds().includes(adv.id) ? "Un-bin (restore normal position in the list)" : "Bin: move to the end of the list";
    binBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); togglePremadeBin(adv.id); };
    btns.append(pinBtn, linkBtn, binBtn);
    card.append(main, btns);
    // placeholder URLs (pre-upload) are skipped — card shows plain box
    if(adv.cardImage && !adv.cardImage.startsWith("UPLOAD:")) {
      card.dataset.bg = adv.cardImage;
      getPremadeCardObserver().observe(card);
    }
    return card;
  }
  // Only ~50 cards are in the DOM initially; more append as you scroll near
  // the right end (rendering hundreds up-front is pointless lag).
  const PREMADE_RENDER_CHUNK = 50;
  function appendMorePremadeCards() {
    let ordered = window.premadeOrderedList || [];
    let from = window.premadeRenderedCount || 0;
    let to = Math.min(ordered.length, from + PREMADE_RENDER_CHUNK);
    for(let i = from; i < to; i++) premadeAdventuresRow.append(makePremadeCard(ordered[i]));
    window.premadeRenderedCount = to;
  }
  function renderPremadeAdventures() {
    let list = window.premadeAdventures || [];
    if(!list.length) { premadeAdventuresCtn.hidden = true; return; }
    premadeAdventuresCtn.hidden = false;
    // tag-affinity ranking (base score = rating) with interleaved random discovery slots
    window.premadeOrderedList = orderPremadeAdventures(list);
    window.premadeRenderedCount = 0;
    let prevScroll = premadeAdventuresRow.scrollLeft;
    premadeAdventuresRow.innerHTML = "";
    appendMorePremadeCards();
    premadeAdventuresRow.scrollLeft = prevScroll;
    updatePremadeFadeColor();
    requestAnimationFrame(updatePremadeRowFade);
  }
  async function loadFullPremadeManifest() {
    let url = window.premadeAdventuresManifestUrl;
    if(!url || String(url).startsWith("UPLOAD:")) return;
    try {
      let full = await fetch(url).then((r) => r.json());
      if(Array.isArray(full) && full.length > (window.premadeAdventures || []).length) {
        window.premadeAdventures = full;
        renderPremadeAdventures();
      }
    } catch(e) { console.error("premade manifest load failed:", e); }
    checkPremadeHashLink();
  }
  // Deep links: #some_adventure_id (underscores) opens that premade adventure.
  // Runs once at startup against the embedded pre-cache, and again after the
  // full manifest loads (in case the id isn't in the top-10 pre-cache).
  async function checkPremadeHashLink() {
    try {
      if(window.premadeHashLinkHandled) return;
      let hash = (location.hash || "").slice(1);
      let m = /^data=id:([a-z0-9_-]+)$/i.exec(hash);
      if(!m) {
        // legacy bare-id form (#some_adventure_id); real share links (#data=<encoded>) are handled elsewhere
        if(!hash || hash.includes("=") || !/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(hash)) return;
        m = [hash, hash];
      }
      let id = m[1].toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, "-");
      let adv = (window.premadeAdventures || []).find((a) => a.id === id);
      if(!adv) return;
      window.premadeHashLinkHandled = true;
      // wait for the app's storage/init to be ready before creating the adventure
      while(!window.initialDataLoadFinished) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
      try { history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search); } catch(e) { location.hash = ""; }
      await startPremadeAdventure(adv);
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  premadeAdventuresRow.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    updatePremadeRowFade();
    let el = premadeAdventuresRow;
    if((window.premadeRenderedCount || 0) < (window.premadeOrderedList || []).length &&
       el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth > el.scrollWidth - 900) {
      appendMorePremadeCards();
    }
  }, {passive: true});
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => { updatePremadeFadeColor(); updatePremadeRowFade(); });
  function startPremadeMusicFadeIn(durationMs = 10000) {
    if(typeof backgroundAudioPlayerEl === "undefined") return;
    if(!(window.currentBackgroundMusic || "").trim()) return;
    let el = backgroundAudioPlayerEl;
    let targetVolume = 0.6; // matches updateMusicPlayback's default volume
    updateMusicPlayback(true); // counts as user-initiated (card click) so playback starts
    el.volume = 0; // after updateMusicPlayback, which resets volume to default
    let start = Date.now();
    if(window.premadeMusicFadeTimer) clearInterval(window.premadeMusicFadeTimer);
    window.premadeMusicFadeTimer = setInterval(() => {
      let t = (Date.now() - start) / durationMs;
      if(t >= 1 || (el.paused && t > 0.05)) {
        // done fading (or the user paused mid-fade) - restore normal volume for future plays
        el.volume = targetVolume;
        clearInterval(window.premadeMusicFadeTimer);
        window.premadeMusicFadeTimer = null;
        return;
      }
      el.volume = targetVolume * t;
    }, 250);
  }
  async function startPremadeAdventure(adv) {
    try {
      if(!Array.isArray(adv.starters)) {
        // slim pre-cache entry (feed fields only) — the full data lives in the manifest
        try { await window.premadeManifestPromise; } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
        adv = (window.premadeAdventures || []).find(a => a.id === adv.id) || adv;
        if(!Array.isArray(adv.starters)) { alert("This adventure's data is still loading - please try again in a moment."); return; }
      }
      let starters = Array.isArray(adv.starters) && adv.starters.length ? adv.starters : [""];
      let starter = starters[Math.floor(Math.random()*starters.length)] || "";
      // fixed context/intro paragraph always precedes the randomized opening
      let intro = (adv.intro || "").trim();
      let storyText = intro && starter ? intro + "\n\n---\n\n" + starter : (intro || starter);
      // not-yet-uploaded media has "UPLOAD:<path>" placeholders — treat as absent
      let realUrl = (u) => (u && !String(u).startsWith("UPLOAD:")) ? u : "";
      let bgLandscape = realUrl(adv.background?.landscape);
      let bgPortrait = realUrl(adv.background?.portrait);
      let customBackgrounds = [];
      if(bgLandscape) customBackgrounds.push({url: bgLandscape, title: (adv.title || "Adventure"), emoji: "\u{1F5BC}\uFE0F"});
      if(bgPortrait) customBackgrounds.push({url: bgPortrait, title: (adv.title || "Adventure") + " (mobile)", emoji: "\u{1F4F1}"});
      let customMusic = (adv.music || []).filter(m => realUrl(m.url)).map((m, i) => ({url: m.url, title: m.title || ("Track " + (i+1)), emoji: m.emoji || "\u{1F3B5}"}));
      let data = normalizeStoryData({
        storyOverview: adv.overview || "",
        storySoFar: storyText,
        backgroundVisual: bgLandscape,
        backgroundVisualMobile: bgPortrait,
        backgroundVisualMobileEnabled: !!bgPortrait,
        backgroundMusic: customMusic.length ? customMusic[Math.floor(Math.random()*customMusic.length)].url : "",
        musicRepeatMode: customMusic.length > 1 ? "next" : "repeat",
        hideDefaultMusic: customMusic.length > 0,
        customBackgrounds,
        customMusic,
      });
      await createNewStory({title: adv.title || "Premade adventure", data});
      recordPremadePlay(adv);
      try { startPremadeMusicFadeIn(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
      try { storySoFarEl.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"}); } catch(e) {}
    } catch(e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("Could not start this adventure: " + (e?.message || e));
    }
  }
  renderPremadeAdventures();
  checkPremadeHashLink();
  window.premadeManifestPromise = loadFullPremadeManifest(); // fetches the full list in the background; the embedded top-rated cards render instantly (awaited by startPremadeAdventure for slim pre-cache entries)
</script>

<ul style="font-size:80%; max-width:640px; margin:1rem auto; margin-top:2rem; padding-bottom:0.5rem; padding-left:1.125rem; padding-right:0.25rem; background:var(--box-color); border:1px solid var(--box-border-color); border-radius:3px;">
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">Once you begin your adventure, you can <b>manually edit</b> the story/adventure text by just tapping in the text box, and this is a good way to control the AI's writing style, since it'll tend to follow the writing style of the previous text. You can also set a custom writing style/mode using the drop-down menu above.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">This page uses your browser/device storage to <b>remember your adventures even after you refresh the page</b>. You can have multiple adventures - use the <b>📚 adventures</b> button at the top to create, switch, search, and organize them into folders. Your adventures are <b style="color:#e98721;">not</b> stored on a server. They're stored privately in your browser/device storage only. <b>Export/backup your adventures often</b> using the export button in the adventures panel.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;"><b>Please give feedback</b> using the button in the bottom-right corner of the screen. This is new and still being improved.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">If you want <i>extreme</i> of control over the AI's writing style, you can click the edit button in the top-right, and edit the text under <b>sharedInstructionPrefix</b>, <b>consequencesOfActionTaskInstruction</b> (and any other task instructions) in the left panel, and then click save to create your own custom copy of this generator, with its own URL.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">The <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-text-adventure" target="_blank">AI Text Adventure</a> page is similar, but it automatically gives you options to choose from at each step. And the <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?char=ai-adventure" target="_blank">AI Adventure</a> page allows <u>generating images</u> within the adventure.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">Also check out <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-story-generator" target="_blank">AI Story Generator</a> and <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-text-to-image-generator" target="_blank">AI Image Generator</a> and <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-generated-hierarchical-world" target="_blank">Hierarchical World Generator</a>.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">Prefer a chat/RP-style experience? Try the simple <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-chat" target="_blank">AI Chat</a> page, or the more advanced <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat" target="_blank">AI Character Chat</a> which can generate images within the chat.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">If some generated text is particularly bad or particularly good, please rate it with the thumbs up/down buttons to help improve the AI.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">If you scroll up in the adventure text once it has become long, you'll see that some special summary paragraphs have been inserted. Feel free to edit the content of these summaries, but don't move or delete them. <b>They help extend the AI's memory</b>. If you want to easily get the full adventure text without the summary paragraphs, you can click this button: <button id="copyStoryTextWithoutSummariesBtn" onclick="copyStoryTextToClipboardWithoutSummaries()">📋 copy adventure without summaries</button></li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">You can edit/fork the <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-rpg-template#edit" target="_blank">ai-rpg-template</a> page to create your own custom AI RPG game with a fixed story/world/etc.</li>
  <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">This generator is powered by the <a href="https://perchance.org/ai-text-plugin" target="_blank">ai-text-plugin</a>.</li>
</ul>

  <p id="commentsEl" style="display:none;"></p>
</div>
<script>
  function initTabbedComments() {
    commentsEl.innerHTML = "";
    commentsEl.append(tabbedCommentsPlugin({channels:commentChannels, defaultChannelOptions:defaultCommentOptions}));
  }
</script>

<!-- DARK MODE STUFF -->
<div id="leftFooterStickyButtonsCtn" style="position:fixed; bottom:0.5rem; left:0.5rem; z-index:10;">
  <button id="darkModeBtn" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.toggleManualDarkMode(); if(commentsEl.innerHTML.trim()){initTabbedComments()};">🌃</button>
  <div style="display:inline-block;">[fullscreenButton("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;⇱&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;⇲&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;")]</div>
</div>
<script>
  function toggleManualDarkMode() {
    let newColorScheme = (getCurrentColorScheme() === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
    localStorage.forceColorScheme = newColorScheme;
    setColorScheme(newColorScheme);
    // if chosen mode matches current OS default, we remove manual "forced" mode:
    let systemColorScheme = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? "dark" : "light";
    if(systemColorScheme === newColorScheme) {
      localStorage.removeItem("forceColorScheme");
    }
  }
  function getCurrentColorScheme() {
    if(localStorage.forceColorScheme !== undefined) {
      return localStorage.forceColorScheme;
    } else {
      return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? "dark" : "light";
    }
  }
  function setColorScheme(scheme) {
    if(scheme !== "dark" && scheme !== "light") throw new Error("scheme should be 'light' or 'dark'");
    document.querySelector("#darkModeBtn").textContent = (scheme === "dark" ? "🌄" : "🌃");
    window.colorScheme = scheme;
    if(scheme === "dark") {
      document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = "dark";
      document.body.style.color = "#d8d4cf";
      document.body.style.backgroundColor = "#131516";
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--box-color', '#2a2a2a');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--box-border-color', '#444');
    } else {
      document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = "light";
      document.body.style.color = "black";
      document.body.style.backgroundColor = "white";
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--box-color', '#ebebeb');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--box-border-color', '#bdbdbd');
    }
    // note: the textbox background/shadow CSS vars are set by applyThemeSettings() (theme system),
    // which runs via the onForcedColorSchemeChangeHandlers below.
    for(let fn of window.onForcedColorSchemeChangeHandlers) {
      try { fn({colorScheme:scheme}) } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    }
  }
  // during page load, set the chosen mode based on localStorage value if it exists:
  if(localStorage.forceColorScheme !== undefined) {
    setColorScheme(localStorage.forceColorScheme);
  } else {
    // user has not manually overwritten, so we use OS default:
    let systemIsInDarkMode = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
    setColorScheme(systemIsInDarkMode ? "dark" : "light");
  }
</script>
 


<!-- FEEDBACK STUFF -->
<div id="feedbackOuterCtn" style="position:fixed; bottom:0.5rem; right:0.5rem; text-align:right; z-index:100;">
  <div id="feedbackCommentsCtn" hidden style="margin-bottom:0.25rem;"></div>
  <button id="feedbackCommentsBtn" onclick="if(feedbackCommentsCtn.hidden) { feedbackCommentsCtn.hidden=false; if(!feedbackCommentsCtn.innerHTML) { feedbackCommentsCtn.innerHTML=generateFeedbackCommentsHtml(); } this.innerHTML='❌ close'; } else {  feedbackCommentsCtn.hidden=true; setTimeout(() => { if(feedbackCommentsCtn.hidden) {feedbackCommentsCtn.innerHTML=''} }, 20000); /* delay, to allow time for feedback to send */  this.innerHTML='🗨️ feedback'; }">🗨️ feedback</button>
</div>
<script>
  // Change the below variable to `false` to disable debug info (e.g. browser version, device type, localStorage size limits, etc.) with feedback submissions.
  // See   perchance.org/bug-report-plugin   for more info.
  let enableBrowserDebugInfoWithFeedback = true;
  
  if(enableBrowserDebugInfoWithFeedback) bugReport.initAutoErrorCapture(); // <-- must be initialized at page load
  
  function generateFeedbackCommentsHtml() {
    let options = {channel:"feedback", hideComments:location.hash.includes("#showfeedback") || localStorage.showFeedback ? false : true, height:location.hash.includes("#showfeedback") || localStorage.showFeedback ? 500 : 220, commentPlaceholderText: "Share some feedback about how I can improve this page. Do not share personal info, feedback comments are public.", submitButtonText: "submit feedback", hideSettingsButton:true, hideFullscreenButton:true};
    
    async function beforeSubmit({inputText}) {
      if(!inputText.trim()) return null;
      
      let url = await bugReport.createTemporaryDebugInfoUrl({ // this URL is not permanent - i.e. debug data is deleted after a few months. See   perchance.org/bug-report-plugin   for more info.
        customData: {
          storySoFarLength: storySoFarEl.value.length, // since very long stories cause some issues on slow/old devices
          timeSincePageLoad: Date.now()-window.pageLoadStartTime,
          storySoFarElInitialRenderTime: window.storySoFarElInitialRenderTime,
          storageEstimate: await navigator.storage.estimate(),
        },
        // Debug info is encrypted with this public key to increase user privacy. IF you're developing your own version of this generator, you can generate your own public/private key pairs here:  https://perchance.org/public-key-encryption-tool
        publicKey: "PUBLIC_1__PUBLIC_END",
      });
      return `${inputText}\n\nBrowser Debug Info:\n${url}`;
    }
    if(enableBrowserDebugInfoWithFeedback) options.beforeSubmit = beforeSubmit;
    
    if(localStorage.forceColorScheme) options.forceColorScheme = localStorage.forceColorScheme;
    com = root.commentsPlugin(options);
    return com;
  }
</script>



<script>
  // so bottom-sticky buttons don't clutter screen while typing:
  window.isTouchScreen = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
  if(isTouchScreen) {
    let maxSeenViewportHeight = window.visualViewport.height;
    let maxSeenFullscreenViewportHeight = window.screen.height;
    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      let isAlmostCertainlyInFullscreen = Math.abs(window.innerHeight-window.screen.height) / window.screen.height < 0.05;
      let keyboardIsProbablyShown;
      if(isAlmostCertainlyInFullscreen) { // measure fullscreen separately, else it messes up our non-fullscreen heuristic/ratio
        if(window.visualViewport.height > maxSeenFullscreenViewportHeight) maxSeenFullscreenViewportHeight = window.visualViewport.height;
        keyboardIsProbablyShown = window.visualViewport.height < 0.8*maxSeenFullscreenViewportHeight;
      } else {
        if(window.visualViewport.height > maxSeenViewportHeight) maxSeenViewportHeight = window.visualViewport.height;
        keyboardIsProbablyShown = window.visualViewport.height < 0.8*maxSeenViewportHeight;
      }
      leftFooterStickyButtonsCtn.hidden = keyboardIsProbablyShown;
      feedbackCommentsBtn.hidden = keyboardIsProbablyShown && feedbackCommentsCtn.hidden;
    });
  }
</script>


<script>
  try {
    let isTouchScreen = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
    let isSafari = navigator.vendor && navigator.vendor.indexOf('Apple') > -1 && navigator.userAgent && navigator.userAgent.indexOf('CriOS') == -1 && navigator.userAgent.indexOf('FxiOS') == -1;
    if(isSafari && window.innerWidth < 800 && isTouchScreen) {
      let viewportMetaEl = document.querySelector("[name=viewport]");
      if(!viewportMetaEl.getAttribute("content").includes("maximum-scale")) {
        viewportMetaEl.setAttribute("content", viewportMetaEl.getAttribute("content") + ", maximum-scale=1");
      }
      whatHappensNextEl.style.fontSize = "16px";
      storyArcInstructionEl.style.fontSize = "16px";
      console.log("Safari iOS detected. Added maximum-scale attribute and minimum font sizes to prevent zooming when clicking textarea with small font size:", viewportMetaEl.getAttribute("content"));
    }
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
  }
</script>

<style>
  button:disabled {
    filter: grayscale(1); /* since firefox doesn't seem to change emoji colors to indicate disabledness - only affects text */
  }
</style>

<script>
  // preload on mobiles after a few seconds of delay, to avoid causing lag on initial page load
  if(window.innerWidth < 500) setTimeout(() => ai({preload:true}), 5000);
  else ai({preload:true});
</script>

$output(...arr) =>
  if(arr.length === 1 && Array.isArray(arr[0])) arr = arr[0];

  return `<span style="position:relative;"><span>${arr[0]}</span>${arr.slice(1).map(e => `<span style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0;">${e}</span>`).join("")}</span>`;

          opts.onLoadMore(e.data.onLoadMoreData.comments);
        }
      } else if(e.data.type === "perchance_comments_load_more_no_more") {
        loadMoreButton.style.display = "none";
      } else if(e.data.type === "perchance_comments_finished_loading") {
        ctx.finishedLoading = true;
        for(let handler of ctx.finishedLoadingHandlers) {
          try { handler() } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
        }
        // hide the loader of the iframe:
        let ctn = document.querySelector(`.${e.data.iframeUniqueId}`).closest(".comments-plugin-ctn");
        // have to check if exists because i think with fullscreen button it's not in the ctn anymore:
        if(ctn) ctn.querySelector(".__perchance-comments-loading-facade-12345").style.display = "none";
        // and then tell it its parent origin:
        e.source.postMessage({parentOrigin:window.origin}, e.origin);
      } else if(e.data.type === "evaluateText") {
        // EDIT: This is unused, so I'm commenting it out. It's likely a very bad idea anyway, since it creates a larger XSS type attack surface stuff like send-me-a-secret-message where keys may be stored in localStorage
        // let result = e.data.text.evaluateItem;
        // e.source.postMessage({requestId:e.data.requestId, result}, e.origin);
      } else if(e.data.type === "before_submit_handler_call") {
        let result;

          try {
            result = await opts.beforeSubmit({inputText:e.data.inputText});
            if(result !== undefined) result = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result));
          } catch(e) {
            result = null; // IMPORTANT: return null if it fails, which cancels the submission. Important for cases like: perchance.org/send-me-a-secret-message where continue-submission-on-error is 'dangerous'
            alert(`beforeSubmit function failed with error: ${e.message}`);
            console.error(e);
          }
        }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); // important: allow e.g. set_input_el_text to be sent before this submit handler call is considered "done"
        e.source.postMessage({requestId:e.data.requestId, result}, e.origin);

          alert("Please refresh the page before testing newly-added commands.");
          return "";
        }
        slashCommands[commandName].input = argText;
        let resultText = slashCommands[commandName].output.evaluateItem;
        e.source.postMessage({requestId:e.data.requestId, resultText}, e.origin);

    return addMethodsToReturnValue(new String(containerHtml));

  if(!document.querySelector(`[data-comments-section-folder-name="${folderName}"]`)) {

    let markerEl = document.querySelector(`[data-marker-tag="temporaryMarkerElForCommentsPlugin84738932-folderName-${folderName}"]`);
    if(markerEl) {

## 02-perchance-dependencies/dynamic-import-plugin/main.pjs

```javascript
$output(generatorName, mode) =>
  if(generatorName === undefined) throw new Error(`You passed \`undefined\` (as the generator name) to the dynamic import plugin. For example, you wrote something like \`dynamicImport(foo)\`, but you hadn't yet put a generator name inside the 'foo' variable.`);
  if(window.moduleSpace.hasOwnProperty(generatorName)) { // if we've already got it:
    let root = window.moduleSpace[generatorName].getSelf;
    return root.hasOwnProperty("$output") ? root.$output : root;
  }
  
  // TODO: I should allow generatorName to be an array of names so they can be preloaded/loaded with a single request.
  //       And in that case it'd return an object like {foo:fooRootOr$output, bar:barRootOr$output, ...}
  
  if(!mode) mode = "sync";
  
  if(mode === "sync") {
    // *synchronously* download the lists text (and cache it):
    const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
    
    // This is endpoint is public, stable, and has a backwards-compatibility guarantee, so you're free to use it in your own plugins.
    // You give it a list of comma-separated names like generatorNames=foo,bar and it returns an object like {success:true, generators:{foo:{name:"foo", code:"...", imports:[...]}, bar: ... }
    request.open("GET", `https://perchance.org/api/getGeneratorsAndDependencies?generatorNames=${generatorName}`, false); // `false` makes the request synchronous
    request.send(null);

    if(request.status === 200) {
      let responseJson = JSON.parse(request.responseText);
      
      if(!responseJson.generators[generatorName]) throw new Error(`You passed '${generatorName}' to the dynamic import plugin, but the '${generatorName}' generator doesn't seem to exist.`);
      
      let root = createPerchanceTree(responseJson.generators[generatorName].code, {name:generatorName}); // since we specify the name, it gets added to window.moduleSpace
      
      function compileImports(root) {
        for(let name of root.$imports) {
          if(!window.moduleSpace.hasOwnProperty(name)) {
            if(responseJson.generators[name]) {
              console.log("compiling sub-import:", name, responseJson.generators[name]);
              let subImportRoot = createPerchanceTree(responseJson.generators[name].code, {name:name});
              compileImports(subImportRoot);
            } else {
              console.error(`Sub-import of '${generatorName}' named '${name}' doesn't seem to exist.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      compileImports(root);
      
      return root.hasOwnProperty("$output") ? root.$output : root;
    } else {
      console.error(`A generator named '${generatorName}' was not found by the dynamic import plugin.`);
      throw new Error(`A generator named '${generatorName}' was not found by the dynamic import plugin.`);
    }
    
  } else if(mode === "async" || mode === "preload") {
    return fetch(`https://perchance.org/api/getGeneratorsAndDependencies?generatorNames=${generatorName}`).then(r => r.json()).then(async responseJson => {
      if(!responseJson.generators[generatorName]) throw new Error(`You passed '${generatorName}' to the dynamic import plugin, but the '${generatorName}' generator doesn't seem to exist.`);
      
      let root = createPerchanceTree(responseJson.generators[generatorName].code, {name:generatorName});
      
      function compileImports(root) {
        for(let name of root.$imports) {
          if(!window.moduleSpace.hasOwnProperty(name)) {
            if(responseJson.generators[name]) {
              console.log("compiling sub-import:", name, responseJson.generators[name]);
              let subImportRoot = createPerchanceTree(responseJson.generators[name].code, {name:name});
              compileImports(subImportRoot);
            } else {
              console.error(`Sub-import of '${generatorName}' named '${name}' doesn't seem to exist.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      compileImports(root);
      
      return root.hasOwnProperty("$output") ? root.$output : root;
    });
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unknown 'mode' given to dynamic-import-plugin: '${mode}'. The valid modes are 'sync' and 'async' and 'preload'.`);
  }
````
