## 02-perchance-dependencies/fullscreen-button-plugin/main.pjs

```javascript
$output(text, exitText, style) => 
  if(!window.addedFullscreenEventListenerForPlugin39492749374) {
    window.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", function(event) {
      if(document.fullscreenElement) {
        for(let btn of [...document.querySelectorAll(".fullscreenButtonPluginButton938479832938")]) {
          btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset.exitText;
        }
      } else {
        for(let btn of [...document.querySelectorAll(".fullscreenButtonPluginButton938479832938")]) {
          btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset.text;
        }
      }
    });
    window.addedFullscreenEventListenerForPlugin39492749374 = true;
  }
  if(!document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) document.documentElement.requestFullscreen = document.documentElement.webkitRequestFullscreen || document.documentElement.mozRequestFullScreen || document.documentElement.msRequestFullscreen;
  if(!document.exitFullscreen) document.exitFullscreen = document.webkitExitFullscreen || document.mozCancelFullScreen || document.msExitFullscreen;
  if(!document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) {
    document.documentElement.requestFullscreen = function() {
      alert("The browser/device you're using doesn't support fullscreen mode.");
    };
  }
  if(!document.exitFullscreen) {
    document.exitFullscreen = function() {
      alert("The browser/device you're using doesn't support fullscreen mode.");
    };
  }
  return `<button class="fullscreenButtonPluginButton938479832938" data-text="${text || "Fullscreen"}" data-exit-text="${exitText || "Exit Fullscreen"}" onclick="(!document.fullscreenElement && !document.webkitFullscreenElement && !document.mozFullScreenElement && !document.msFullscreenElement) ? (document.documentElement.requestFullscreen(), this.innerHTML=this.dataset.exitText) : (document.exitFullscreen(), this.innerHTML=this.dataset.text)" style="line-height:1.2rem; ${style || ""}">${text || "Fullscreen"}</button>`;
````

## 02-perchance-dependencies/literal-plugin/main.pjs

```javascript
$output(text, opts) =>
  let out = text.replace(/(\\)*([\[\]{}])/g, function(m, p1, p2) {
    return (p1 ? "\\"+p1 : "") + "\\"+p2; // if there's a backslash (or group of backslashes) already before the square/curly bracket, then we need to add an extra backslash before that
  });
  if(opts === "+html") {
    out = out.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
  }
  return out;
````

```javascript
async $output(specs, opts) =>
  if(!opts) opts = {};
  opts = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(opts)); // so we can edit below without mutating inputs.
  
  let specEntries = Object.entries(specs);
  specEntries = specEntries.filter(e => e[1]);
  specs = Object.fromEntries(specEntries); // so 'null' can be specified as a value in the specs object, which means it gets entirely skipped
  
  let colorScheme = opts.colorScheme;
  if(!colorScheme) colorScheme = localStorage.forceColorScheme !== undefined ? localStorage.forceColorScheme : window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? "dark" : "light";

  if(!opts.backgroundColor) opts.backgroundColor = colorScheme=="light" ? "#e8e8e8" : "#151515";
  if(!opts.borderColor) opts.borderColor = colorScheme=="light" ? "#c8c8c8" : "#333";
  if(!opts.borderRadius) opts.borderRadius = "3px";
  
  function sanitizeHtml(text) {
    if(text === undefined) text = "";
    text = text+"";
    return text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");

  let ctn = document.createElement("div");

      sections += `
        <section class="structuredInputSection" data-is-hidden-extra="${spec.hidden === true ? "yes" : "no"}" style="${spec.hidden === true ? "display:none" : ""};">
          <div class="sectionLabel" style="${structuredSectionsI === 0 ? "margin-top:0;" : ""}">${spec.label}${spec.infoTooltip ? ` <span title="${sanitizeHtml(spec.infoTooltip)}" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="alert(this.title)">ℹ️</span>` : ""}</div>
          <div style="display:flex;">
            <div style="flex-grow:1;">
              <select data-spec-key="${sanitizeHtml(key)}" value="${sanitizeHtml(spec.defaultValue)}" ${spec.disabled === true ? "disabled" : ""} style="width:100%;height:100%; padding:0.25rem;">${spec.options.map(o => `<option value="${sanitizeHtml(o.value)}" ${o.value === spec.defaultValue ? "selected" :""}>${sanitizeHtml(o.content) || sanitizeHtml(o.value)}</option>`).join("")}</select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>`;
      structuredSectionsI++;
    } else if(spec.type == "textLine") {
      sections += `
        <section class="structuredInputSection" data-is-hidden-extra="${spec.hidden === true ? "yes" : "no"}" style="${spec.hidden === true ? "display:none" : ""};">
          <div class="sectionLabel" style="${structuredSectionsI === 0 ? "margin-top:0;" : ""}">${spec.label}${spec.infoTooltip ? ` <span title="${sanitizeHtml(spec.infoTooltip)}" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="alert(this.title)">ℹ️</span>` : ""}</div>
          <div style="display:flex;">
            <div style="flex-grow:1;">
              <input data-initial-focus="${spec.focus === true ? "yes" : "no"}" data-spec-key="${sanitizeHtml(key)}" ${spec.disabled === true ? "disabled" : ""} value="${sanitizeHtml(spec.defaultValue)}" style="width:100%;height:100%; padding: 0.25rem; ${spec.cssText || ""};" type="text" placeholder="${sanitizeHtml(spec.placeholder)}" ${spec.validationPattern ? `pattern="${sanitizeHtml(spec.validationPattern)}"` : ""} ${spec.disableSpellCheck ? `spellcheck="false"` : ``}>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>`;
      structuredSectionsI++;
    } else if(spec.type == "text") {
      sections += `
        <section class="structuredInputSection" data-is-hidden-extra="${spec.hidden === true ? "yes" : "no"}" style="${spec.hidden === true ? "display:none" : ""};">
          <div class="sectionLabel" style="${structuredSectionsI === 0 ? "margin-top:0;" : ""}">${spec.label}${spec.infoTooltip ? ` <span title="${sanitizeHtml(spec.infoTooltip)}" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="alert(this.title)">ℹ️</span>` : ""}</div>
          <div style="display:flex;">
            <div style="flex-grow:1;">
              <textarea data-initial-focus="${spec.focus === true ? "yes" : "no"}" data-spec-key="${sanitizeHtml(key)}" ${spec.height === "fit-content" ? `data-height="fit-content"` : ``} ${spec.disabled === true ? "disabled" : ""} style="width:100%; ${spec.height === "fit-content" ? "" : `height:${sanitizeHtml(spec.height)}`}; min-height:${spec.minHeight ?? "4rem"}; max-height:${spec.maxHeight ?? "50vh"}; padding:0.25rem; ${spec.cssText || ""};" type="text" placeholder="${sanitizeHtml(spec.placeholder)}" ${spec.disableSpellCheck ? `spellcheck="false"` : ``}>${sanitizeHtml(spec.defaultValue)}</textarea>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>`;
      structuredSectionsI++;
    } else if(spec.type == "buttons") {
      sections += `
        <section data-spec-key="${sanitizeHtml(key)}" class="structuredInputSection" data-is-hidden-extra="${spec.hidden === true ? "yes" : "no"}" style="${spec.hidden === true ? "display:none" : ""};">
          <div class="sectionLabel" style="${structuredSectionsI === 0 ? "margin-top:0;" : ""}">${spec.label ?? ""}${spec.infoTooltip ? ` <span title="${sanitizeHtml(spec.infoTooltip)}" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="alert(this.title)">ℹ️</span>` : ""}</div>
          <div style="display:flex;">
            <div style="flex-grow:1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(90px, 200px)); gap: 1rem; justify-content:center;">
              ${spec.buttons.map(b => `<button ${b.disabled === true ? "disabled" : ""} style="width:max-content; justify-self:center; align-self:center; border: 1px solid lightgrey; border-radius: 3px; padding:0.25rem; ${b.cssText || ""};">${b.text}</button>`).join(" ")}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>`;
      structuredSectionsI++;
    } else if(spec.type == "none") {
      sections += `
        <section data-spec-key="${sanitizeHtml(key)}" data-is-hidden-extra="${spec.hidden === true ? "yes" : "no"}" data-requires-element-insert="${typeof spec.html === "string" ? "no" : "yes"}" style="${spec.hidden === true ? "display:none" : ""};">
          ${typeof spec.html === "string" ? spec.html : ""}
        </section>`;
    }
    i++;
  }
  ctn.innerHTML = `
    <div class="promptModalInnerContainer" style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7); position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; z-index:9999999; display:flex; justify-content:center; ${opts.verticallyCenter ? "align-items:center;" : ""} color:inherit; color-scheme:${colorScheme}; ${colorScheme==="light" ? "color:black" : "color:#e7e7e7"}; font:inherit; padding:0.5rem; text-align:left;">
      <div style="width:600px; max-width:100%; background:${sanitizeHtml(opts.backgroundColor)}; height: min-content; padding:1rem; border:1px solid ${opts.borderColor}; border-radius:${opts.borderRadius}; box-shadow: 0px 1px 10px 3px rgb(130 130 130 / 24%); max-height: calc(100% - 1rem);display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
        <div class="sectionsContainer" style="overflow:auto;">
          ${sections}
          ${Object.values(specs).find(s => s.hidden === true) ? `
          <div style="text-align:center; margin-top:1rem; display:flex; justify-content:center;">
            <button class="showHidden" style="padding: 0.25rem;">${opts.showHiddenInputsText || "Show hidden inputs"}</button>
          </div>
          ` : ""}
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:center; margin-top:1rem; ${opts.cancelButtonText === null ? "" : `display:flex; justify-content:space-between;`}">
          ${opts.cancelButtonText === null ? "" : `<button class="cancel" style="padding: 0.25rem;">${opts.cancelButtonText ?? "cancel"}</button>`}
          <button class="submit" style="padding: 0.25rem; ${opts.submitButtonCssText || ''};">${opts.submitButtonText || "submit"}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <style>
        .promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer > section .sectionLabel {
          margin:0.125rem 0;
          margin-top: 1rem;
          font-size:85%;
        }
        .promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer input:invalid {
          background-color: lightpink;
        }
        .promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer {
          -ms-overflow-style: none;  /* Internet Explorer 10+ */
          scrollbar-width: none;  /* Firefox */
        }
        .promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer::-webkit-scrollbar { 
          display: none;  /* Safari and Chrome */
        }
        .promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer.scrollFade {
          padding-bottom: 30px;
          -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black calc(100% - 30px), #ffffff00 100%);
          mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black calc(100% - 30px), #ffffff00 100%);
        }
        .promptModalInnerContainer * {
          box-sizing: border-box;
        }
      </style>
    </div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(ctn);
  
  function updateFitHeights() { // settimeout to ensure rendered
    ctn.querySelectorAll("textarea[data-height=fit-content]").forEach(el => {
      let minHeight = el.offsetHeight; // textareas will always have min-height set, so we can use that via offsetHeight
      el.style.height = Math.max(minHeight, (el.scrollHeight+10)) + "px";
    });
  }

  setTimeout(updateFitHeights, 5);

  if(ctn.querySelector("button.showHidden")) {
    ctn.querySelector("button.showHidden").onclick = () => {
      ctn.querySelectorAll('.sectionsContainer [data-is-hidden-extra=yes]').forEach(el => {
        el.style.display='';
        el.dataset.isHiddenExtra = "no";
      });
      ctn.querySelector("button.showHidden").remove();
      updateFitHeights();
      updateInputVisibilies();
    };
  }

  // insert non-string HTML elements for type==html specs
  let elementObjects = Object.values(specs).filter(s => s.html && typeof s.html !== "string").map(s => s.html);
  ctn.querySelectorAll('.sectionsContainer [data-requires-element-insert=yes]').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.append(elementObjects[i]);
  });

  // add onclick handlers for type==button specs
  let buttonSpecKeys = Object.entries(specs).filter(([key, spec]) => spec.type === "buttons").map(([key, spec]) => key);
  for(let key of buttonSpecKeys) {
    ctn.querySelectorAll(`.sectionsContainer [data-spec-key=${key}]`).forEach(el => {
      let buttonEls = [...el.querySelectorAll("button")];
      for(let i = 0; i < buttonEls.length; i++) {
        buttonEls[i].onclick = specs[key].buttons[i].onClick;
      }
    });
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    // add scrollFade if sectionsContainer has scroll
    let sectionsContainerEl = ctn.querySelector(".promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer");
    if(sectionsContainerEl.scrollHeight > sectionsContainerEl.offsetHeight) {
      sectionsContainerEl.classList.add("scrollFade");
    }
    // focus
    let focusEl = ctn.querySelector(".promptModalInnerContainer .sectionsContainer [data-initial-focus=yes]");
    if(!focusEl) focusEl = [...ctn.querySelectorAll(".promptModalInnerContainer input, .promptModalInnerContainer textarea")][0];
    if(focusEl) {
      focusEl.focus();
      focusEl.selectionStart = focusEl.value.length;
    }
  }, 5);
  
  function getAllValues() {
    let values = {};
    for(let el of [...ctn.querySelectorAll("[data-spec-key]")]) {
      if(el.tagName === "INPUT") {
        if(el.type == "file") {
          values[el.dataset.specKey] = el.files;
        } else {
          values[el.dataset.specKey] = el.value;
        }
      } else if(el.tagName === "TEXTAREA") {
        values[el.dataset.specKey] = el.value;
      } else if(el.tagName === "SELECT") {
        values[el.dataset.specKey] = el.value;
      }
    }
    return values;
  }

  // a spec can have a `show` function which determines whether it's shown based on the values of the other inputs
  function updateInputVisibilies() {
    const values = getAllValues();
    for(const el of [...ctn.querySelectorAll("[data-spec-key]")]) {
      const showFn = specs[el.dataset.specKey].show;
      if(!showFn) continue;
      if(showFn(values)) {
        el.closest('section').style.display = "";
      } else {
        el.closest('section').style.display = "none";
      }

      // the "show advanced" hidden-ness overrides the show() function
      if(el.closest("section").dataset.isHiddenExtra === "yes") {
        el.closest("section").style.display = "none";
      }
    }
  }
  updateInputVisibilies();
  for(const el of [...ctn.querySelectorAll("[data-spec-key]")]) {
    el.addEventListener("input", updateInputVisibilies);
  }
  
  // add onChange handlers, if any:
  try {
    for(let [key, value] of Object.entries(specs)) {
      if(value.type === "select" && typeof value.onChange === "function") {
        ctn.querySelector(`.sectionsContainer [data-spec-key=${key}]`).addEventListener("change", function() {
          let data = getAllValues();
          let originalData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
          value.onChange(data); // if this handler edits the data, then we propagate those edits to the actual inputs
          let thereWereDataChanges = false;
          for(let k in originalData) {
            if(data[k] !== originalData[k]) {
              // todo: propagate change events?
              ctn.querySelector(`.sectionsContainer [data-spec-key=${k}]`).value = data[k];
              thereWereDataChanges = true;
            }
          }
          if(thereWereDataChanges) updateInputVisibilies();
        });
      }
    }
  } catch(e) { console.error(e); } // try/catch because it's new code

  let promptResolver;

  if(opts.controls) {
    // add a proxy to the controls object so that we can read and write spec values from the outside
    opts.controls.data = new Proxy({}, {
      set: function(obj, prop, value) {
        let el = ctn.querySelector(`[data-spec-key=${prop}]`);
        if(!el) return true;
        el.value = value;
        updateInputVisibilies();
        return true;
      },
      get: function(obj, prop) {
        let el = ctn.querySelector(`[data-spec-key=${prop}]`);
        if(!el) return undefined;
        return el.value;
      }
    });
    opts.controls.submit = function() {
      ctn.querySelector("button.submit").click();
    };
    opts.controls.cancel = function() {
      promptResolver(null);
    };
  }

  let values = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    promptResolver = resolve;
    ctn.querySelector("button.submit").onclick = () => {
      let values = getAllValues();
      resolve(values);
    };
    if(ctn.querySelector("button.cancel")) {
      ctn.querySelector("button.cancel").onclick = () => {
        resolve(null);
      };
    }
  });
  ctn.remove();
  return values;
````

```javascript
      <input class="tabbed-comments-auto-comment-auto-send-checkbox" onchange="localStorage.__tabbedCommentsAutoCommentAutoSendCheckboxValue=this.checked?'1':''; " style="cursor:pointer;" type="checkbox">
      <div onclick="this.closest('.tabbed-comments-plugin-outer-ctn').querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-auto-send-checkbox').click()" style="margin-left:0.25rem; cursor:pointer; user-select:none;">auto-send?</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  
  let rightCtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-ctn-right');
  let middleCtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-ctn-middle');
  let leftCtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-ctn-left');
  
  let showAutoCommentAreaBtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-show-auto-comment-area-btn');
  let autoCommentCtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-ctn');
  let autoCommentCharBtn = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-char-btn');
  let autoCommentCharSelectEl = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-char-select');
  let autoCommentCharNameEl = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-char-name');
  let autoCommentCharNameDescriptionEl = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-char-description');
  let autoCommentAutoSendCheckboxEl = outerCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-auto-comment-auto-send-checkbox');
  
  let middleCtnCurrentlyShownCommentsChannelName;
  
  let sidePanelObjs = new Set();
  let middlePanelObj;
  let middleCtnChannelNameToObj = {};
  let allPanelObjs = new Set();

  function getConfiguredChannelName(commentOptions) {
    if(typeof commentOptions === "string") return commentOptions.toString();
    if(!commentOptions.channel) return (commentOptions.getName==="general" ? "" : commentOptions.getName).toString();
    return commentOptions.channel.toString();
  }

  let configuredDefaultChannelNames = new Set(commentsChannels.selectAll.map(getConfiguredChannelName));

  function isConfiguredDefaultChannel(channel) {
    return configuredDefaultChannelNames.has(channel);
  }

  function isStoredCustomChannel(channel) {
    return channel !== "" && !isConfiguredDefaultChannel(channel);
  }

  function readStoredCustomChannels() {
    if(!localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginCustomChannels) localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginCustomChannels = "{}";
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginCustomChannels);
    } catch(e) {
      console.error("Failed to parse custom channels from localStorage:", e);
      return {};
    }
  }

  function writeStoredCustomChannels(customChannels) {
    localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginCustomChannels = JSON.stringify(customChannels);
  }

  function getStoredCustomChannelEntriesInOrder() {
    return Object.entries(readStoredCustomChannels())
      .map(([key, commentOptions]) => ({ key, commentOptions, channel: commentOptions?.channel?.toString() }))
      .filter(({ channel }) => channel && isStoredCustomChannel(channel));
  }

  function syncOpenPanelsToStoredCustomChannelState() {
    for(let panelObj of [...allPanelObjs]) {
      if(!document.body.contains(panelObj.element)) {
        allPanelObjs.delete(panelObj);
        continue;
      }
      panelObj.syncPanelCustomChannelsFromStorage();
    }
  }

  function moveStoredCustomChannel(channel, direction) {
    let customChannels = readStoredCustomChannels();
    let channelEntries = Object.entries(customChannels);
    let currentIndex = channelEntries.findIndex(([, commentOptions]) => commentOptions?.channel?.toString() === channel);
    let nextIndex = currentIndex + (direction === "left" ? -1 : 1);
    if(currentIndex < 0 || nextIndex < 0 || nextIndex >= channelEntries.length) return;
    [channelEntries[currentIndex], channelEntries[nextIndex]] = [channelEntries[nextIndex], channelEntries[currentIndex]];
    writeStoredCustomChannels(Object.fromEntries(channelEntries));
    syncOpenPanelsToStoredCustomChannelState();
  }
  
  function updateColorScheme() {
    let systemColorScheme = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? "dark" : "light";
    if(localStorage.forceColorScheme === "dark" || (!localStorage.forceColorScheme && systemColorScheme === "dark")) {
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-text-color', '#efefef');
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-box-color', '#2a2a2a');
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-active-comment-channel-tab-color', '#3f3f3f');
    } else {
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-text-color', '#222');
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-box-color', '#ebebeb');
      outerCtn.style.setProperty('--tabbed-comments-plugin-active-comment-channel-tab-color', '#c6c6c6');
    }
    outerCtn.querySelectorAll("[data-tabbed-comments-direct-parent-of-comments-plugin-putput='1']").forEach(el => {
      let commentOptions = el.__commentOptionsUsed;
      commentOptions.forceColorScheme = defaultChannelOptions.forceColorScheme ?? localStorage.forceColorScheme ?? null
      el.innerHTML = commentsPlugin(commentOptions);
    });
  }
  updateColorScheme();
  
  let colorSchemeMediaQuery = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)"); 
  colorSchemeMediaQuery.addEventListener("change", updateColorScheme);
  
  let localStorageChangeHandler = function(e) { 
    if(!document.body.contains(outerCtn)) { // prevent memory leak
      window.removeEventListener("storage", localStorageChangeHandler);
      colorSchemeMediaQuery.removeEventListener("change", updateColorScheme);
      return;
    }
    if(e.key === "forceColorScheme") {
      updateColorScheme();
    } else if(e.key === "__tabbedCommentsPluginCustomChannels") {
      syncOpenPanelsToStoredCustomChannelState();
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener("storage", localStorageChangeHandler);
  let storageListenerInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if(!document.body.contains(outerCtn)) { // prevent memory leak
      window.removeEventListener("storage", localStorageChangeHandler);
      colorSchemeMediaQuery.removeEventListener("change", updateColorScheme);
      clearInterval(storageListenerInterval);
    }
  }, 1000*30);
  
  function updateMiddleTabModuleWidth() {
    if(leftCtn.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-tabs-module-button") && rightCtn.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-tabs-module-button")) {
      // both side modules are closed, so prevent it from getting too big:
      middleCtn.style.maxWidth = "min(800px, 100vw)";
      leftCtn.style.width = "";
      middleCtn.style.width = "100%";
      rightCtn.style.width = "";
    } else {
      // at least one is open, so make them take up thirds
      middleCtn.style.maxWidth = "";
      leftCtn.style.width = "33.3%";
      middleCtn.style.width = "33.3%";
      rightCtn.style.width = "33.3%";
    }
    
    if(!opts.fillHeight) {
      if(leftCtn.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-tabs-module-button") || rightCtn.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-tabs-module-button")) {
        // at least one is closed, so restore normal height
        middleCtn.style.minHeight = "";
        leftCtn.style.minHeight = "";
        rightCtn.style.minHeight = "";
      } else {
        // both side panels are open, so make the whole section taller
        middleCtn.style.minHeight = "90vh";
        leftCtn.style.minHeight = "90vh";
        rightCtn.style.minHeight = "90vh";
      }
    }
  }
  function initSideButton(side) {
    let buttonHtml = `<button class="tabbed-comments-plugin-add-tabs-module-button" style="margin-${side==="left" ? "right" : "left"}:0.5rem; padding:1px 6px;">+</button>`;
    let ctn = outerCtn.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-ctn-"+side);
    ctn.innerHTML = buttonHtml;
    ctn.querySelector("button").onclick = function() {
      ctn.innerHTML = "";
      let obj = createTabbedCommentsPanel({
        addCloseButton:true,
        onClose: function() {
          sidePanelObjs.delete(obj);
          setTimeout(() => {
            initSideButton(side);
            updateMiddleTabModuleWidth();
          }, 10);
        }
      });
      ctn.appendChild(obj.element);
      sidePanelObjs.add(obj);
      updateMiddleTabModuleWidth();
    };
  }
  initSideButton("left");
  initSideButton("right");
  
  
  
  
  
  
  /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  //     CHANNEL MENTIONS, SEEN/UNSEEN COUNTING, ETC.    //
  /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  let unseenCommentCountByChannel = {};
  function updateUnseenCountHtml(channel) {
    let count = unseenCommentCountByChannel[channel];
    for(let tabCtn of [...outerCtn.querySelectorAll(".tabbed-comments-plugin-ctn")]) {
      let countEl = tabCtn.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}'] .tabbed-comments-plugin-unseen-count`);
      if(countEl) { // since this tabCtn may not have that particular tab
        countEl.textContent = count;
        countEl.style.background = (count > 0) ? "#ab0e0e" : "";
        countEl.style.display = (count > 0) ? "inline" : "none";
      }
    }
  }

  let knownMessageIdsByChannel = {};
  let lastCurrentUserCommentTime = null;
  function commentsPluginOnLoadHandler(comments) {
    for(let comment of comments) {
      processCommentForUnseenCounts(comment);
      if(comment.byCurrentUser) {
        lastCurrentUserCommentTime = Date.now();
      }
    }
    if(comments[0]) unseenCommentCountByChannel[comments[0].channel] = 0; // reset unseen count since above `processCommentForUnseenCounts` has incremented it
    processCommentsForTempChannels(comments.slice(-30));
  }
  function commentsPluginOnCommentHandler(comment) {
    processCommentForUnseenCounts(comment);
    if(comment.byCurrentUser) {
      lastCurrentUserCommentTime = Date.now();
    }
    processCommentsForTempChannels([comment]);
  }
  function processCommentForUnseenCounts(comment) {
    // console.log("new comment:", comment);
    let channel = comment.channel;
    // initialize if we haven't yet:
    if(!knownMessageIdsByChannel[comment.channel]) knownMessageIdsByChannel[channel] = new Set();

    // increment the unseen count if we haven't seen this comment id before:
    if(!knownMessageIdsByChannel[channel].has(comment.id)) {
      knownMessageIdsByChannel[channel].add(comment.id);
      unseenCommentCountByChannel[channel] = (unseenCommentCountByChannel[channel] || 0) + 1;

      let tabIsVisible = false; // check if it's visible in any of the tabbedCommentsCtn elements
      for(let tabCtn of [...outerCtn.querySelectorAll(".tabbed-comments-plugin-ctn")]) {
        let tabContentEl = tabCtn.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channel}']`);
        if(tabContentEl && tabContentEl.offsetHeight !== 0) tabIsVisible = true;
      }
      if(tabIsVisible) { // set unseen count to 0 if tab is visible
        unseenCommentCountByChannel[channel] = 0;
      }
      updateUnseenCountHtml(channel);
    }
  }
  function attachEventsToTemporaryMentionedChannelTab(tabEl, channelName) {
    tabEl.addEventListener("click", function() {
      if(!tabEl.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel) return;
      promoteTemporaryMentionedChannel(channelName);
    });
  }
  function clearTemporaryMentionedChannel(channelName) {
    for(let t of [...outerCtn.querySelectorAll(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-ctn .tabbed-comments-plugin-header .tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channelName}']`)]) {
      t.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel = "";
    }
  }
  function promoteTemporaryMentionedChannel(channelName) {
    clearTemporaryMentionedChannel(channelName);
    if(middlePanelObj) middlePanelObj.addCommentsChannel(channelName);
  }
  
  // to rate limit mentions:
  let userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes = {};
  setInterval(() => {
    userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes = {};
  }, 1000*60*2);

  function isValidFolderName(folderName) {
    // examples of valid folder names:
    // foo
    // foo+channelname
    // foo+channelname+u:username1
    // foo+channelname+u:username1|username2

    let parts = folderName.split("+");
    if(parts.length > 3) return false;
    let name = parts[0] + (parts[1] ? `+${parts[1]}` : "");
    let rules = parts[2];
    
    let nameIsValid = name && /^[a-z0-9\-+]+$/.test(name) && name.split("+").length <= 2 && !name.endsWith("+");
    let rulesIfAnyAreValid = true;
    if(rules) rulesIfAnyAreValid = /^u:[a-z0-9|]+$/.test(rules) && !/\|\|/.test(rules) && !/:\|/.test(rules) && !rules.endsWith("|");
    return nameIsValid && rulesIfAnyAreValid;
  }
  
  function processCommentsForTempChannels(comments) {
    if(commentsChannels.allowCustomChannels === false) return;
    for(let comment of comments) {
      let mentionedChannelName = comment.message.match(/(\s|^)#[a-z0-9\-\+\|:]+(\s|$)/g)?.[0];
      if(mentionedChannelName && !isValidFolderName(window.generatorName+"+"+mentionedChannelName.trim().replace(/^#/, "").trim())) mentionedChannelName = "";
      if(mentionedChannelName && !/^[0-9]+$/.test(mentionedChannelName)) { // if it's all numbers, ignore
        mentionedChannelName = mentionedChannelName.trim().replace(/^#/, "").trim(); // remove the hash from the start and whitespace from start/end
        if(mentionedChannelName === "feedback") continue;
        if(!userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes[comment.user.id]) userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes[comment.user.id] = [];
        if(userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes[comment.user.id].length >= 10) continue;
        // add it as a temporary channel which self-deletes after a short timeout.
        // it upgrades to a real one when clicked.
        if(middlePanelObj) { // <-- just in case somehow hasn't initialized yet, or whatever

          // If they've got the tab *somewhere* (e.g. in side module), then we don't add it as a temporary channel.
          let alreadyExistsSomewhere = !!outerCtn.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-ctn .tabbed-comments-plugin-header .tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${mentionedChannelName}']`);

          let { tab, alreadyExisted } = middlePanelObj.addTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel(mentionedChannelName);
          userIdToMentionedChannelsInLast2Minutes[comment.user.id].push(mentionedChannelName);
          
          if(!alreadyExisted && !alreadyExistsSomewhere) {
            let newTabs = [];
            newTabs.push(tab);

            try { // because it's new code
              for(let obj of sidePanelObjs) {
                let { tab } = obj.addTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel(mentionedChannelName);
                newTabs.push(tab);
              }
            } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

            for(let newTab of newTabs) {
              newTab.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel = "1";
              attachEventsToTemporaryMentionedChannelTab(newTab, mentionedChannelName);
            }
            // make its background blink for a couple of seconds:
            let blinkCount = 0;
            let blinkInterval = setInterval(() => {
              tab.style.background = blinkCount%2===0 ? "#043a9b" : "";
              blinkCount++;
              if(blinkCount > 5) clearInterval(blinkInterval);
            }, 300);
            setTimeout(() => {
              if(document.body.contains(tab) && tab.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel) {
                for(let obj of [...sidePanelObjs, middlePanelObj]) {
                  obj.removeTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel(mentionedChannelName);
                }
              }
            }, 1000*40);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  
  
  
  
  /////////////////////////////////////////////
  //         BOT/AUTO-COMMENT STUFF          //
  /////////////////////////////////////////////
  let autoCommentChars = [];
  if(localStorage.autoCommentChars) {
    try { autoCommentChars = JSON.parse(localStorage.autoCommentChars); } catch(e) { alert(e); }
    autoCommentChars = autoCommentChars.filter(c => c && c.name);
  }
  function getAutoCommentNameFromUserLabel(userLabel) {
    let labelWithoutNonNameCharacters = userLabel.replace(/[\n\-:|()!{}*]/g, "").replace(/(?![*#0-9]+)[\p{Emoji}\p{Emoji_Modifier}\p{Emoji_Component}\p{Emoji_Modifier_Base}\p{Emoji_Presentation}]/gu, '');
    let words = labelWithoutNonNameCharacters.split(/[|/ \-})]/g).map(w => w.trim()).filter(w => w);
    while(words.slice(0, -1).join("_").length > 25) words.pop(); // we remove the last one for the length check in case it's a name like One Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious - better for userTag to be "OneSupercalif" than "One"
    if(words.slice(0, -1).join("_").length > 15) words.pop(); // we probably don't need the last word if all the earlier ones are over 15 characters
    let name = words.join("_").trim().toLowerCase();
    return name + (userLabel.length > 25 ? "…" : "");
  }
  window[`__${globalFnsId}_tabbedCommentsPluginAutoComment`] = function(character) {
    let commentsBox = middleCtnChannelNameToObj[middleCtnCurrentlyShownCommentsChannelName];
    if(commentsBox.channel === "n/o/-/a/i".replaceAll("/", "")) return;

    let startTime = Date.now();
    autoCommentCharBtn.disabled = true;
    autoCommentCharBtn.textContent = "⏳ just a sec...";

    let currentUser = commentsBox.comments.find(c => c.byCurrentUser)?.user;
    let comments = commentsBox.comments.slice(-500).map(c => {
      let visualId = c.user.visualId.toUpperCase();
      let userTag = visualId;
      let userName = c.user.name ? getAutoCommentNameFromUserLabel(c.user.name) : "";
      let nickname = c.user.nickname ? getAutoCommentNameFromUserLabel(c.user.nickname) : "";
      let labels = [userName, nickname].filter(Boolean);
      if(labels.length) userTag = `${visualId}(${labels.join(" / ")})`;
      return `${userTag}: ${c.message.trim().replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")}`;
    });
    while(comments.join("").length > 10000) comments.shift();

    let nicknameOverride = character.name.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 50);
    let currentUserVisualId = currentUser ? currentUser.visualId.toUpperCase() : "U7OP"; // just use a random/arbitrary tag if we don't have the user's actual one (we'll get it once they've made their first comment)
    let respondingUserTag = `${currentUserVisualId}(${character.name})`;
    let characterDescription = character.description.replace(/\n/g, " ").slice(0, 5000);

    let newCommentText = ""; //commentsBox.inputText.trim().replace(/\n/g, " ").split(" ").slice(0, 3);
    let obj = generateText({ // NOTE: perchance removes all leading spaces from lines, so we don't need to dedent the lines below
      instruction: `
      Your task is to write the next 5 messages in the following chat/roleplay. Keep it interesting. Stay in character based on the previous messages. You are **NOT** an AI. You are writing as a regular chat participant, not as an AI. When writing ${respondingUserTag}'s messages, you can ignore the off-topic/OOC/spam/commentary chat messages and focus on the roleplay messages that are actually a part of the story. Predict what the characters in this chat/roleplay are most likely to say next, and then write it **EXACTLY** as the chat participants would, based on what they've previously said.
      IMPORTANT: Here's a description of ${respondingUserTag}: ${characterDescription}.

      <MESSAGES>
      ${comments.slice(0, -4).join("\n\n---\n\n").trim() || `(None yet. Start the chat/roleplay with an interesting starter message.)`}
      </MESSAGES>

      Again, your task is to write the next 5 messages. Make sure your writing is interesting, authentic, descriptive, natural, engaging, and creative. Create a captivating and genuinely fascinating roleplay, and always stay in-character and write responses based on the previous chat context. Don't be boring. Keep the roleplay flowing!
      As a reminder about the ${respondingUserTag} character: ${characterDescription.slice(0, 500) + (characterDescription.length > 1000 ? "..." : "")}
      `.trim(),
      startWith: comments.slice(-4).join("\n\n---\n\n")+"\n\n---\n\n"+respondingUserTag+": "+newCommentText,
      stopSequences: ["\n\n", "</MESSAGES>"],
      onChunk: function(data) {
        if(data.isFromStartWith) return;
        newCommentText += data.textChunk; 
        if(newCommentText.includes("</MESSAGES>")) {
          newCommentText = newCommentText.replace(/<\/MESSAGES>/g, "").trim();
          obj.stop();
        }
        commentsBox.inputText = newCommentText.trim();

        // if really long, or repeating a single character, stop:
        if(newCommentText.length > 800 || newCommentText.slice(-30) === newCommentText[newCommentText.length-1].repeat(30)) {
          obj.stop();
        }
      },
      onFinish: async function() {
        autoCommentCharBtn.disabled = false;
        autoCommentCharBtn.textContent = "🧝 write as character";

        if(/\n---\s*$/.test(commentsBox.inputText)) {
          commentsBox.inputText = commentsBox.inputText.replace(/\n---\s*$/g, "");
          newCommentText = newCommentText.replace(/\n---\s*$/g, "");
        }

        if(autoCommentAutoSendCheckboxEl.checked) {
          if(newCommentText.trim()) {
            if(lastCurrentUserCommentTime && Date.now()-lastCurrentUserCommentTime < 3000) {
              // too soon to submit again, so just set nickname and let them click submit manually
              commentsBox.setNicknameForNextComment(nicknameOverride);
              autoCommentCharBtn.textContent = "submitting too fast";
              setTimeout(() => {
                autoCommentCharBtn.textContent = "🧝 write as character";
              }, 1000);
            } else {
              commentsBox.submit(newCommentText.trim(), {nickname:nicknameOverride}).then(r => {
                if(!r.success) commentsBox.inputText = newCommentText.trim(); // recover comment text if it failed
              });
              commentsBox.inputText = "";
            }
          }
        } else {
          // No auto-submit, but we still set the nickname to their character
          commentsBox.setNicknameForNextComment(nicknameOverride);
        }
      },
    });
  }
  let saveAutoCommentCharInfoDebounceTimeout;
  window[`__${globalFnsId}_tabbedCommentsPluginSaveAutoCommentCharInfo`] = function() {
    autoCommentCharSelectEl.selectedOptions[0].textContent = autoCommentCharNameEl.value;
    autoCommentChars[autoCommentCharSelectEl.value] = {name:autoCommentCharNameEl.value, description:autoCommentCharNameDescriptionEl.value};
    clearTimeout(saveAutoCommentCharInfoDebounceTimeout);
    saveAutoCommentCharInfoDebounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.autoCommentChars = JSON.stringify(autoCommentChars);
    }, 500);
  }
  window[`__${globalFnsId}_tabbedCommentsPluginSwitchToAutoCommentCharByIndex`] = function(index) {
    if(index === "#") {
      // add a new <option> with an index 1 higher than the current highest:
      let newIndex = autoCommentChars.length;
      let selectedOptionEl = autoCommentCharSelectEl.selectedOptions[0];
      selectedOptionEl.value = newIndex;
      selectedOptionEl.textContent = "Unnamed";
      autoCommentCharNameEl.value = "";
      autoCommentCharNameDescriptionEl.value = "";
      autoCommentCharSelectEl.innerHTML += `<option value="#">Add char...</option>`;
      autoCommentCharSelectEl.value = newIndex;
      localStorage.__tabbedCommentsLastActiveAutoCommentCharIndex = newIndex;
    } else {
      autoCommentCharNameEl.value = autoCommentChars[index].name;
      autoCommentCharNameDescriptionEl.value = autoCommentChars[index].description;
      autoCommentCharSelectEl.value = index;
      localStorage.__tabbedCommentsLastActiveAutoCommentCharIndex = index;
    }
  }
  if(autoCommentChars.length === 0) {
    autoCommentChars.push({name:"Unnamed", description:""});
    autoCommentCharSelectEl.innerHTML = `<option value="0">Unnamed</option>`;
  } else {
    autoCommentCharSelectEl.innerHTML = autoCommentChars.map((o, i) => `<option value="${i}">${o.name}</option>`).join("");
  }
  autoCommentCharSelectEl.innerHTML += `<option value="#">Add char...</option>`;
  try {
    let charIndex = Number(localStorage.__tabbedCommentsLastActiveAutoCommentCharIndex || 0);
    if(isNaN(charIndex)) charIndex = 0;
    if(!autoCommentChars[charIndex]) charIndex = 0;
    if(!autoCommentChars[charIndex]) {
      charIndex = 0;
      autoCommentChars[0] = {name:"Unnamed", description:""};
    }
    localStorage.__tabbedCommentsLastActiveAutoCommentCharIndex = charIndex;
    window[`__${globalFnsId}_tabbedCommentsPluginSwitchToAutoCommentCharByIndex`](charIndex);
    autoCommentAutoSendCheckboxEl.checked = !!localStorage.__tabbedCommentsAutoCommentAutoSendCheckboxValue;
  } catch(e) { alert(e); }

  function createTabbedCommentsPanel(panelOpts) { // takes *list* of commentOptions as input
    if(!panelOpts) panelOpts = {};
    let panelCtn = document.createElement("div");
    panelCtn.innerHTML = `
      <div class="tabbed-comments-plugin-header"></div>
      <div class="tabbed-comments-plugin-body"></div>
    `;
    

    let commentsChannelNameToObj = {};
    let currentChannelName = null;
    let panelObj;

    const tabsHeaderEl = panelCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-plugin-header');
    const tabsContentEl = panelCtn.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-plugin-body');

    function deleteCommentsChannel(channel) {
      let customChannels = readStoredCustomChannels();
      delete customChannels[channel];
      writeStoredCustomChannels(customChannels);
      syncOpenPanelsToStoredCustomChannelState();
    }

    function addCommentsChannel(channel) {
      let customChannels = readStoredCustomChannels();
      let alreadyExisted = !!customChannels[channel] || !!tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      if(channel !== "" && !customChannels[channel]) {
        customChannels[channel] = {channel:channel};
        writeStoredCustomChannels(customChannels);
        syncOpenPanelsToStoredCustomChannelState();
      } else if(channel !== "" && customChannels[channel] && !tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`)) {
        syncPanelCustomChannelsFromStorage();
      }
      if(channel !== "" && customChannels[channel]) clearTemporaryMentionedChannel(channel);

      let tab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      let tabContent = tabsContentEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channel}']`);

      return {tab, tabContent, alreadyExisted};
    }

    function addLocalCommentsChannel(channel) {
      let tab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      let tabContent = tabsContentEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      let alreadyExisted = !!tab;

      if(!alreadyExisted) {
        ({tab, tabContent} = addTab({channel:channel}));
        let addCustomChannelBtn = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-custom-channel");
        if(addCustomChannelBtn) addCustomChannelBtn.before(tab);
      }

      return {tab, tabContent, alreadyExisted};
    }

    function addTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel(channel) {
      let customChannels = readStoredCustomChannels();
      if(customChannels[channel]) return addCommentsChannel(channel);
      return addLocalCommentsChannel(channel);
    }

    function removeTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel(channel) {
      if(readStoredCustomChannels()[channel]) {
        clearTemporaryMentionedChannel(channel);
        syncPanelCustomChannelsFromStorage();
        return;
      }

      let tab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      if(!tab || !tab.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel) return;

      let wasCurrentChannel = currentChannelName === channel;
      delete commentsChannelNameToObj[channel];
      tab.remove();
      tabsContentEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channel}']`)?.remove();

      if(wasCurrentChannel) {
        let firstChannelTab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab');
        if(firstChannelTab) {
          showTabByChannelName(firstChannelTab.dataset.channel);
        } else {
          currentChannelName = null;
          hideActiveCustomChannelControlButtons();
        }
      }
    }

    // Function to react to tab clicks
    async function handleTabClick(event) {
      let clickedTab = event.target;
      if(!clickedTab.classList.contains('tabbed-comments-plugin-tab')) return; // they didn't click directly on a tab

      if(event.target.classList.contains('tabbed-comments-plugin-add-custom-channel')) {
        // They clicked on the "+" icon to add a new channel.
        // let channel = prompt("Choose a channel name. Note: You can type #channelname in the chat to share your channel.");
        let userInput = await getUserInput({
          channel: { type: "input:text", label: "Choose a channel name to add:", placeholder: "You can use letters, numbers and hyphens.", value: window.lastUsedAiSuggestPrompt || "" },
          tip:         { type: "html",     html: `<div style="opacity:0.8; font-size:75%;">
          <details>
            <summary style="cursor:pointer;">Tap here for tips</summary>
            <ul>
              <li>You can type <b>#channelname</b> in the chat to share your channel.</li>
              <li style="margin-top:0.5rem;">If you add <b>+u:alice|bob</b> at the end of a channel name, then only the users with usernames 'alice' and 'bob' will be able to comment on that channel. If your username is 'abc', and you want a personal 'blog' type channel that is publicly known but can't get spammed by others, then you could write <b>blog+u:abc</b> in the above text input, and only you will be able to comment on that channel.</li>
            </u>
            </details>
          </div>`, marginBottom:"0px" },
        }, { okText:"Add channel", cancelText:"Cancel", cancelOnBackgroundClick:true });
        let channel = userInput?.channel;
        if(channel) {
          let removeChannel = false;
          if(channel.startsWith("!")) {
            removeChannel = true;
            channel = channel.slice(1);
          }
          channel = channel.toLowerCase();
          channel = channel.replace(/[^a-z0-9\-:+|]/g, "");

          if(!channel) {
            alert("Channel names can only contain lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.");
            return;
          }
          if(channel === "feedback") return;
          if(channel === "general") return;

          if(removeChannel) {
            deleteCommentsChannel(channel);
            let firstChannelTab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab');
            if(firstChannelTab) showTabByChannelName(firstChannelTab.dataset.channel);
          } else {
            addCommentsChannel(channel);
            showTabByChannelName(channel);
            alert(`The '${channel}' channel has been added. Type #${channel} in the chat to share it.`)
          }
        }
        return;
      } else if(event.target.classList.contains('tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab')) {
        showTabByChannelName(clickedTab.dataset.channel);
      }
    }

    function ensureActiveCustomChannelControlButtons() {
      if(!tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveLeftBtn) {
        let btn = tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveLeftBtn = document.createElement("div");
        btn.className = "tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-control-btn";
        btn.style.cssText = "min-width:1.4rem; display:none;";
        btn.innerHTML = "⬅️";
        btn.title = "Move channel left";
        btn.onclick = function(event) {
          event.stopPropagation();
          moveStoredCustomChannel(this.dataset.channelToMove, "left");
        };
      }
      if(!tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveRightBtn) {
        let btn = tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveRightBtn = document.createElement("div");
        btn.className = "tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-control-btn";
        btn.style.cssText = "min-width:1.4rem; display:none;";
        btn.innerHTML = "➡️";
        btn.title = "Move channel right";
        btn.onclick = function(event) {
          event.stopPropagation();
          moveStoredCustomChannel(this.dataset.channelToMove, "right");
        };
      }
      if(!tabsHeaderEl.channelDeleteBtn) {
        let btn = tabsHeaderEl.channelDeleteBtn = document.createElement("div");
        btn.className = "tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-control-btn";
        btn.style.cssText = "min-width:1.4rem; display:none; outline:light-dark(#ff5858, #a10808) solid 2px;";
        btn.innerHTML = "🗑️";
        btn.title = "Hide or unpin this channel";
        btn.onclick = function(event) {
          event.stopPropagation();
          let channel = this.dataset.channelToDelete;
          if(confirm(`Hide/unpin the '${channel}' channel?`)) {
            deleteCommentsChannel(channel);
          }
        };
      }
    }

    function hideActiveCustomChannelControlButtons() {
      ensureActiveCustomChannelControlButtons();
      disbandActiveCustomChannelControlCluster();
      clearActiveCustomChannelJoinStyles();
      tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveLeftBtn.style.display = "none";
      tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveRightBtn.style.display = "none";
      tabsHeaderEl.channelDeleteBtn.style.display = "none";
    }

    function disbandActiveCustomChannelControlCluster() {
      let clusterEl = tabsHeaderEl.activeCustomChannelControlClusterEl;
      if(!clusterEl || !clusterEl.parentNode) return;
      while(clusterEl.firstChild) {
        clusterEl.parentNode.insertBefore(clusterEl.firstChild, clusterEl);
      }
      clusterEl.remove();
    }

    function clearActiveCustomChannelJoinStyles() {
      for(let el of [...tabsHeaderEl.querySelectorAll(`
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-control-btn,
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-left,
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-right,
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-both,
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-left-arrow-joined-to-active-tab,
        .tabbed-comments-plugin-right-arrow-joined-to-active-tab
      `)]) {
        el.classList.remove(
          'tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-left',
          'tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-right',
          'tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-both',
          'tabbed-comments-plugin-left-arrow-joined-to-active-tab',
          'tabbed-comments-plugin-right-arrow-joined-to-active-tab',
        );
      }
    }

    function ensureActiveCustomChannelControlCluster() {
      if(!tabsHeaderEl.activeCustomChannelControlClusterEl) {
        let clusterEl = tabsHeaderEl.activeCustomChannelControlClusterEl = document.createElement("div");
        clusterEl.className = "tabbed-comments-plugin-active-custom-channel-control-cluster";
      }
      return tabsHeaderEl.activeCustomChannelControlClusterEl;
    }

    function renderControlsAroundActiveCustomChannel(channel) {
      ensureActiveCustomChannelControlButtons();
      hideActiveCustomChannelControlButtons();
      if(!isStoredCustomChannel(channel)) return;

      let activeTab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      if(!activeTab) return;

      let orderedCustomChannelNames = getStoredCustomChannelEntriesInOrder()
        .map(({ channel }) => channel)
        .filter(channelName => !!tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab[data-channel='${channelName}']`));
      let channelIndex = orderedCustomChannelNames.indexOf(channel);
      if(channelIndex < 0) return;

      let moveLeftBtn = tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveLeftBtn;
      let moveRightBtn = tabsHeaderEl.channelMoveRightBtn;
      let deleteBtn = tabsHeaderEl.channelDeleteBtn;
      let clusterEl = ensureActiveCustomChannelControlCluster();

      moveLeftBtn.dataset.channelToMove = channel;
      moveRightBtn.dataset.channelToMove = channel;
      deleteBtn.dataset.channelToDelete = channel;

      let hasLeftMove = channelIndex > 0;
      let hasRightMove = channelIndex < orderedCustomChannelNames.length-1;
      clusterEl.classList.toggle('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-custom-channel-control-cluster-with-arrows', hasLeftMove || hasRightMove);

      activeTab.before(clusterEl);
      if(hasLeftMove) {
        moveLeftBtn.style.display = "flex";
        moveLeftBtn.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-left-arrow-joined-to-active-tab');
        clusterEl.append(moveLeftBtn);
      }
      if(hasLeftMove && hasRightMove) {
        activeTab.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-both');
      } else if(hasLeftMove) {
        activeTab.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-left');
      } else if(hasRightMove) {
        activeTab.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-right');
      }
      clusterEl.append(activeTab);
      if(hasRightMove) {
        moveRightBtn.style.display = "flex";
        moveRightBtn.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-right-arrow-joined-to-active-tab');
        clusterEl.append(moveRightBtn);
      }

      deleteBtn.style.display = "flex";
      clusterEl.after(deleteBtn);
    }

    // Given the channel of a tab, it shows the tab content:
    function showTabByChannelName(channel) {
      let activeTab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      let activeContent = tabsContentEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channel}']`);
      if(!activeTab || !activeContent) return;

      currentChannelName = channel;
      localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginLastViewedChannel = channel;
      tabsHeaderEl.querySelectorAll('.tabbed-comments-plugin-tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab'));
      activeTab.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab');

      tabsContentEl.querySelectorAll('.tabbed-comments-plugin-content').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-content'));
      activeContent.classList.add('tabbed-comments-plugin-active-content');

      unseenCommentCountByChannel[channel] = 0;

      updateUnseenCountHtml(channel);
      renderControlsAroundActiveCustomChannel(channel);
      if(panelOpts.onShowTab) panelOpts.onShowTab({channel});
    }

    function syncPanelCustomChannelsFromStorage() {
      let orderedCustomChannelEntries = getStoredCustomChannelEntriesInOrder();
      let orderedCustomChannelNames = orderedCustomChannelEntries.map(({ channel }) => channel);

      for(let tab of [...tabsHeaderEl.querySelectorAll('.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab')]) {
        let channelName = tab.dataset.channel;
        if(tab.dataset.tabbedCommentsPluginIsTemporaryMentionedChannel) continue;
        if(!isStoredCustomChannel(channelName) || orderedCustomChannelNames.includes(channelName)) continue;
        delete commentsChannelNameToObj[channelName];
        tab.remove();
        tabsContentEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-content[data-channel='${channelName}']`)?.remove();
      }

      for(let { commentOptions, channel } of orderedCustomChannelEntries) {
        clearTemporaryMentionedChannel(channel);
        if(tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab[data-channel='${channel}']`)) continue;
        let {tab} = addTab(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(commentOptions)));
      }

      let addCustomChannelBtn = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-add-custom-channel");
      let closePanelBtn = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(".tabbed-comments-plugin-close-panel-btn");
      if(closePanelBtn) tabsHeaderEl.prepend(closePanelBtn);
      for(let channelName of orderedCustomChannelNames) {
        let tab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab[data-channel='${channelName}']`);
        if(!tab) continue;
        if(addCustomChannelBtn) addCustomChannelBtn.before(tab);
        else tabsHeaderEl.append(tab);
      }
      if(addCustomChannelBtn) tabsHeaderEl.append(addCustomChannelBtn);

      if(currentChannelName && tabsHeaderEl.querySelector(`.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab[data-channel='${currentChannelName}']`)) {
        renderControlsAroundActiveCustomChannel(currentChannelName);
        return;
      }

      let firstChannelTab = tabsHeaderEl.querySelector('.tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab');
      if(firstChannelTab) {
        showTabByChannelName(firstChannelTab.dataset.channel);
      } else {
        currentChannelName = null;
        hideActiveCustomChannelControlButtons();
      }
    }

    // Adds a new tab to the module
    function addTab(commentOptions) {
    
      commentOptions.width = "100%";
      commentOptions.height = "100%"; // only makes sense to set height via defaultChannelOptions, and that controls overall comments container height
      if(!commentOptions.customEmojis) commentOptions.customEmojis = defaultChannelOptions.customEmojis || defaultCustomEmojis;
      commentOptions.forceColorScheme = defaultChannelOptions.forceColorScheme ?? localStorage.forceColorScheme ?? null;
      
      let originalOnCommentHandler = commentOptions.onComment || defaultChannelOptions.onComment;
      let originalOnLoadHandler = commentOptions.onLoad || defaultChannelOptions.onLoad
      commentOptions.onComment = function(...args) {
        commentsPluginOnCommentHandler(...args); // for counting unseen, channel mentions, etc.
        try { if(originalOnCommentHandler) originalOnCommentHandler(...args); } catch(e) { console.error(e) } // userland code
      };
      commentOptions.onLoad = function(...args) {
        commentsPluginOnLoadHandler(...args); // for counting unseen, channel mentions, etc.
        try { if(originalOnLoadHandler) originalOnLoadHandler(...args);  } catch(e) { console.error(e) } // userland code
      };
    
      commentOptions.replacedDuringUpdate = true; // needed to allow multiple instances of the same channel (since we have multiple tabbed-comments-modules)
      for(let key of defaultChannelOptions.getAllKeys || Object.keys(defaultChannelOptions)) {
        if(!commentOptions[key] && !commentOptions.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
          // getter, because the default options could be dynamic (e.g. dark/light mode using localStorage), and this createTabbedCommentsPanel function is (as of writing) called every time the dark/light mode is switched.
          Object.defineProperty(commentOptions, key, {
            get: () => defaultChannelOptions[key],
          });
        }
      }
      
      let commentsPluginOutput = commentsPlugin(commentOptions);
      commentsChannelNameToObj[commentOptions.channel] = commentsPluginOutput;

      const tab = document.createElement('div');
      tab.className = 'tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-channel-tab'; // note that non-channel tabs/buttons are possible - e.g. close tab button, close panel button
      tab.textContent = commentOptions.label || commentOptions.channel || "general";
      tab.innerHTML += `<span class="tabbed-comments-plugin-unseen-count">?</span>`;
      tab.dataset.channel = commentOptions.channel;

      const tabContent = document.createElement('div');
      tabContent.className = 'tabbed-comments-plugin-content';
      tabContent.innerHTML = commentsPluginOutput;
      tabContent.dataset.channel = commentOptions.channel;
      
      // for refreshing the comments if needed (e.g. when dark/light mode changes - see updateColorScheme function)
      tabContent.dataset.tabbedCommentsDirectParentOfCommentsPluginOutput = "1";
      tabContent.__commentOptionsUsed = commentOptions; // this should probably not be 'concrete' ones because we want a reference to the dynamic onces for if/when we need to reload it

      tabsHeaderEl.appendChild(tab);
      tabsContentEl.appendChild(tabContent);
      return {tab, tabContent};
    }

    let existingChannelNames = [];
    let channelNameToChannelData = {};
    for(let commentOptions of commentsChannels.selectAll) {
      if(typeof commentOptions === "string") commentOptions = {channel:commentOptions}; // in case commentsChannels is just an array of strings
      if(!commentOptions.channel) commentOptions.channel = commentOptions.getName==="general" ? "" : commentOptions.getName; // use name of commentOptions object as channel name by default
      let channelName = commentOptions.channel.toString();
      let {tab, tabContent} = addTab(commentOptions);
      channelNameToChannelData[channelName] = {tab, tabContent, channelName};
      existingChannelNames.push(channelName);
    }

    // Add the "+" button:
    if(commentsChannels.allowCustomChannels !== false) {

      // add user-specified custom channels:
      for(let commentOptions of Object.values(readStoredCustomChannels())) {
        if(existingChannelNames.includes(commentOptions.channel)) continue; // already got that channel
        let channelName = commentOptions.channel.toString();
        let {tab, tabContent} = addTab(commentOptions);
        channelNameToChannelData[channelName] = {tab, tabContent, channelName};
      }
      // add the "+" button:
      const tab = document.createElement('div');
      tab.className = 'tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-add-custom-channel';
      tab.textContent = "+";
      tab.style.cssText = "min-width:1.4rem;";
      tabsHeaderEl.appendChild(tab);
    }
    
    // add the close-panel button if needed:
    {
      const tab = document.createElement('div');
      tab.className = 'tabbed-comments-plugin-tab tabbed-comments-plugin-close-panel-btn';
      tab.textContent = "❌";
      tab.title = "Close this panel";
      // NOTE: rather than not adding the button, or using display:none; we just remove it's width + opacity + pointer-events, because otherwise the height of the header can change due to emoji font size, which vertically offsets the panels by a pixel or two, which looks bad.
      tab.style.cssText = panelOpts.addCloseButton ? "min-width:1.4rem;" : "width:0px; max-width:0px; pointer-events:none; margin-left:0; margin-right:0; padding-left:0; padding-right:0; min-width:0px; opacity:0;";
      tab.onclick = function() {
        panelCtn.remove();
        if(panelObj) allPanelObjs.delete(panelObj);
        if(panelOpts.onClose) panelOpts.onClose();
      };
      tabsHeaderEl.prepend(tab);
    }

    let defaultStartChannelIndex = 0;

    let activeChannelData = channelNameToChannelData[localStorage.__tabbedCommentsPluginLastViewedChannel ?? existingChannelNames[defaultStartChannelIndex]];
    if(!activeChannelData) {
      console.error("localstorage had __tabbedCommentsPluginLastViewedChannel, but that channel doesn't exist?");
      activeChannelData = channelNameToChannelData[existingChannelNames[0]];
    }

    setTimeout(async () => {
      while(!document.body.contains(panelCtn)) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
      showTabByChannelName(activeChannelData.channelName);
    }, 10);

    tabsHeaderEl.addEventListener('click', handleTabClick);

    panelObj = {element:panelCtn, addCommentsChannel, addTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel, removeTemporaryMentionedCommentsChannel, deleteCommentsChannel, commentsChannelNameToObj, showTabByChannelName, syncPanelCustomChannelsFromStorage};
    allPanelObjs.add(panelObj);

    let styleEl = document.createElement("style");
    styleEl.textContent = `
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-header {
        display: flex;
        font-size: 70%;
        overflow:auto;
        color:var(--tabbed-comments-plugin-text-color);
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-body {
        flex-grow:1;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-tab {
        padding: 0.25rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        background: var(--tabbed-comments-plugin-box-color, #ebebeb);
        border-radius: 0.25rem;
        margin: 0.25rem;
        user-select: none;
        min-width: max-content;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-tab[data-tabbed-comments-plugin-is-temporary-mentioned-channel='1'] {
        opacity:0.6;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-unseen-count {
        border-radius: 100px;
        padding: 0.05rem 0.15rem;
        font-size:80%;
        background:grey;
        margin-left: 0.1rem;
        pointer-events:none;
        color:white;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab {
        background: var(--tabbed-comments-plugin-active-comment-channel-tab-color, #c6c6c6);
        outline: 2px solid #0086c9;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-custom-channel-control-cluster {
        display:flex;
        align-items:center;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-custom-channel-control-cluster-with-arrows {
        margin: 0.25rem;
        border-radius: 0.25rem;
        outline: 2px solid #0086c9;
        outline-offset: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-left,
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-right,
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-both,
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-left-arrow-joined-to-active-tab,
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-right-arrow-joined-to-active-tab {
        outline: none;
        margin: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-left-arrow-joined-to-active-tab {
        border-top-right-radius: 0;
        border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-right-arrow-joined-to-active-tab {
        border-top-left-radius: 0;
        border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-left {
        border-top-left-radius: 0;
        border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-right {
        border-top-right-radius: 0;
        border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-tab-joined-both {
        border-radius: 0;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-content {
        display: none;
        height:100%;
      }
      .tabbed-comments-plugin-active-content {
        display: block;
      }
      @media only screen and (max-width: 650px) {
        .tabbed-comments-auto-comment-ctn { flex-direction:column; }
      }
      .tabbed-comments-ctn-left { display:none; }
      .tabbed-comments-ctn-right { display:none; }
      ${CSS.supports("container-type", "inline-size") ? `@container` : `@media only screen and`} (min-width: 1100px) {
        .tabbed-comments-ctn-left { display:flex; }
        .tabbed-comments-ctn-right { display:flex; }
      }
    `;
    panelCtn.append(styleEl);
    panelCtn.style.cssText = "height:100%; width:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column;"
    return panelObj;
  }
  
  middlePanelObj = createTabbedCommentsPanel({
    onShowTab: ({channel}) => {
      middleCtnCurrentlyShownCommentsChannelName = channel;
      
      let channelData = commentsChannels[channel || "general"];
      if(!channelData) channelData = defaultChannelOptions;
      let allowBots = channelData.allowBots;
      if(channel === "" || channel === "general" || opts.allowBots === false) {
        if(allowBots === undefined) allowBots = false; // by default, don't allow bots on main/general/chat channel
      }
      autoCommentCtn.style.display = "none";
      if(allowBots !== false) {
        showAutoCommentAreaBtn.style.display = "";
      } else {
        showAutoCommentAreaBtn.style.display = "none";
      }
    },
  });
  middleCtnChannelNameToObj = middlePanelObj.commentsChannelNameToObj;
  middleCtn.appendChild(middlePanelObj.element);
  return outerCtn;

async getUserInput(fields, opts) =>
  fields = fields || {};
  opts = opts || {};
  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[<>&]/g, m => ({"<":"&lt;","&":"&amp;",">":"&gt;"}[m]));
  const cancelText = esc(opts.cancelText || "Cancel");
  const okText = esc(opts.okText || "OK");

  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const overlay = Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { tabIndex: 0 });
    overlay.style.cssText = `position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999999;display:grid;place-items:center;background-color:rgba(0,0,0,.65);font:16px/1.4 system-ui`;

    const modal = document.createElement("div");
    modal.style.cssText = `
      text-align:left !important;
      width:520px;max-width:97vw;
      border-radius:8px;padding:15px;
      background-color:light-dark(#fff,#222);
      color:light-dark(#000,#fff);
      box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;
      max-height:min(92vh, 900px);
    `;

    // Scrollable content
    const scrollWrap = document.createElement("div");
    scrollWrap.style.cssText = "overflow:auto;min-height:0;";
    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.style.cssText = "display:block";
    scrollWrap.append(host);

    // Footer (Cancel left, OK right)
    const footer = document.createElement("div");
    footer.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:4px;";
    const cancelBtn = document.createElement("button");
    cancelBtn.textContent = cancelText;
    cancelBtn.hidden = !!opts.hideCancel;
    cancelBtn.style.cssText = "padding:6px 16px;border:1px solid light-dark(#ccc,#555);border-radius:6px;background-color:light-dark(#f6f6f6,#333);color:inherit;cursor:pointer;";
    const okBtn = document.createElement("button");
    okBtn.textContent = okText;
    okBtn.autofocus = true;
    okBtn.style.cssText = "margin-left:auto;padding:6px 16px;border:none;border-radius:6px;background-color:light-dark(#1677ff,#2b87ff);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;";

    footer.append(cancelBtn, okBtn);
    modal.append(scrollWrap, footer);
    overlay.append(modal);

    const elMap = new Map();
    const inputCSS = "width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:8px;border:1px solid light-dark(#ccc,#555);border-radius:6px;background-color:light-dark(#fff,#333);color:inherit;";

    Object.entries(fields).forEach(([name, cfgRaw]) => {
      const cfg = cfgRaw || {};
      const t = (cfg.type || "input:text").toLowerCase();
      const wrap = document.createElement("div");
      wrap.style.cssText = `margin:0 0 ${cfg.marginBottom || "12px"}`;

      if (cfg.label) {
        const lab = document.createElement("div");
        lab.style.cssText = "margin:0 0 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;";
        const labText = document.createElement("div");
        labText.textContent = cfg.label || name;
        lab.append(labText);
        if (cfg.help) {
          const help = document.createElement("span");
          help.textContent = "i";
          help.title = cfg.help;
          help.style.cssText = "margin-left:auto;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid light-dark(#ccc,#555);font:12px/1 system-ui;opacity:.75;cursor:help;user-select:none";
          help.onclick = () => alert(cfg.help);
          lab.append(help);
        }
        wrap.append(lab);
      }

      let el = null, kind = "std";
      if (t === "textarea") {
        el = document.createElement("textarea");
        el.rows = cfg.rows || 4;
        el.style.cssText = inputCSS;
        if (cfg.placeholder != null) el.placeholder = cfg.placeholder;
        if (cfg.value != null) el.value = cfg.value;
      } else if (t === "select") {
        el = document.createElement("select");
        el.style.cssText = inputCSS;
        if (cfg.multiple) el.multiple = true;
        (cfg.options || []).forEach(opt => {
          const o = document.createElement("option");
          if (typeof opt === "object") { o.value = opt.value; o.textContent = opt.label ?? opt.value; }
          else { o.value = String(opt); o.textContent = String(opt); }
          el.append(o);
        });
        const v = cfg.value;
        if (el.multiple && Array.isArray(v)) Array.from(el.options).forEach(o => o.selected = v.includes(o.value));
        else if (v != null) el.value = v;
      } else if (t.startsWith("input:")) {
        el = document.createElement("input");
        el.type = t.split(":")[1] || "text";
        el.style.cssText = inputCSS;
        if (cfg.placeholder != null) el.placeholder = cfg.placeholder;
        if (cfg.min != null) el.min = cfg.min;
        if (cfg.max != null) el.max = cfg.max;
        if (cfg.step != null) el.step = cfg.step;
        if (el.type === "checkbox") el.checked = !!cfg.value;
        else if (cfg.value != null) el.value = cfg.value;
      } else if (t === "html") {
        const html = document.createElement("div");
        html.innerHTML = cfg.html || "";
        wrap.append(html);
        host.append(wrap);
        elMap.set(name, { cfg, el: html, wrap, kind: "html" });
        return;
      } else {
        const html = document.createElement("div");
        html.innerHTML = cfg.html || "";
        wrap.append(html);
        host.append(wrap);
        elMap.set(name, { cfg, el: html, wrap, kind: "html" });
        return;
      }

      el.name = name;
      wrap.append(el);
      host.append(wrap);
      elMap.set(name, { cfg, el, wrap, kind: "std" });
    });

    const finish = v => { overlay.remove(); resolve(v); };

    cancelBtn.onclick = () => finish(null);
    okBtn.onclick = () => {
      const out = {};
      elMap.forEach(({ el, kind, wrap }, name) => {
        if (kind === "html") {
          const dv = wrap.querySelector("[data-value]");
          out[name] = dv ? dv.getAttribute("data-value") : null;
        } else if (el.tagName === "SELECT") {
          out[name] = el.multiple ? Array.from(el.selectedOptions).map(o => o.value) : el.value;
        } else if (el.tagName === "TEXTAREA") {
          out[name] = el.value;
        } else if (el.tagName === "INPUT") {
          if (el.type === "checkbox") out[name] = el.checked;
          else if (el.type === "number" || el.type === "range") {
            const n = parseFloat(el.value); out[name] = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
          } else out[name] = el.value;
        } else out[name] = null;
      });
      finish(out);
    };

    overlay.onkeydown = e => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") finish(null);
      else if (e.key === "Enter" && e.target.tagName !== "TEXTAREA") { e.preventDefault(); okBtn.click(); }
    };

    // Backdrop mousedown cancel only (not mouseup)
    if (opts.cancelOnBackgroundClick) {
      overlay.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
        if (e.target === overlay) finish(null);
      });
    }

    document.body.append(overlay);
    overlay.focus({ preventScroll: true });

    const first = host.querySelector("input,textarea,select");
    if (first) setTimeout(() => first.focus({ preventScroll: true }), 0);
  });
````

```javascript
        user-select: none !important;
      }
      `;
    }
    
    let elementStylesObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => { updateStyles(); });
    elementStylesObserver.observe(element, { attributes:true, attributeFilter:['style'] });

    // let lastElementRectHeight = null;
    // let elementResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    //   updateCmEditorHeight();
    // });
    // elementResizeObserver.observe(element);

    updateStyles();
    setTimeout(updateStyles, 1);
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', e => {
      editorView.dispatch({effects: themeCompartment.reconfigure(e.matches ? darkTheme : lightTheme)});
      updateStyles();
    });

    editorView.dom.style.outline = "none";  
    
    element.view = editorView;
    // element.yDoc = yDoc;
    // element.yText = yText;
    // element.docId = docId;

    // Hackily triggers synchronous layout
    // EDIT: Commented out because it causes a *massive* (multi-second) initial render delay.
    // editorView.coordsAtPos(1);
    
    return element;
  }

  return createTextEditor(opts);
````
